# app_host.py: entry point frozen into VideoGrabberApp.exe (thin app host).
# This is the former launcher.py, unchanged in its defences; under the
# Supervisor Architecture it is spawned BY the supervisor (launcher.py,
# frozen as VideoGrabber.exe), which owns the single-instance mutex and
# crash counting. Added here: VG_SUPERVISED (skip the mutex - the
# supervisor holds it), VG_SMOKE_TEST (runtime health probe for
# Recovery), VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT (run updater_ui.py instead of server.py),
# and the --simulate matrix used by test_harness.py.
#
# (Original header follows.)
# launcher.py: entry point frozen into VideoGrabber.exe (thin launcher).
#
# Order matters, and the first three steps are the fork-bomb defence:
#   1. multiprocessing.freeze_support()  (frozen children exit cleanly)
#   2. single-instance mutex             (a 2nd copy exits at once)
#   3. self-spawn guard                  (frozen exe can never re-run itself
#                                         through subprocess; logs who tried)
#   4. sys.path / DLL dirs for runtime\site-packages (numpy, PIL, PySide6)
#   5. run app\server.py as __main__
#
# NOTE: this launcher never relaunches itself, on a crash or otherwise.
# If you merge in other launcher features (bgutil provider, self-heal),
# keep them AFTER step 3, and if one truly must start this exe again,
# set VG_ALLOW_SELF_SPAWN=1 in that child's env and close the mutex first
# with release_instance_lock().
import os
import sys
import runpy
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

LOCK_NAME = "Local\\VideoGrabber_SingleInstance_v1"
HOST_LOCK_NAME = "Local\\VideoGrabber_Host_v1"
# Exit code for "refused: another host already has the host mutex".
# Distinct on purpose (post-audit fix 1): the supervisor recognises it
# and does NOT count the run as a crash. A duplicate launch is not a
# failure, and counting it could blacklist a healthy version after 3
# stray double-clicks against an orphaned host.
DUPLICATE_HOST_EXIT = 42
_lock_handle = None
_host_lock_handle = None
_dll_handles = []   # keep add_dll_directory handles alive


def _root() -> Path:
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        return Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent


ROOT = _root()
APP = ROOT / "app" if (ROOT / "app").is_dir() else Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RUNTIME = ROOT / "runtime"
SITE = RUNTIME / "site-packages"
LOG = ROOT / "launcher.log"


def _log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} pid={os.getpid()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def _fatal(msg: str) -> None:
    _log("FATAL: " + msg)
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            import ctypes
            ctypes.windll.user32.MessageBoxW(
                None, msg[:1500] + f"\n\nDetails: {LOG}", "Video Grabber", 0x10)
        except Exception:
            pass


_stderr_file = None


def _ensure_std_streams() -> None:
    """console=False builds start with sys.stdout / sys.stderr = None.
    Anything that writes to them (print, werkzeug, yt-dlp, click) can
    then die with AttributeError, and every traceback vanishes. Give
    them real sinks (stdout -> devnull, stderr -> launcher.log) and
    switch on faulthandler so a native crash (Qt / DLL abort) leaves a
    trace instead of a silent exit."""
    global _stderr_file
    try:
        if sys.stdout is None:
            sys.stdout = open(os.devnull, "w", encoding="utf-8")
        if sys.stderr is None:
            _stderr_file = open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8", buffering=1)
            sys.stderr = _stderr_file
        import faulthandler
        faulthandler.enable(file=sys.stderr, all_threads=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


# ---- 2. single-instance lock ------------------------------------------------
def acquire_instance_lock() -> bool:
    """True if we are the only instance. Windows named mutex."""
    global _lock_handle
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        return True
    import ctypes
    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    k32.CreateMutexW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    k32.CreateMutexW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_wchar_p]
    k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    handle = k32.CreateMutexW(None, False, LOCK_NAME)
    if ctypes.get_last_error() == 183:      # ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS
        if handle:
            k32.CloseHandle(handle)
        return False
    _lock_handle = handle
    return True


def release_instance_lock() -> None:
    global _lock_handle
    if _lock_handle and sys.platform == "win32":
        import ctypes
        ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32").CloseHandle(ctypes.c_void_p(_lock_handle))
    _lock_handle = None


def host_lock_required(env) -> bool:
    """Fix 4 (pure, unit-tested): the host mutex is required for
    every real run. Only the two guest modes skip it: the smoke probe
    (Recovery must be able to test the runtime WHILE the app runs)
    and the updater entry script (a guest of the supervisor)."""
    return not (env.get("VG_SMOKE_TEST") or env.get("VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT"))


def acquire_host_lock() -> bool:
    """The host's OWN mutex, Local\\VideoGrabber_Host_v1, taken
    regardless of VG_SUPERVISED. The supervisor's mutex proves a
    supervisor is running; it does not prove only one HOST is. With
    VG_SUPERVISED inherited by every grandchild, the main mutex alone
    left the fork-bomb defence resting on the subprocess patch; this
    lock means a second host exits at once, supervised or not, and an
    orphaned host blocks (visibly) instead of colliding silently."""
    global _host_lock_handle
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        return True
    import ctypes
    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    k32.CreateMutexW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    k32.CreateMutexW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_wchar_p]
    k32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    handle = k32.CreateMutexW(None, False, HOST_LOCK_NAME)
    if ctypes.get_last_error() == 183:      # ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS
        if handle:
            k32.CloseHandle(handle)
        return False
    _host_lock_handle = handle
    return True


def release_host_lock() -> None:
    global _host_lock_handle
    if _host_lock_handle and sys.platform == "win32":
        import ctypes
        ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32").CloseHandle(ctypes.c_void_p(_host_lock_handle))
    _host_lock_handle = None


# ---- 3. self-spawn guard ------------------------------------------------------
def install_spawn_guard() -> None:
    """In a frozen build sys.executable IS this exe. Anything that runs
    [sys.executable, '-m', ...] or [sys.executable, '-c', ...] would start
    a whole new copy of the app. Block it and log the call stack."""
    if not getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        return
    import subprocess
    own = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(sys.executable))
    own_name = os.path.basename(own)
    real_init = subprocess.Popen.__init__

    def _is_self(cmd) -> bool:
        try:
            first = cmd
            if isinstance(cmd, (list, tuple)):
                if not cmd:
                    return False
                first = cmd[0]
            first = os.fsdecode(first).strip()
            n = os.path.normcase(first).lstrip('"')
            if isinstance(cmd, (list, tuple)):
                return (os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(first.strip('"'))) == own
                        or os.path.basename(n.rstrip('"')) == own_name)
            return n.startswith(own)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def guarded(self, *a, **kw):
        cmd = a[0] if a else kw.get("args")
        if _is_self(cmd) and os.environ.get("VG_ALLOW_SELF_SPAWN") != "1":
            _log("BLOCKED self-spawn: %r\n%s" % (cmd, "".join(traceback.format_stack(limit=12))))
            raise RuntimeError("Blocked: frozen app tried to start itself via subprocess")
        return real_init(self, *a, **kw)

    subprocess.Popen.__init__ = guarded


# ---- 4. sys.path + DLL search path --------------------------------------------
def setup_paths() -> None:
    for p in (str(SITE), str(APP)):          # APP ends up first, SITE second
        while p in sys.path:
            sys.path.remove(p)
        sys.path.insert(0, p)

    dll_dirs = [Path(getattr(sys, "_MEIPASS", ROOT)), RUNTIME, SITE,
                SITE / "PySide6", SITE / "shiboken6",
                SITE / "numpy.libs", SITE / "numpy" / ".libs",
                SITE / "pillow.libs", SITE / "PIL"]
    existing = [d for d in dll_dirs if d.is_dir()]
    if hasattr(os, "add_dll_directory"):
        for d in existing:
            try:
                _dll_handles.append(os.add_dll_directory(str(d)))
            except OSError as e:
                _log(f"add_dll_directory failed for {d}: {e}")
    os.environ["PATH"] = os.pathsep.join(
        [str(d) for d in existing] + [os.environ.get("PATH", "")])

    _log(f"python={sys.version.split()[0]} root={ROOT} app={APP}")
    _log("site-packages: numpy=%s numpy.libs=%s PIL=%s PySide6=%s" % (
        (SITE / "numpy").is_dir(), (SITE / "numpy.libs").is_dir(),
        (SITE / "PIL").is_dir(), (SITE / "PySide6").is_dir()))
    if "numpy" in sys.modules or "PIL" in sys.modules:
        _log("WARNING: numpy/PIL already imported before path setup (bundled copy?)")


def _simulate_mode() -> str:
    for a in sys.argv[1:]:
        if a.startswith("--simulate="):
            return a.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
    return os.environ.get("VG_SIMULATE", "").strip()


_held_sockets = []   # --simulate=port-occupied keeps 5757 bound during the run


def _apply_simulation(mode: str) -> None:
    """test_harness hooks (contract §7). Non-destructive: corrupt-settings
    restores the original bytes in main()'s finally."""
    if mode == "crash-before-sentinel":
        _log("SIMULATE crash-before-sentinel: exiting before the app starts")
        raise SystemExit(3)
    if mode == "missing-module":
        _log("SIMULATE missing-module: raising ModuleNotFoundError")
        raise ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'vg_simulated_missing' (simulated)")
    if mode == "port-occupied":
        import socket
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 5757))
        sock.listen(1)
        _held_sockets.append(sock)
        _log("SIMULATE port-occupied: dummy listener bound to 5757")
    if mode == "corrupt-settings":
        sj = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "VideoGrabber" / "settings.json"
        if sj.is_file():
            backup = sj.with_suffix(".json.simbackup")
            backup.write_bytes(sj.read_bytes())
            sj.write_text("{ this is not json", encoding="utf-8")
            _log(f"SIMULATE corrupt-settings: {sj} corrupted (backup at {backup})")


def _restore_simulated_settings() -> None:
    sj = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "VideoGrabber" / "settings.json"
    backup = sj.with_suffix(".json.simbackup")
    try:
        if backup.is_file():
            sj.write_bytes(backup.read_bytes())
            backup.unlink()
            _log("SIMULATE corrupt-settings: original settings.json restored")
    except Exception:
        pass


def main() -> int:
    # 1. must be first: frozen multiprocessing children are handled here
    import multiprocessing
    multiprocessing.freeze_support()

    try:
        if LOG.exists() and LOG.stat().st_size > 512_000:
            LOG.unlink()
    except Exception:
        pass

    _ensure_std_streams()
    _log("host start argv=%r supervised=%s smoke=%s entry=%s" % (
        sys.argv[1:], os.environ.get("VG_SUPERVISED"),
        os.environ.get("VG_SMOKE_TEST"), os.environ.get("VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT")))

    # 2. Under the supervisor, the supervisor holds the mutex (§1).
    # Smoke-test and updater-entry modes never take it either: they are
    # probes/guests, and blocking them on the app's mutex would make a
    # healthy install look broken (and silently no-op the updater).
    supervised = os.environ.get("VG_SUPERVISED") == "1"
    guest_mode = bool(os.environ.get("VG_SMOKE_TEST")
                      or os.environ.get("VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT"))
    if not supervised and not guest_mode and not acquire_instance_lock():
        _log("another instance holds the lock; exiting")
        return 0
    # 2b. Our own host mutex, supervised or not (fix 4). Guests skip
    # it: see host_lock_required.
    if host_lock_required(os.environ) and not acquire_host_lock():
        _log("another HOST already holds the host lock; exiting (42)")
        return DUPLICATE_HOST_EXIT
    # 3.
    install_spawn_guard()
    # 4.
    mode = _simulate_mode()
    try:
        setup_paths()
        if os.environ.get("VG_SMOKE_TEST") == "1":
            # Recovery's runtime probe: importing from runtime\ ONLY
            # (paths were just set up) proves the environment is whole.
            # Quiet by design: no _fatal MessageBox - the caller reads
            # the exit code and stderr.
            failures = []
            for modname in ("PySide6.QtWidgets", "requests", "flask",
                            "yt_dlp", "yt_dlp.extractor", "server"):
                try:
                    __import__(modname)
                except BaseException:
                    failures.append(modname)
                    _log(f"SMOKE import {modname} FAILED:\n"
                         + traceback.format_exc()[-1500:])
            if failures:
                print("SMOKE_FAIL: " + ", ".join(failures))
                return 1
            print("SMOKE_OK")
            return 0
        _apply_simulation(mode)
        entry = os.environ.get("VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT", "")
        if entry:
            # Updater mode: the supervisor staged updater_ui.py and asks
            # the host (the only interpreter this install has) to run it.
            script = Path(entry)
            if not script.is_file():
                _fatal(f"VG_ENTRY_SCRIPT not found: {script}")
                return 1
            os.chdir(str(script.parent))
            sys.argv = [str(script)]
            runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")
            return 0
        server = APP / "server.py"
        if not server.is_file():
            _fatal(f"app\\server.py not found at {server}")
            return 1
        os.chdir(str(APP))
        sys.argv[0] = str(server)
        # 5.
        runpy.run_path(str(server), run_name="__main__")
        return 0
    except SystemExit as e:
        code = e.code
        _log(f"SystemExit code={code!r}")
        return code if isinstance(code, int) else 0
    except BaseException:
        _fatal("Video Grabber crashed on startup:\n" + traceback.format_exc()[-1200:])
        return 1
    finally:
        if mode == "corrupt-settings":
            _restore_simulated_settings()
        for sock in _held_sockets:
            try:
                sock.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        release_instance_lock()
        release_host_lock()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""Bundle the bgutil PO-token provider into a Video Grabber runtime\\ folder.

    python bundle_pot_provider.py --runtime path\\to\\runtime
    python bundle_pot_provider.py --runtime path\\to\\runtime --verify-only

What it does (needs internet; run it on the machine that builds the release):

  1. Installs the yt-dlp plugin (pure Python, no dependencies) into
     runtime\\site-packages, where launcher.py already puts sys.path.
  2. Downloads the provider SERVER source for the SAME version into
     runtime\\bgutil-pot-server and runs `deno install` there, using the
     runtime's own deno. No Node.js is needed.
  3. Starts the server on a spare port, checks /ping reports the pinned
     version, stops it. Exit code 0 only if that worked.

Plugin and server versions must match; bump PROVIDER_VERSION for both at once
(check PyPI for the newest bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider). runtime\\ is not touched
by thin app updates, so a bump ships with a full install package.

--verify-only runs just step 3 against an existing folder. Run it on the
UNPACKED release too: node_modules uses links, and a zip tool that doesn't
preserve or follow them will break the server.
"""
import argparse
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

PROVIDER_VERSION = "2.0.1"
REPO = "Brainicism/bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider"
SMOKE_PORT = 4499  # not 4416, so a running app's provider isn't disturbed


def _deno_path(runtime: Path, override: str = None) -> str:
    if override:
        return override
    for name in ("deno.exe", "deno"):
        p = runtime / name
        if p.is_file():
            return str(p)
    found = shutil.which("deno")
    if found:
        return found
    sys.exit("deno not found in the runtime folder or on PATH (use --deno).")


def install_plugin(runtime: Path, version: str, python: str) -> None:
    target = runtime / "site-packages"
    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"[1/3] plugin bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider=={version} -> {target}")
    subprocess.run(
        [python, "-m", "pip", "install", "--target", str(target), "--no-deps",
         "--upgrade", "--disable-pip-version-check",
         f"bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider=={version}"],
        check=True)
    plugin_dir = target / "yt_dlp_plugins" / "extractor"
    if not (plugin_dir / "getpot_bgutil_http.py").is_file():
        sys.exit(f"plugin files not found under {plugin_dir}")


def install_server(runtime: Path, version: str, deno: str) -> None:
    dest = runtime / "bgutil-pot-server"
    url = f"https://codeload.github.com/{REPO}/zip/refs/tags/{version}"
    print(f"[2/3] server {version}: downloading {url}")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "VideoGrabber-bundler"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
        data = r.read()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
            zf.extractall(tmp)
        roots = [p for p in Path(tmp).iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
        src = roots[0] / "server" if roots else None
        if not src or not (src / "src" / "main.ts").is_file():
            sys.exit("downloaded archive has no server/src/main.ts")
        if dest.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(dest)  # also removes node_modules links without following them
        shutil.copytree(src, dest, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(
            "node_modules", "Dockerfile", "README.md", "scripts", "eslint.config.mjs"))
    print(f"      deno install (native canvas module) in {dest}")
    subprocess.run([deno, "install", "--allow-scripts=npm:canvas", "--frozen"],
                   cwd=str(dest), check=True,
                   env=dict(os.environ, DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK="1"))
    (dest / "bgutil-version.txt").write_text(version + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def smoke_test(runtime: Path, version: str, deno: str, port: int = SMOKE_PORT) -> None:
    server = runtime / "bgutil-pot-server"
    modules = server / "node_modules"
    if not (server / "src" / "main.ts").is_file() or not modules.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f"{server} is missing src\\main.ts or node_modules; run without --verify-only first.")
    print(f"[3/3] smoke test: starting the server on port {port}")
    cmd = [deno, "run", "--no-prompt", "--allow-env", "--allow-net", "--allow-ffi=.",
           "--allow-read=.", "../src/main.ts", "--port", str(port)]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=str(modules), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            env=dict(os.environ, DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK="1"))
    out = []
    try:
        deadline = time.time() + 60
        reply = None
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if proc.poll() is not None:
                break
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/ping", timeout=2) as r:
                    reply = json.loads(r.read().decode())
                    break
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.5)
        if reply is None:
            proc.terminate()
            try:
                out = proc.communicate(timeout=5)[0].decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()
            except Exception:
                pass
            tail = "\n".join(out[-15:])
            sys.exit(f"server did not answer /ping (exit code {proc.poll()}).\n{tail}")
        if reply.get("version") != version:
            sys.exit(f"server reports version {reply.get('version')!r}, expected {version!r}")
        print(f"      ok: /ping -> {reply}")
    finally:
        if proc.poll() is None:
            proc.terminate()
            try:
                proc.wait(timeout=5)
            except Exception:
                proc.kill()


def folder_size_mb(p: Path) -> float:
    total = 0
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(p, followlinks=False):
        for f in files:
            try:
                total += os.lstat(os.path.join(root, f)).st_size
            except OSError:
                pass
    return total / 1e6


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--runtime", required=True, help="the runtime\\ folder beside VideoGrabber.exe")
    ap.add_argument("--version", default=PROVIDER_VERSION)
    ap.add_argument("--python", default=sys.executable, help="python used for pip (any 3.8+)")
    ap.add_argument("--deno", default=None, help="deno executable (default: runtime\\deno.exe)")
    ap.add_argument("--verify-only", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    runtime = Path(a.runtime).resolve()
    if not runtime.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f"runtime folder not found: {runtime}")
    deno = _deno_path(runtime, a.deno)
    print(f"runtime: {runtime}\ndeno:    {deno}")
    if not a.verify_only:
        install_plugin(runtime, a.version, a.python)
        install_server(runtime, a.version, deno)
    smoke_test(runtime, a.version, deno)
    print(f"done. bgutil-pot-server is {folder_size_mb(runtime / 'bgutil-pot-server'):.0f} MB")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""component_updater.py: ffmpeg and deno updates for the installed app (v5.5).

Same idea as updater.bat's rename-then-replace swap, done at launch instead of
by a batch file: the new binary is downloaded, checked, and placed in runtime\\
as <name>.exe.new together with a pending marker. The launcher swaps it in on
the next start, before anything holds the file open (old -> .old, new -> live),
and deletes the .old leftovers after the app has stayed up for a minute.

Python itself is NOT updated here: the frozen app bundles its own interpreter,
so it only changes with a full app update.

status() and update() are plain blocking functions meant to run on a worker
thread. update() never raises; it returns {"ok": bool, "message": str}.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from logging_setup import log

FFMPEG_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/latest"
DENO_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/denoland/deno/releases/latest"
FFMPEG_ZIP_RE = re.compile(r"^ffmpeg-n(\d+\.\d+)-latest-win64-gpl-(\d+\.\d+)\.zip$")
DENO_ZIP = "deno-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
PENDING_FILE = "components-pending.json"
COMPONENTS = ("ffmpeg", "deno")
# component -> files it owns inside runtime\
FILES = {"ffmpeg": ("ffmpeg.exe", "ffprobe.exe"), "deno": ("deno.exe",)}
_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _runtime_dir():
    rt = os.environ.get("VG_RUNTIME", "")
    return Path(rt) if rt and Path(rt).is_dir() else None


def _staging_dir(name):
    base = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or str(Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local")
    return Path(base) / "VideoGrabber" / "components" / name


def _get_json(url):
    req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "VideoGrabber-Updater",
                                "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
    with urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))


def _get_text(url):
    req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "VideoGrabber-Updater"})
    with urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        return r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")


def _vtuple(s):
    return tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", s or "")[:3])


def _exe_path(name):
    rt = _runtime_dir()
    if rt is not None and (rt / FILES[name][0]).is_file():
        return rt / FILES[name][0]
    return None


def installed_version(name):
    """Version string of the runtime's binary, '' when not found/unreadable."""
    exe = _exe_path(name)
    if exe is None:
        return ""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([str(exe), "-version" if name == "ffmpeg" else "--version"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20,
                           creationflags=_NO_WINDOW)
        out = (r.stdout or r.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()
        first = out[0] if out else ""
        m = re.search(r"version\s+n?(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)", first) if name == "ffmpeg" \
            else re.search(r"deno\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)", first)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
        m = re.search(r"version\s+(\S+)", first)      # git builds: N-12345-gabc
        return m.group(1) if m else first[:40]
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"components: couldn't read {name} version: {e}")
        return ""


def pending():
    rt = _runtime_dir()
    if rt is None:
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads((rt / PENDING_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- latest
def latest_ffmpeg():
    """Newest stable-branch win64 GPL build from BtbN. Returns
    {version, url, sha256, name}. Stable branches (n7.1, n8.0, ...) are used
    because their version numbers can be compared with the installed one."""
    rel = _get_json(FFMPEG_API)
    best = None
    for a in rel.get("assets") or []:
        m = FFMPEG_ZIP_RE.match(a.get("name") or "")
        if m and (best is None or _vtuple(m.group(2)) > _vtuple(best[0])):
            best = (m.group(2), a)
    if best is None:
        raise RuntimeError("no versioned ffmpeg win64 build in the latest BtbN release")
    ver, asset = best
    sha = (asset.get("digest") or "").replace("sha256:", "")
    if not sha:
        for a in rel.get("assets") or []:
            if (a.get("name") or "").lower() == "checksums.sha256":
                for line in _get_text(a["browser_download_url"]).splitlines():
                    parts = line.split()
                    if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[-1].lstrip("*") == asset["name"]:
                        sha = parts[0]
                        break
    return {"version": ver, "url": asset["browser_download_url"],
            "sha256": sha.lower(), "name": asset["name"]}


def latest_deno():
    rel = _get_json(DENO_API)
    tag = (rel.get("tag_name") or "").lstrip("v")
    asset = next((a for a in rel.get("assets") or [] if a.get("name") == DENO_ZIP), None)
    if not tag or asset is None:
        raise RuntimeError("no win64 deno zip in the latest release")
    sha = (asset.get("digest") or "").replace("sha256:", "")
    if not sha:
        side = next((a for a in rel.get("assets") or []
                     if a.get("name") == DENO_ZIP + ".sha256sum"), None)
        if side:
            sha = (_get_text(side["browser_download_url"]).split() or [""])[0]
    return {"version": tag, "url": asset["browser_download_url"],
            "sha256": sha.lower(), "name": DENO_ZIP}


_LATEST = {"ffmpeg": latest_ffmpeg, "deno": latest_deno}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- status
def status():
    """{name: {installed, latest, update_available, pending, error}} plus
    'frozen_only' when this isn't the installed exe."""
    out = {"frozen_only": not (getattr(sys, "frozen", False) and _runtime_dir() is not None)}
    pend = pending()
    for name in COMPONENTS:
        d = {"installed": installed_version(name), "latest": "", "update_available": False,
             "pending": (pend.get(name) or {}).get("version", ""), "error": ""}
        try:
            d["latest"] = _LATEST[name]()["version"]
            inst = _vtuple(d["installed"])
            d["update_available"] = (bool(inst) and _vtuple(d["latest"]) > inst
                                     and d["latest"] != d["pending"])
        except Exception as e:
            d["error"] = str(e)
            log(f"components: {name} version check failed: {e}")
        out[name] = d
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- update
def _download(url, dest, expect_sha):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "VideoGrabber-Updater"})
    with urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r, open(dest, "wb") as f:
        while True:
            chunk = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not chunk:
                break
            h.update(chunk)
            f.write(chunk)
    got = h.hexdigest().lower()
    if expect_sha:
        if got != expect_sha:
            raise RuntimeError(f"checksum mismatch (expected {expect_sha[:12]}..., got {got[:12]}...)")
        log(f"components: sha256 verified for {Path(dest).name}")
    else:
        log("components: no published checksum, falling back to a run check only")


def _extract(zip_path, wanted, dest_dir):
    """Pull the wanted file names out of the zip (any folder depth), with a
    path check; returns {name: Path}."""
    found = {}
    dest_real = dest_dir.resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
        for m in zf.infolist():
            base = Path(m.filename).name
            if m.is_dir() or base.lower() not in wanted:
                continue
            target = (dest_dir / base).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(dest_real):
                raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe path in zip: {m.filename}")
            with zf.open(m) as src, open(target, "wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
            found[base.lower()] = target
    missing = [w for w in wanted if w not in found]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("zip is missing " + ", ".join(missing))
    return found


def _verify_runs(name, exe, version):
    r = subprocess.run([str(exe), "-version" if name == "ffmpeg" else "--version"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, creationflags=_NO_WINDOW)
    out = (r.stdout or r.stderr or "")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{exe.name} failed its self-check (exit {r.returncode})")
    if name == "deno" and version not in out:
        raise RuntimeError(f"downloaded deno reports a different version than {version}")


def update(name):
    """Download, verify and stage one component. Applies on next launch."""
    try:
        if name not in COMPONENTS:
            raise RuntimeError(f"unknown component {name}")
        rt = _runtime_dir()
        if not getattr(sys, "frozen", False) or rt is None:
            raise RuntimeError("updates only apply to the installed exe, not a source run")
        info = _LATEST[name]()
        stage = _staging_dir(name)
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        stage.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log(f"components: downloading {name} {info['version']} from {info['url']}")
        zip_path = stage / "pkg.zip"
        _download(info["url"], zip_path, info["sha256"])
        wanted = [f.lower() for f in FILES[name]]
        extracted = _extract(zip_path, wanted, stage)
        for exe_name, exe in extracted.items():
            _verify_runs(name if exe_name == FILES[name][0] else "ffmpeg", exe, info["version"])
        # Verified: place beside the live files as <name>.new.
        for exe_name, exe in extracted.items():
            dest = rt / (exe_name + ".new")
            shutil.copy2(exe, dest)
            if dest.stat().st_size != exe.stat().st_size:
                raise RuntimeError(f"copy to {dest.name} was incomplete")
        marker = pending()
        marker[name] = {"version": info["version"], "files": list(FILES[name])}
        (rt / PENDING_FILE).write_text(json.dumps(marker, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
        log(f"components: {name} {info['version']} staged; applies on next launch")
        return {"ok": True, "message": f"{name} {info['version']} is ready. "
                                       "It applies the next time Video Grabber starts."}
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"components: {name} update failed: {e}")
        return {"ok": False, "message": f"{name} update failed: {e}"}

# Keep ffmpeg / Defender from flashing console windows when frozen on Windows.
_CREATE_NO_WINDOW = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == "win32" else 0


def _try_transition(job, event):
    """transition() for worker threads: an illegal transition (e.g. the API
    already moved the job to stopped/paused while the worker was finishing)
    is logged and returns False instead of raising out of the thread and
    skipping the cleanup after it."""
    try:
        transition(job, event)
        return True
    except ValueError as e:
        log(f"job {job.get('id')}: {e} (ignored)")
        return False


class _RestartFromZero(Exception):
    """Raised inside _run_generic_single when the server answers 416 and the
    .part file is not the whole file: discard it and start over."""
