DARK_LUM = 0.06   # a case body darker than this gets the dark-theme bevels


def _lin(v):
    v /= 255.0
    return v / 12.92 if v <= 0.04045 else ((v + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4


def _luminance(c):
    return 0.2126 * _lin(c.red()) + 0.7152 * _lin(c.green()) + 0.0722 * _lin(c.blue())


COLUMN = 210   # width of the controls column


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dark title bars (Windows). The native title bar is drawn by Windows, so it
# stays white unless each top-level window opts in to the immersive dark mode
# through DWM. No custom frameless title bar: the standard one just goes dark.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def apply_dark_titlebar(widget, dark=True):
    """Switch one top-level window's native title bar to dark (or back to
    light). Returns True when Windows accepted it. A no-op off Windows."""
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        return False
    try:
        import ctypes
        hwnd = ctypes.c_void_p(int(widget.winId()))
        val = ctypes.c_int(1 if dark else 0)
        dwm = ctypes.windll.dwmapi
        ok = False
        # DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE is 20 on Windows 10 2004+ and 11,
        # and 19 on the older Windows 10 builds that had it.
        for attr in (20, 19):
            if dwm.DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, attr, ctypes.byref(val), ctypes.sizeof(val)) == 0:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            # Repaint the frame so the change shows without a focus change.
            SWP = 0x0002 | 0x0001 | 0x0004 | 0x0020 | 0x0010   # NOMOVE|NOSIZE|NOZORDER|FRAMECHANGED|NOACTIVATE
            ctypes.windll.user32.SetWindowPos(hwnd, None, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP)
        return ok
    except Exception:
        return False


class DarkTitleBarFilter(QObject):
    """Application-wide event filter: every normal top-level window (main
    window, dialogs, message boxes) gets the title bar matching the theme the
    moment it is shown. `dark_fn()` says whether the current theme is dark."""

    def __init__(self, dark_fn, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._dark_fn = dark_fn

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):
        if event.type() == QEvent.Show and isinstance(obj, QWidget) and obj.isWindow():
            try:
                flags = obj.windowFlags()
                if (obj.windowType() in (Qt.Window, Qt.Dialog)
                        and not (flags & Qt.FramelessWindowHint)):
                    apply_dark_titlebar(obj, bool(self._dark_fn()))
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False

    def refresh(self):
        """Re-apply to every open window (theme changed light <-> dark)."""
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
        for w in QApplication.topLevelWidgets():
            if w.isVisible() and w.windowType() in (Qt.Window, Qt.Dialog) \
                    and not (w.windowFlags() & Qt.FramelessWindowHint):
                apply_dark_titlebar(w, bool(self._dark_fn()))


class _Backlight(QWidget):
    """Sits over the screen. With the backlight off it tints the content
    green-grey, dims it and darkens the corners. Never takes mouse input."""

    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_NoSystemBackground)
        self.dim = False

    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        if not self.dim:
            return
        p = QPainter(self)
        r = self.rect()
        p.setCompositionMode(QPainter.CompositionMode_Multiply)
        p.fillRect(r, QColor(150, 188, 150))
        p.setCompositionMode(QPainter.CompositionMode_SourceOver)
        rg = QRadialGradient(QPointF(r.center()), max(r.width(), r.height()) * 0.75)
        rg.setColorAt(0.55, QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
        rg.setColorAt(1, QColor(0, 0, 0, 120))
        p.fillRect(r, rg)
        p.end()


class ShellFrame(QWidget):
    dpad = Signal(str)      # "up" "down" "left" "right"
    button = Signal(str)    # "a" "b" "select" "start"

    def __init__(self, inner, color="cream", parent=None, backlight=True,
                 overrides=None, theme=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.inner = inner
        self.color = color if color in SHELLS else "cream"
        self.overrides = dict(overrides) if isinstance(overrides, dict) else {}
        # Speaker dots follow the APP theme accent, not the shell.
        self._accent = QColor(resolve_palette(theme)["accent"])
        if not self._accent.isValid():
            self._accent = QColor("#8ccf72")
        self._hits = {}
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        lay = QHBoxLayout(self)
        lay.setContentsMargins(38, 62, COLUMN + 12, 40)
        lay.addWidget(inner)
        # Freely resizable: the case stretches with the window, the inner screen
        # takes all the extra room, and the controls column scales down on
        # short windows (see paintEvent) instead of forcing a big minimum.
        self.setMinimumSize(760, 520)
        self.backlight = bool(backlight)
        self.overlay = _Backlight(self)
        self.overlay.dim = not self.backlight
        self.overlay.setVisible(not self.backlight)
        inner.installEventFilter(self)

    def set_color(self, color):
        self.color = color if color in SHELLS else "cream"
        self.update()

    def set_overrides(self, overrides):
        """Per-part colors, e.g. {"dpad": "#3a0808"}. Empty values mean 'no override'."""
        self.overrides = dict(overrides) if isinstance(overrides, dict) else {}
        self.update()

    def _col(self, key):
        """Override first, then the shell's own value, then the built-in default."""
        for src in (self.overrides, SHELLS[self.color], _CONTROLS):
            v = src.get(key)
            if v:
                c = QColor(v)
                if c.isValid():
                    return c
        return QColor("#000000")

    def set_backlight(self, on):
        """Backlight off = dim green screen. The power light stays lit."""
        self.backlight = bool(on)
        self.overlay.dim = not self.backlight
        self.overlay.setVisible(not self.backlight)
        self._sync_overlay()
        self.overlay.update()
        self.update()

    def _sync_overlay(self):
        self.overlay.setGeometry(self.inner.geometry())
        self.overlay.raise_()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, e):
        if obj is self.inner and e.type() in (QEvent.Resize, QEvent.Move, QEvent.Show):
            self._sync_overlay()
        return super().eventFilter(obj, e)

    def showEvent(self, e):
        super().showEvent(e)
        self._sync_overlay()

    # ---- painting ----
    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        top, body, bot, edge = (self._col(k) for k in ("top", "body", "bottom", "edge"))
        dark = _luminance(body) < DARK_LUM
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        w, h = self.width(), self.height()
        body_r = QRectF(4, 14, w - 8, h - 22)
        g = QLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
        g.setColorAt(0, top)
        g.setColorAt(0.35, body)
        g.setColorAt(1, bot)
        p.setPen(QPen(edge, 2))
        p.setBrush(g)
        p.drawRoundedRect(body_r, 26, 26)
        # rounded edge: light along the top lip, shade along the bottom
        rim = QLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
        rim.setColorAt(0, QColor(255, 255, 255, 120 if not dark else 40))
        rim.setColorAt(0.45, QColor(255, 255, 255, 0))
        rim.setColorAt(0.8, QColor(0, 0, 0, 0))
        rim.setColorAt(1, QColor(0, 0, 0, 70))
        p.setPen(QPen(QBrush(rim), 2))
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.drawRoundedRect(body_r.adjusted(3, 3, -3, -3), 23, 23)
        # hinge strip with two raised, rounded barrels
        hinge_c = top.darker(106) if not dark else top.lighter(115)

        def barrel(rect, rad):
            gb = QLinearGradient(0, rect.top(), 0, rect.bottom())
            gb.setColorAt(0, hinge_c.lighter(112))
            gb.setColorAt(0.45, hinge_c)
            gb.setColorAt(1, hinge_c.darker(118))
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 60))
            p.drawRoundedRect(rect.translated(0, 2), rad, rad)
            p.setPen(QPen(edge, 1.5))
            p.setBrush(gb)
            p.drawRoundedRect(rect, rad, rad)
            p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 80 if not dark else 30), 1.2))
            p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
            p.drawRoundedRect(rect.adjusted(2, 2, -2, -2), rad - 2, rad - 2)

        barrel(QRectF(4, 14, w - 8, 26), 14)
        for x in (70, w - 220):
            barrel(QRectF(x, 2, 150, 24), 9)
        # screen bezel behind the inner widget: sunk into the body
        r = self.inner.geometry().adjusted(-12, -12, 12, 12)
        bez = QPainterPath()
        bez.addRoundedRect(QRectF(r), 16, 16)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 110 if not dark else 40), 1.5))
        p.drawPath(bez.translated(0, 1.5))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(self._col("bezel"))
        p.drawPath(bez)
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(bez)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 140), 4))
        p.drawPath(bez.translated(0, 3))
        p.restore()
        # Controls are laid out for a ~640 px tall case; on shorter windows
        # draw them scaled down (0.7 floor) and scale the hit boxes to match.
        k = max(0.7, min(1.0, h / 640.0))
        if k < 1.0:
            p.save()
            p.scale(k, k)
            self._controls(p, w / k, h / k, dark)
            p.restore()
            self._hits = {n: QRectF(r.x() * k, r.y() * k, r.width() * k, r.height() * k)
                          for n, r in self._hits.items()}
        else:
            self._controls(p, w, h, dark)
        p.end()

    def _well(self, p, c, r, body, edge, dark):
        """Recessed circular socket: shadowed at the top lip, catch-light at the bottom."""
        rect = QRectF(c.x() - r, c.y() - r, 2 * r, 2 * r)
        g = QLinearGradient(0, c.y() - r, 0, c.y() + r)
        g.setColorAt(0, body.darker(140 if not dark else 180))
        g.setColorAt(1, body.lighter(108 if not dark else 130))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(g)
        p.drawEllipse(rect)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        # inner shadow along the top edge
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 70), 3))
        p.drawArc(rect.adjusted(1.5, 1.5, -1.5, -1.5), 20 * 16, 140 * 16)
        # catch-light just outside the bottom edge
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 150 if not dark else 45), 1.5))
        p.drawArc(rect.adjusted(-1, -1, 1, 1), 200 * 16, 140 * 16)
        ec = QColor(edge)
        ec.setAlpha(120)
        p.setPen(QPen(ec, 1))
        p.drawEllipse(rect)

    @staticmethod
    def _xpath(cx, cy, w, h, ang):
        """Rounded capsule of w x h centred on (cx, cy), rotated by ang degrees."""
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.addRoundedRect(QRectF(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h), h / 2, h / 2)
        t = QTransform()
        t.translate(cx, cy)
        t.rotate(ang)
        return t.map(path)

    def _well_path(self, p, path, body, edge, dark):
        """Recessed socket of any shape: catch-light under the bottom lip, shadow inside the top."""
        r = path.boundingRect()
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 150 if not dark else 45), 1.5))
        p.drawPath(path.translated(0, 1.2))
        g = QLinearGradient(0, r.top(), 0, r.bottom())
        g.setColorAt(0, body.darker(140 if not dark else 180))
        g.setColorAt(1, body.lighter(108 if not dark else 130))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(g)
        p.drawPath(path)
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(path)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 70), 3))
        p.drawPath(path.translated(0, 2.5))
        p.restore()
        ec = QColor(edge)
        ec.setAlpha(120)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(ec, 1))
        p.drawPath(path)

    def _raised(self, p, path, top_c, bot_c, line, shadow=90, lit=60):
        """Raised key: drop shadow, vertical gradient, light top edge, dark bottom edge."""
        r = path.boundingRect()
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, shadow))
        p.drawPath(path.translated(0, 3))
        g = QLinearGradient(0, r.top(), 0, r.bottom())
        g.setColorAt(0, top_c)
        g.setColorAt(1, bot_c)
        p.setPen(QPen(line, 1))
        p.setBrush(g)
        p.drawPath(path)
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(path)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, lit), 2))
        p.drawPath(path.translated(0, 2))
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 90), 2))
        p.drawPath(path.translated(0, -2))
        p.restore()

    def _controls(self, p, w, h, dark):
        cx = w - COLUMN / 2 - 4
        body, edge = self._col("body"), self._col("edge")
        ctl, ctl_hi = self._col("dpad"), self._col("dpad_hi")
        label = self._col("button_labels")
        led_c = self._col("power_led")
        self._hits = {}
        # power light
        led = QPointF(w - 44, 74)
        halo = QRadialGradient(led, 18)
        halo_c = QColor(led_c)
        halo_c.setAlpha(120)
        halo.setColorAt(0, halo_c)
        halo_c.setAlpha(0)
        halo.setColorAt(1, halo_c)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        if self.backlight:
            p.setBrush(halo)
            p.drawEllipse(led, 18, 18)
        lg = QRadialGradient(QPointF(led.x() - 2, led.y() - 3), 10)
        lg.setColorAt(0, led_c.lighter(175))
        lg.setColorAt(0.5, led_c)
        lg.setColorAt(1, led_c.darker(170))
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 90), 1))
        p.setBrush(lg)
        p.drawEllipse(led, 8, 8)
        f = p.font(); f.setPixelSize(10); f.setLetterSpacing(QFont.SpacingType.AbsoluteSpacing, 1.4); p.setFont(f)
        p.setPen(label)
        p.drawText(QRectF(w - 130, 64, 70, 20), Qt.AlignRight | Qt.AlignVCenter, "POWER")
        self._hits["power"] = QRectF(w - 134, 58, 106, 32)   # click: backlight on/off
        # d-pad: recessed well, raised cross
        dy = max(190, h * 0.30)
        arm, ln, well_r = 40, 120, 74
        self._well(p, QPointF(cx, dy), well_r, body, edge, dark)
        cross = QPainterPath()
        cross.addRoundedRect(QRectF(cx - ln / 2, dy - arm / 2, ln, arm), 10, 10)
        cross.addRoundedRect(QRectF(cx - arm / 2, dy - ln / 2, arm, ln), 10, 10)
        cross.setFillRule(Qt.WindingFill)   # odd-even would punch a hole where the arms cross
        cross = cross.simplified()
        # shadow the cross casts into the well
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 90))
        p.drawPath(cross.translated(0, 3))
        # cross body
        gr = QLinearGradient(0, dy - ln / 2, 0, dy + ln / 2)
        gr.setColorAt(0, ctl_hi)
        gr.setColorAt(0.5, ctl)
        gr.setColorAt(1, ctl.darker(130))
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor("#000"), 1))
        p.setBrush(gr)
        p.drawPath(cross)
        # bevel: light along the top edges, dark along the bottom edges
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(cross)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 60), 2))
        p.drawPath(cross.translated(0, 2))
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 110), 2))
        p.drawPath(cross.translated(0, -2))
        p.restore()
        # engraved arrows + hit areas
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        for name, (ox, oy) in {"up": (0, -1), "down": (0, 1), "left": (-1, 0), "right": (1, 0)}.items():
            c = QPointF(cx + ox * 40, dy + oy * 40)
            sz = 6
            tip = QPointF(c.x() + ox * sz, c.y() + oy * sz)
            b1 = QPointF(c.x() - ox * sz * 0.6 - oy * sz, c.y() - oy * sz * 0.6 + ox * sz)
            b2 = QPointF(c.x() - ox * sz * 0.6 + oy * sz, c.y() - oy * sz * 0.6 - ox * sz)
            tri = QPolygonF([tip, b1, b2])
            p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 45))
            p.drawPolygon(tri.translated(QPointF(0, 1)))
            p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 170))
            p.drawPolygon(tri)
            self._hits[name] = QRectF(c.x() - 20, c.y() - 20, 40, 40)
        # centre dimple
        rg = QRadialGradient(QPointF(cx, dy + 2), 11)
        rg.setColorAt(0, ctl.darker(160))
        rg.setColorAt(1, ctl.lighter(115))
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 40), 1))
        p.setBrush(rg)
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(cx, dy), 9, 9)
        # A / B: one diagonal recessed track, two raised round keys
        ay = max(340, h * 0.55)
        track = self._xpath(cx + 9, ay - 4, 160, 76, -26)
        self._well_path(p, track, body, edge, dark)
        for name, (x, y) in {"a": (cx + 46, ay - 22), "b": (cx - 28, ay + 14)}.items():
            key = QPainterPath()
            key.addEllipse(QPointF(x, y), 30, 30)
            self._raised(p, key, ctl_hi, ctl, QColor("#000"))
            f2 = p.font(); f2.setPixelSize(22); f2.setBold(True); f2.setLetterSpacing(QFont.SpacingType.AbsoluteSpacing, 0); p.setFont(f2)
            box = QRectF(x - 30, y - 30, 60, 60)
            letter = QColor(label)
            if abs(_luminance(letter) - _luminance(ctl_hi)) < 0.10:
                # labels tuned for the case would vanish on the key: lift or sink them
                letter = letter.lighter(260) if _luminance(ctl) < 0.3 else letter.darker(300)
            p.setPen(QColor(0, 0, 0, 170))
            p.drawText(box.translated(0, 1), Qt.AlignCenter, name.upper())
            p.setPen(letter)
            p.drawText(box, Qt.AlignCenter, name.upper())
            self._hits[name] = box
        # speaker dots
        sy = max(450, h * 0.72)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        hole = body.darker(160) if not dark else QColor("#0b0c0c")
        dot = QColor(self._accent)
        dot.setAlpha(235)
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                c = QPointF(cx + 10 + i * 14 + j * 6, sy + j * 12 - i * 5)
                p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 110 if not dark else 35))
                p.drawEllipse(c + QPointF(0.6, 1.2), 3.6, 3.6)
                p.setBrush(hole)
                p.drawEllipse(c, 3.6, 3.6)
                p.setBrush(dot)
                p.drawEllipse(c, 2.6, 2.6)
        # select / start: raised pills in recessed slots
        by = h - 70
        f3 = p.font(); f3.setPixelSize(10); f3.setBold(False); f3.setLetterSpacing(QFont.SpacingType.AbsoluteSpacing, 1.4); p.setFont(f3)
        pill = self._col("select_start")
        if dark:
            pill_top, pill_bot, pill_line = pill.lighter(115), pill.darker(120), QColor("#000")
        else:
            pill_top, pill_bot, pill_line = pill.lighter(108), pill.darker(108), pill.darker(140)
        for name, x in (("select", cx - 38), ("start", cx + 38)):
            self._well_path(p, self._xpath(x, by, 62, 24, -22), body, edge, dark)
            self._raised(p, self._xpath(x, by, 48, 16, -22), pill_top, pill_bot, pill_line, shadow=80, lit=110)
            p.setPen(label)
            p.drawText(QRectF(x - 40, by + 22, 80, 16), Qt.AlignCenter, name.upper())
            self._hits[name] = QRectF(x - 28, by - 14, 56, 28)

    # ---- input ----
    def _hit(self, pos):
        for name, r in self._hits.items():
            if r.contains(pos):
                return name
        return None

    def mousePressEvent(self, e):
        name = self._hit(e.position())
        if name is None:
            return super().mousePressEvent(e)
        if name in ("up", "down", "left", "right"):
            self.dpad.emit(name)
        else:
            self.button.emit(name)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e):
        self.setCursor(QCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor if self._hit(e.position()) else Qt.ArrowCursor))
        super().mouseMoveEvent(e)
"""QSS generation from the palette. Applied app-wide (launch_gui and after
every Settings save), so the main window, dialogs and settings all follow
the same tokens. Nothing in here should hardcode a color."""
from palette import resolve_palette, mix, contrast, luminance, scale_px, zoom_factor


def _shade(hexc, f):
    """Lighten (f > 0) or darken (f < 0) a #rrggbb color by that fraction.
    Anything that is not plain #rrggbb is returned unchanged."""
    h = str(hexc).lstrip("#")
    if len(h) != 6:
        return hexc
    try:
        r, g, b = (int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
    except ValueError:
        return hexc
    t, a = (255, f) if f > 0 else (0, -f)
    r, g, b = (round(c + (t - c) * a) for c in (r, g, b))
    return f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}"


def build_qss(settings_state=None, override_tokens=None):
    p = resolve_palette(settings_state)
    if override_tokens:
        p.update(override_tokens)
    # v5.5 layout layer: padding is scaled by the preset's density token and
    # corner radii come from the radius tokens. At the default preset every
    # value is identical to the old hardcoded one.
    # Batch 2 true global zoom: General > Text size is a zoom factor for the
    # fonts AND for paddings, margins, radii and control sizes, applied on top
    # of the preset's own density (pad_scale).
    _zoom = zoom_factor(settings_state)
    _ps = float(p.get("pad_scale", 1.0) or 1.0) * _zoom
    _rs = scale_px(p.get("radius_sm", "6px"), _zoom)
    _rc = scale_px(p.get("radius_chip", "10px"), _zoom)
    _rad = scale_px(p.get("radius", "10px"), _zoom)

    def _z(n):
        return max(1, round(n * _zoom))

    def pad(*v):
        return " ".join((f"{round(n * _ps)}px" if round(n * _ps) > 0 else "0") for n in v)

    # v5.5 text size (General): every font size below is scaled; the base
    # font is only set when the size isn't 100%, so 100% looks as before.
    # Fonts follow the zoom and the preset's font_scale (Compact is small).
    try:
        _fm = max(0.5, min(2.0, float(p.get("font_scale", 1.0) or 1.0)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        _fm = 1.0
    _ts = _zoom * _fm

    def fs(px):
        return max(8, round(px * _ts))

    # Disabled text: the faint token pushed toward the background, so it still
    # reads as disabled next to the lifted (AA) secondary text.
    _dis = mix(p["text_dim"], p["bg_base"], 0.25)

    # Only set a base size when scaled (Qt's default is 9pt).
    _base_font = "" if abs(_ts - 1.0) < 0.01 else f"\n    font-size: {10 * _ts:.1f}pt;"

    # Batch 2: "App Font" (General) overrides the preset's font stack.
    _app_font = str((settings_state or {}).get("app_font") or "").replace('"', "").strip()
    _family = f'"{_app_font}", {p["font"]}' if _app_font else p["font"]
    _wt = str(p.get("font_weight") or "normal").strip().lower()
    _weight = "" if _wt in ("", "normal", "400") else f"\n    font-weight: {_wt};"
    # Preset border thickness (Classic LCD and High Contrast are thick).
    # Batch 3: the floor is 0, not 1 — Glass sets border_w=0 and means it
    # (the old `or 1` also turned an explicit 0 back into 1).
    try:
        _bwv = p.get("border_w", 1)
        _bwn = max(0, min(6, int(round(float(1 if _bwv is None else _bwv)))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        _bwn = 1
    _bw = f"{_bwn}px"
    # Batch 3: a preset may carry border_soft (Glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.1))
    # — a faint 1px line used INSTEAD of the _bw border on the panel
    # surfaces and the download table, so a borderless preset's lighter
    # panels still read as separate sheets. Qt's QSS parser takes the CSS
    # rgba() form as-is. Empty for every other preset, where _panel_border
    # and _hdr_border expand to exactly what those rules said before.
    _soft = str(p.get("border_soft") or "").strip()
    _panel_border = f"1px solid {_soft}" if _soft else f"{_bw} solid {p['border']}"
    _hdr_border = f"1px solid {_soft}" if _soft else f"1px solid {p['border']}"
    # A borderless preset still needs a visible keyboard focus ring.
    _bw_focus = _bw if _bwn else "1px"
    _ind = _z(16)       # checkbox / radio indicator size
    _sb = _z(10)        # scrollbar thickness

    qss = f"""
QMainWindow, QWidget {{
    background: {p['bg_base']};
    color: {p['text']};
    font-family: {_family};{_weight}{_base_font}
}}
QLabel {{ background: transparent; }}
QWidget#Plain {{ background: transparent; }}
QDialog {{ background: {p['bg_panel']}; }}
QScrollArea {{ background: transparent; border: 0; }}
QToolTip {{
    background: {p['bg_elevated']}; color: {p['text']};
    border: {_bw} solid {p['border_hi']}; padding: {pad(6, 8)};
}}

/* ---- menus ---- */
QMenuBar {{ background: {p['bg_panel']}; color: {p['text_muted']}; padding: {pad(3, 8)};
    border-bottom: 1px solid {p['border']}; }}
QMenuBar::item {{ padding: {pad(6, 12)}; background: transparent; }}
QMenuBar::item:selected {{ background: {p['bg_hover']}; color: {p['text']}; border-radius: {_rs}; }}
QMenu {{ background: {p['bg_elevated']}; border: {_bw} solid {p['border_hi']};
    border-radius: {_rad}; padding: {pad(6)}; }}
QMenu::item {{ padding: {pad(8, 26, 8, 12)}; border-radius: {_rs}; }}
QMenu::item:selected {{ background: {p['bg_sel']}; }}
QMenu::separator {{ height: 1px; background: {p['border']}; margin: {pad(6, 8)}; }}

/* ---- toolbar ---- */
#Toolbar {{ background: {p['bg_panel']}; border-bottom: 1px solid {p['border']}; }}
#ToolbarTitle {{ font-size: {fs(16)}px; font-weight: 600; }}
#ToolbarButton {{
    background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: {_rad}; padding: {pad(8, 11)}; color: {p['text_soft']};
}}
#ToolbarButton:hover {{ background: {p['bg_hover']}; border-color: {p['border_hi']}; color: {p['text']}; }}
#ToolbarButton:pressed {{ background: {p['bg_sel']}; }}
#Search {{
    background: {p['bg_input']}; border: {_bw} solid {p['border']};
    border-top: 2px solid {_shade(p['bg_input'], -0.4)};
    border-radius: {_rad}; padding: {pad(7, 12, 8, 12)}; min-width: {_z(200)}px;
}}
#Search:focus {{ border-color: {p['accent']}; }}

/* ---- sidebar ---- */
#Sidebar {{ background: {p['bg_side']}; border-right: 1px solid {p['border']}; }}
#Brand {{ font-size: {fs(12)}px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: {p['text']}; }}
#SectionLabel {{ color: {p['text_dim']}; font-size: {fs(10)}px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.4px; }}
#SidebarSeparator {{ color: {p['border']}; background: {p['border']}; max-height: 1px; }}
QToolButton[nav="true"] {{
    text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0;
    border-radius: {_rad}; color: {p['text_soft']}; padding: {pad(0, 10)};
}}
QToolButton[nav="true"]:hover {{ background: {p['bg_hover']}; color: {p['text']}; }}
QToolButton[nav="true"][active="true"] {{ background: {p['bg_sel']}; color: {p['text']}; font-weight: 600; }}

/* ---- download table ---- */
QTableView {{
    background: {p['bg_panel']};
    alternate-background-color: {p['bg_base']};
    border: {_panel_border};
    border-radius: {_rad};
    gridline-color: {p['border']};
    selection-background-color: {p['bg_sel']};
    selection-color: {p['text']};
    outline: 0;
}}
QTableView::item {{ border: 0; padding: {pad(7, 8)}; }}
QTableView::item:hover {{ background: {p['bg_hover']}; }}
QTableView::item:selected {{ background: {p['bg_sel']}; }}
QHeaderView::section {{

    if (settings_state or {}).get("frame_cream"):
        qss += _cream_frame_qss(p, _zoom)
    return qss


def _cream_frame_qss(p, zoom=1.0):
    """Window frame (toolbar, menu bar, status bar, margins) around the
    theme's dark panels, painted in the palette's "frame" token (cream by
    default). Scoped to the main window's own widgets so dialogs keep the
    normal theme. Highlight, edge and text colors are derived from the token,
    so one color picker drives all of them."""
    fb = p["frame"]
    _ps = float(p.get("pad_scale", 1.0) or 1.0) * zoom    # v5.5 density token, times the Batch 2 zoom
    _rad = scale_px(p.get("radius", "10px"), zoom)

    def pad(*v):
        return " ".join((f"{round(n * _ps)}px" if round(n * _ps) > 0 else "0") for n in v)

    fh = mix(fb, "#ffffff", 0.35)          # light top / hover
    fe = mix(fb, "#000000", 0.22)          # edges
    fd = mix(fb, "#000000", 0.34)          # bottom bevel
    ft = p["bg_base"] if contrast(fb, p["bg_base"]) >= 4.5 else (
        "#000000" if luminance(fb) > 0.4 else "#ffffff")
    fm = mix(ft, fb, 0.35)                 # secondary text
    for _t in (0.3, 0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05, 0.0):   # v5.5: keep it AA (4.5:1) on the frame
        if contrast(fm, fb) >= 4.5:
            break
        fm = mix(ft, fb, _t)
    return f"""
/* ---- cream frame ---- */
QMainWindow, #MainRoot, #FrameArea, #Content {{ background: {fb}; }}
QMenuBar {{ background: {fh}; color: {ft}; border-bottom: 1px solid {fe}; }}
QMenuBar::item:selected {{ background: {fb}; color: {ft}; }}
#Toolbar {{ background: {fb}; border-bottom: 1px solid {fe}; }}
#ToolbarTitle {{ color: {ft}; }}
#ToolbarButton {{
    color: {ft};
    background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:0, y2:1, stop:0 {fh}, stop:1 {fb});
    border: 1px solid {fe}; border-bottom: 2px solid {fd};
    border-radius: {_rad}; padding: {pad(8, 11, 7, 11)};
}}
#ToolbarButton:hover {{ background: {fh}; border-color: {fd}; color: {ft}; }}
#ToolbarButton:pressed {{ background: {fe}; border-bottom: 1px solid {fd}; }}
#Content #SectionLabel {{ color: {fm}; }}
QStatusBar, #BottomStatus {{ background: {fb}; color: {ft}; border-top: 1px solid {fe}; }}
QStatusBar QLabel {{ color: {ft}; }}
"""
"""Theme Engine: build a theme from an image or by picking colors, with a
live preview in the running app.

The dialog never writes settings. It emits themeChanged(state), where state
is the full settings dict (saved settings plus the theme being edited), and
the host applies it with gui_style.build_qss. The only files it writes are
HOME/themes/<name>.json, in the Export format that
gui_theme_page._theme_from_dict reads back, so the Theme tab shows them.
Saving emits themeSaved(path) so the host can refresh its theme list at once.

Pillow is optional. With it, colors come from Pillow's quantizer; without it
the same step runs on Qt's own image reader and a built-in median cut, so the
drop zone always works.

The image step: drop an image on the zone at the top (or click it to browse).
The dialog shows a thumbnail and the extracted swatches, and waits. The theme
only changes when you press Fill chips (smart: if the image has no strong
accent color, a complementary one is generated) or Scramble (shuffles the
colors across the chips). Undo steps back one Fill or Scramble.
"""
import json
import random
import re
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QImage, QImageReader, QPainter, QPixmap
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QColorDialog, QComboBox, QDialog, QFileDialog, QFrame, QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit, QMessageBox, QPushButton, QVBoxLayout, QWidget,
)

from gui_theme_page import ThemePage, _theme_from_dict
from palette import PRESET_NAMES, THEME_PRESETS, contrast, luminance, resolve_palette

try:
    from PIL import Image
except ImportError:          # Pillow missing: the rest of the dialog still works
    Image = None

# The seven chips. "accent" is saved as the top-level "accent", never inside
# theme_tokens, because the Theme tab drops it there.
CHIPS = (
    ("bg_base", "Background"),
    ("bg_panel", "Panel"),
    ("bg_elevated", "Elevated"),
    ("text", "Text"),
    ("text_muted", "Text muted"),
    ("accent", "Accent"),
    ("border", "Border"),
)
CHIP_KEYS = tuple(k for k, _ in CHIPS)
LOW_CONTRAST_CHIPS = ("text_muted",)   # each is checked against bg_base
MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST = 4.5                # WCAG AA for normal text
LIVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 75
DEFAULT_NAME = "My Theme"
MAX_NAME_LEN = 60
SMART_MIN_SAT = 0.35                   # best accent candidate below this is "not a real accent"
SMART_TINT_SAT = 0.12                  # below this a color has no usable hue (grayscale)
ACCENT_MIN_CONTRAST = 3.0              # a generated accent must stand out from the background
MUTED_MIN_CONTRAST = 3.0               # Scramble repairs text_muted below this
_RESERVED = {"con", "prn", "aux", "nul"} | {f"com{i}" for i in range(1, 10)} \
    | {f"lpt{i}" for i in range(1, 10)}
MAX_THEME_BYTES = 256 * 1024           # the Theme tab skips bigger files
EXTRACT_SIZE = (160, 160)              # thumbnail size; plenty for color stats
EXTRACT_COLORS = 5


def _image_exts():
    """Every picture extension we can read: Qt's image plugins, Pillow's
    registered formats when Pillow is there, and the common ones."""
    exts = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".bmp", ".gif", ".tif", ".tiff", ".ico"}
    exts |= {"." + bytes(f).decode("ascii", "ignore").lower()
             for f in QImageReader.supportedImageFormats()}
    if Image is not None:
        try:
            exts |= {e.lower() for e in Image.registered_extensions()}
        except Exception:
            pass
    return tuple(sorted(exts))


IMAGE_EXTS = _image_exts()
THUMB_MAX = 480                        # longest side the preview ever decodes


def _extract_colors_qt(path, count):
    """Pillow-free extraction: Qt reads and shrinks the image, then a median cut."""
    reader = QImageReader(path)
    reader.setAutoTransform(True)
    size = reader.size()
    if size.isValid():
        size.scale(*EXTRACT_SIZE, Qt.KeepAspectRatio)
        reader.setScaledSize(size)
    img = reader.read()
    if img.isNull():
        raise OSError(reader.errorString() or "unreadable image")
    img = img.convertToFormat(QImage.Format_RGB32)
    px = [(c.red(), c.green(), c.blue())
          for c in (QColor(img.pixel(x, y)) for y in range(img.height())
                    for x in range(img.width()))]
    def spread(box):
        return [max(p[i] for p in box) - min(p[i] for p in box) for i in range(3)]

    boxes = [px]
    while len(boxes) < count:
        # split the box with the widest color range (a flat box cannot be split)
        cand = [b for b in boxes if len(b) > 1 and max(spread(b)) > 0]
        if not cand:
            break
        box = max(cand, key=lambda b: max(spread(b)) * len(b) ** 0.5)
        rng = spread(box)
        ch = rng.index(max(rng))
        box.sort(key=lambda p: p[ch])
        mid = len(box) // 2
        i = next(k for k, b in enumerate(boxes) if b is box)
        boxes[i:i + 1] = [box[:mid], box[mid:]]
    out = []
    for box in sorted(boxes, key=len, reverse=True):
        n = len(box)
        hx = "#%02x%02x%02x" % tuple(sum(p[i] for p in box) // n for i in range(3))
        if hx not in out:
            out.append(hx)
    return out[:count]


def extract_colors(path, count=EXTRACT_COLORS):
    """Up to `count` dominant colors of an image as #rrggbb, most frequent
    first. Raises OSError or ValueError when the file is not a readable image."""
    if Image is None:
        return _extract_colors_qt(path, count)
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        im = im.convert("RGB")
        im.thumbnail(EXTRACT_SIZE)
        q = im.quantize(colors=count, method=Image.Quantize.MEDIANCUT)
    flat = q.getpalette() or []
    out = []
    for _n, idx in sorted(q.getcolors() or [], reverse=True):
        r, g, b = flat[idx * 3: idx * 3 + 3]
        hx = "#%02x%02x%02x" % (r, g, b)
        if hx not in out:
            out.append(hx)
    return out[:count]


def _safe_stem(name):
    """A file-name stem from a theme name: letters, digits, space, - and _ only,
    spaces become underscores, no Windows reserved names. Never empty."""
    stem = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]+", " ", name or "")
    stem = re.sub(r"\s+", "_", stem.strip()).strip("._-")[:MAX_NAME_LEN]
    if not stem:
        stem = DEFAULT_NAME.replace(" ", "_")
    if stem.lower() in _RESERVED:
        stem += "_theme"
    return stem


def _sat(c):
    return QColor(c).hsvSaturationF()


def _mix(a, b, t):
    """Blend color a toward b by t (0 = a, 1 = b), as #rrggbb."""
    ca, cb = QColor(a), QColor(b)
    return "#%02x%02x%02x" % tuple(
        round(x * (1 - t) + y * t)
        for x, y in ((ca.red(), cb.red()), (ca.green(), cb.green()), (ca.blue(), cb.blue())))


def _readable_text(text, bg):
    """`text` if it reads on `bg`; else near-white or near-black, whichever
    contrasts more; else pure white or black (a mid-gray background cannot
    reach MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST with the softer pair)."""
    if contrast(text, bg) >= MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST:
        return text
    for pair in (("#f2f2f2", "#111111"), ("#ffffff", "#000000")):
        best = max(pair, key=lambda c: contrast(c, bg))
        if contrast(best, bg) >= MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST:
            return best
    return best


def _readable_muted(muted, text, bg):
    """`muted` if it holds MUTED_MIN_CONTRAST on `bg`; else the text color
    blended toward the background as far as that contrast allows."""
    if contrast(muted, bg) >= MUTED_MIN_CONTRAST:
        return muted
    for t in (0.35, 0.25, 0.15, 0.0):
        c = _mix(text, bg, t)
        if contrast(c, bg) >= MUTED_MIN_CONTRAST:
            return c
    return text


def generate_accent(colors, bg):
    """Smart accent: a vivid color that suits `bg`, built in HSL.
    If the image has any tint, take the hue of its most saturated color and
    turn it 180 degrees (the complement). A fully grayscale image has no hue,
    so use blue on a dark background and red on a light one. Saturation is
    high; lightness starts mid-high on dark backgrounds and mid-low on light
    ones, then steps until the accent contrasts with `bg` by at least
    ACCENT_MIN_CONTRAST."""
    dark_bg = QColor(bg).lightnessF() < 0.5
    tinted = [c for c in colors if _sat(c) >= SMART_TINT_SAT and QColor(c).hslHueF() >= 0]
    if tinted:
        src = max(tinted, key=_sat)
        hue = (QColor(src).hslHueF() + 0.5) % 1.0
    else:
        hue = (215 if dark_bg else 5) / 360.0
    light = 0.60 if dark_bg else 0.42
    out = QColor.fromHslF(hue, 0.85, light).name()
    for _ in range(24):
        out = QColor.fromHslF(hue, 0.85, light).name()
        if contrast(out, bg) >= ACCENT_MIN_CONTRAST:
            break
        light = min(0.92, light + 0.03) if dark_bg else max(0.08, light - 0.03)
    return out


def suggest_chips(colors, smart=True):
    """Map extracted colors onto the chips. The darkest color is the background
    and the lightest is the text. Of the colors in between, the most saturated
    becomes the accent, and the rest fill panel, elevated and border in order.
    Smart mode: if no in-between color is saturated enough to be an accent
    (SMART_MIN_SAT), or there is none at all, a complementary accent is
    generated instead (see generate_accent) and every in-between color goes to
    panel, elevated and border. If the text fails MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST against the
    background, it is replaced by #f2f2f2 or #111111 (or pure white or black on
    a mid-gray background), whichever contrasts more.
    Chips with no color to take are left out of the result, so they keep their
    current value."""
    if len(colors) < 2:
        return {}
    ordered = sorted(colors, key=luminance)
    bg, text = ordered[0], ordered[-1]
    middle = ordered[1:-1]
    out = {"bg_base": bg}
    accent = None
    if middle:
        # Smart: a candidate must also stand out from the background, so a dark
        # saturated brown on a near-black background is not taken as an accent.
        pool = [c for c in middle if contrast(c, bg) >= ACCENT_MIN_CONTRAST] if smart else middle
        if pool:
            best = max(pool, key=_sat)
            if not smart or _sat(best) >= SMART_MIN_SAT:
                accent = best
                middle.remove(best)
    if accent is None and smart:
        accent = generate_accent(colors, bg)
    if accent is not None:
        out["accent"] = accent
    for key in ("bg_panel", "bg_elevated", "border"):
        if middle:
            out[key] = middle.pop(0)
    out["text"] = _readable_text(text, bg)
    return out


def _rule():
    line = QFrame()
    line.setFrameShape(QFrame.HLine)
    line.setFrameShadow(QFrame.Sunken)
    return line


class ImageDropZone(QFrame):
    """A bordered zone that takes a dropped image file or a click (browse).
    After an image is set it shows a thumbnail, scaled to fit. It only reports
    the choice (imageChosen / clicked); the dialog decides what to do with it."""
    imageChosen = Signal(str)       # a valid image file was dropped
    clicked = Signal()              # click or Enter/Space: ask for a file

    PROMPT = "Drop an image here, or click to browse."
    _QSS = ("QFrame#ImageDropZone { border: 2px dashed palette(mid); border-radius: 10px; }"
            "QFrame#ImageDropZone:hover, QFrame#ImageDropZone[dragOver=\"true\"] "
            "{ border: 2px dashed palette(highlight); }"
            "QFrame#ImageDropZone:disabled { border: 2px dashed palette(midlight); }")

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("ImageDropZone")
        self.setStyleSheet(self._QSS)
        self.setAcceptDrops(True)
        self.setMinimumHeight(130)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
        self.setAccessibleName("Image drop zone")
        self._pix = None
        lay = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.label = QLabel(self.PROMPT)
        self.label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.label.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents)
        lay.addWidget(self.label)

    # ---- state ----
    def disable_with(self, text, tip):
        """Pillow is missing: the zone stays visible but inert, and says why."""
        self.setEnabled(False)
        self.setCursor(Qt.ArrowCursor)
        self.label.setText(text)
        self.setToolTip(tip)

    def set_image(self, path):
        """Show a thumbnail of `path`. Returns False when Qt cannot decode it."""
        reader = QImageReader(path)
        reader.setAutoTransform(True)
        size = reader.size()
        if size.isValid() and max(size.width(), size.height()) > THUMB_MAX:
            size.scale(THUMB_MAX, THUMB_MAX, Qt.KeepAspectRatio)
            reader.setScaledSize(size)
        img = reader.read()
        if img.isNull():
            return False
        self._pix = QPixmap.fromImage(img)
        self.label.setVisible(False)
        self.setToolTip(f"{path}\nDrop another image to replace it.")
        self.update()
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def _dropped_image(md):
        for u in md.urls():
            if not u.isLocalFile():
                continue
            f = u.toLocalFile()
            if f.lower().endswith(IMAGE_EXTS) or QImageReader(f).canRead():
                return f
        return None

    def _drag_over(self, on):
        self.setProperty("dragOver", "true" if on else "false")
        self.style().unpolish(self)
        self.style().polish(self)

    # ---- events ----
    def dragEnterEvent(self, e):
        if self._dropped_image(e.mimeData()):
            e.acceptProposedAction()
            self._drag_over(True)
        else:
            e.ignore()

    def dragLeaveEvent(self, e):
        self._drag_over(False)

    def dropEvent(self, e):
        self._drag_over(False)
        path = self._dropped_image(e.mimeData())
        if path:
            e.acceptProposedAction()
            self.imageChosen.emit(path)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, e):
        if e.button() == Qt.LeftButton and self.rect().contains(e.position().toPoint()):
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(e)

    def keyPressEvent(self, e):
        if e.key() in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter, Qt.Key_Space):
            self.clicked.emit()
        else:
            super().keyPressEvent(e)

    def paintEvent(self, e):
        super().paintEvent(e)       # the dashed border
        if self._pix is None:
            return
        box = self.rect().adjusted(10, 10, -10, -10)
        pm = self._pix.scaled(box.size(), Qt.KeepAspectRatio, Qt.SmoothTransformation)
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.drawPixmap(box.x() + (box.width() - pm.width()) // 2,
                     box.y() + (box.height() - pm.height()) // 2, pm)


class ColorChip(QWidget):
    """One editable token: a color button, its name, its hex and an optional
    low-contrast note under it."""

    def __init__(self, label, on_click, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        row = QHBoxLayout(self)
        row.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.swatch = QPushButton()
        self.swatch.setFixedSize(56, 28)
        self.swatch.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.swatch.setToolTip(f"Click to change {label.lower()}")
        self.swatch.setAccessibleName(f"{label} color")
        self.swatch.clicked.connect(on_click)
        text_col = QVBoxLayout()
        text_col.setSpacing(0)
        name = QLabel(label)
        self.hex = QLabel("")
        self.hex.setObjectName("CardHint")
        self.warn = QLabel("low contrast")
        self.warn.setObjectName("Warn")
        self.warn.setVisible(False)
        text_col.addWidget(name)
        text_col.addWidget(self.hex)
        text_col.addWidget(self.warn)
        row.addWidget(self.swatch)
        row.addLayout(text_col)
        row.addStretch(1)

    def set_color(self, hex_value, edge):
        self.swatch.setStyleSheet(f"background: {hex_value}; border: 1px solid {edge}; "
                                  "border-radius: 6px;")
        self.hex.setText(hex_value)


class ThemeEngineDialog(QDialog):
    # Emitted on every change (debounced). Payload: the full settings state.
    themeChanged = Signal(dict)
    # Emitted after a theme file is written. Payload: its path.
    themeSaved = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, base_settings=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Theme Engine")
        self.setMinimumWidth(520)
        base = dict(base_settings or {})          # copy: load_settings() is read-only
        self._base = base
        preset = base.get("theme_preset")
        self._preset = preset if preset in PRESET_NAMES else "amoled_black"
        self._accent = base.get("accent") or THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"]
        self._tokens = {k: v for k, v in (base.get("theme_tokens") or {}).items()
                        if v and k != "accent"}
        self._extracted = []
        self._picker = None
        self._undo = None           # (accent, tokens) before the last Fill or Scramble

        # A color drag fires many changes; the app restyles once per pause.
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(LIVE_DEBOUNCE_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._emit_live)

        root = QVBoxLayout(self)

        hint = QLabel(f"Starting from {PRESET_NAMES[self._preset]}. Changes show in the app as "
                      "you make them. Save writes a theme file; closing this window puts "
                      "back your saved theme.")
        hint.setObjectName("CardHint")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(hint)

        # Image step: a drop zone, then Fill chips. Dropping only previews;
        # the theme changes when Fill chips is pressed.
        self.drop = ImageDropZone()
        self.drop.imageChosen.connect(self._load_image_path)
        self.drop.clicked.connect(self._load_image)
        root.addWidget(self.drop)
        img_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.fill_btn = QPushButton("Fill chips")
        self.fill_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.fill_btn.setToolTip("Use the image's colors. If the image has no strong accent "
                                 "color, a complementary one is generated.")
        self.fill_btn.clicked.connect(self._fill_from_image)
        self.scramble_btn = QPushButton("Scramble")
        self.scramble_btn.setToolTip("Shuffle the image colors (or the current colors, when no "
                                     "image is loaded) across the seven chips.")
        self.scramble_btn.clicked.connect(self._scramble)
        self.undo_btn = QPushButton("Undo")
        self.undo_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.undo_btn.setToolTip("Undo the last Fill chips or Scramble.")
        self.undo_btn.clicked.connect(self._undo_last)
        for b in (self.fill_btn, self.scramble_btn, self.undo_btn):
            img_row.addWidget(b)
        img_row.addStretch(1)
        root.addLayout(img_row)
        self._swatch_row = QHBoxLayout()
        root.addLayout(self._swatch_row)

        # The seven chips, two per row.
        grid = QGridLayout()
        self._chips = {}
        for i, (key, label) in enumerate(CHIPS):
            chip = ColorChip(label, lambda _=False, k=key: self._pick(k))
            self._chips[key] = chip
            grid.addWidget(chip, i // 2, i % 2)
        root.addLayout(grid)

        root.addWidget(_rule())

        # Load: pick a saved theme and edit it.
        load_row = QHBoxLayout()
        load_row.addWidget(QLabel("Saved themes"))
        self.load_combo = QComboBox()
        self.load_combo.setMinimumWidth(200)
        self.load_theme_btn = QPushButton("Load theme")
        self.load_theme_btn.clicked.connect(self._load_selected)
        load_row.addWidget(self.load_combo, 1)
        load_row.addWidget(self.load_theme_btn)
        root.addLayout(load_row)

        # Save: name it, then write HOME/themes/<name>.json.
        save_row = QHBoxLayout()
        save_row.addWidget(QLabel("Theme name"))
        self.name_edit = QLineEdit(DEFAULT_NAME)
        self.name_edit.setMaxLength(MAX_NAME_LEN)
        self.name_edit.setPlaceholderText(DEFAULT_NAME)
        self.name_edit.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.name_edit.returnPressed.connect(self._save)
        self.save_btn = QPushButton("Save Theme")
        self.save_btn.clicked.connect(self._save)
        save_row.addWidget(self.name_edit, 1)
        save_row.addWidget(self.save_btn)
        root.addLayout(save_row)

        bottom = QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("CardHint")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        close_btn = QPushButton("Close")
        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        bottom.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        bottom.addWidget(close_btn)
        root.addLayout(bottom)

        # Enter in the name box saves; it must not also press some other button.
        for btn in self.findChildren(QPushButton):
            btn.setAutoDefault(False)

        self._scan_files()
        self._refresh_chips()

    # ---- state and live apply ----

    def _state(self):
        """Full settings state for the app. Derived tokens are not stored here:
        resolve_palette computes them from the seven chips, so they stay in step."""
        st = dict(self._base)
        st["theme_preset"] = self._preset
        st["accent"] = self._accent
        st["theme_tokens"] = dict(self._tokens)
        return st

    def _pal(self):
        return resolve_palette(self._state())

    def _schedule(self):
        self._timer.start()

    def _emit_live(self):
        self.themeChanged.emit(self._state())

    def done(self, r):
        # Drop a pending live update, so it cannot restyle the app after the
        # host has put back the saved theme.
        self._timer.stop()
        super().done(r)

    # ---- chips ----

    def _refresh_chips(self):
        pal = self._pal()
        for key, chip in self._chips.items():
            chip.set_color(pal[key], pal["border_hi"])
            if key in LOW_CONTRAST_CHIPS:
                chip.warn.setVisible(contrast(pal[key], pal["bg_base"]) < MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST)

    def _set_chip(self, key, hex_value):
        if not QColor(hex_value).isValid():
            return
        if key == "accent":
            self._accent = hex_value
        else:
            self._tokens[key] = hex_value
        self._refresh_chips()
        self._schedule()

    def _pick(self, key):
        """Open a color picker for one chip. Its color changes live; Cancel
        puts back the color the chip had when the picker opened."""
        original = self._pal()[key]
        dlg = QColorDialog(QColor(original), self)
        dlg.setWindowTitle(dict(CHIPS)[key])
        dlg.setOption(QColorDialog.DontUseNativeDialog, True)   # keeps the eye dropper
        dlg.currentColorChanged.connect(lambda c, k=key: self._set_chip(k, c.name()))
        dlg.rejected.connect(lambda k=key, o=original: self._set_chip(k, o))
        self._picker = dlg          # keep a reference while the picker is open
        dlg.open()

    # ---- image ----

    def _load_image(self):
        """Browse (the drop zone was clicked)."""
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "Pick an image", "",
                                              "Images (" + " ".join("*" + e for e in IMAGE_EXTS)
                                              + ");;All files (*)")
        if path:
            self._load_image_path(path)

    def _load_image_path(self, path):
        """A dropped or browsed image: show the thumbnail and the swatches,
        then wait. Nothing about the theme changes until Fill chips."""
        try:
            colors = extract_colors(path)
        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Image failed", f"Couldn't read that image:\n{e}")
            return
        if len(colors) < 2:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Image failed", "That image has too few colors to use.")
            return
        self._extracted = colors
        self.drop.set_image(path)
        self._show_swatches(colors)
        self.fill_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.status.setText(f"Loaded {Path(path).name}. Press Fill chips to use its colors.")

    def _apply_chips(self, mapping):
        """Set several chips at once (Fill chips, Scramble), remembering the
        previous state for Undo."""
        self._undo = (self._accent, dict(self._tokens))
        self.undo_btn.setEnabled(True)
        for key, value in mapping.items():
            if key == "accent":
                self._accent = value
            else:
                self._tokens[key] = value
        self._refresh_chips()
        self._schedule()

    def _undo_last(self):
        if self._undo is None:
            return
        self._accent, self._tokens = self._undo[0], dict(self._undo[1])
        self._undo = None
        self.undo_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._refresh_chips()
        self._schedule()
        self.status.setText("Undone.")

    def _fill_from_image(self):
        suggested = suggest_chips(self._extracted, smart=True)
        if not suggested:
            return
        self._apply_chips(suggested)
        if suggested.get("accent") not in self._extracted:
            self.status.setText("The image had no strong accent color, so a complementary one "
                                "was generated. Click any chip to adjust it.")
        else:
            self.status.setText("Filled from the image. Click any chip to adjust it.")

    def _scramble(self):
        """Shuffle colors across the seven chips. The pool is the extracted
        image colors (topped up from the current chips to seven), or the
        current seven colors when no image is loaded. The result is kept
        readable: text is swapped for light or dark if it fails contrast, and
        muted text is blended toward the text color if it nearly vanishes."""
        pal = self._pal()
        current = [pal[k] for k in CHIP_KEYS]
        pool = list(dict.fromkeys(self._extracted)) if self._extracted else list(current)
        extras = [c for c in current if c not in pool] + current
        i = 0
        while len(pool) < len(CHIP_KEYS):
            pool.append(extras[i % len(extras)])
            i += 1
        pool = pool[:len(CHIP_KEYS)]
        if len(set(pool)) < 2:
            self.status.setText("Nothing to scramble: all the colors are the same.")
            return
        picked = list(pool)
        for _ in range(8):                   # avoid landing on the arrangement we already have
            random.shuffle(picked)
            if picked != current:
                break
        mapping = dict(zip(CHIP_KEYS, picked))
        bg = mapping["bg_base"]
        mapping["text"] = _readable_text(mapping["text"], bg)
        mapping["text_muted"] = _readable_muted(mapping["text_muted"], mapping["text"], bg)
        self._apply_chips(mapping)
        self.status.setText("Scrambled. Press Scramble again for another arrangement, or Undo.")

    def _show_swatches(self, colors):
        while self._swatch_row.count():
            item = self._swatch_row.takeAt(0)
            if item.widget() is not None:
                item.widget().deleteLater()
        for hx in colors:
            sw = QFrame()
            sw.setFixedSize(36, 28)
            sw.setToolTip(hx)
            sw.setStyleSheet(f"background: {hx}; border: 1px solid transparent; "
                             "border-radius: 4px;")
            self._swatch_row.addWidget(sw)
        self._swatch_row.addStretch(1)

    # ---- files ----

    def _scan_files(self, select=None):
        """List the theme files the Theme tab would also accept, by theme name.
        Keeps the current choice (or selects `select`, a path) after a rescan."""
        keep = select or self.load_combo.currentData()
        self.load_combo.clear()
        d = ThemePage._themes_dir()
        try:
            paths = sorted(d.glob("*.json"), key=lambda p: p.name.lower())
        except OSError:
            paths = []
        for p in paths:
            try:
                if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size > MAX_THEME_BYTES:
                    continue
                raw = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            if _theme_from_dict(raw) is None:
                continue
            self.load_combo.addItem(self._display_name(raw, p), str(p))
            self.load_combo.setItemData(self.load_combo.count() - 1, p.name, Qt.ToolTipRole)
        idx = self.load_combo.findData(keep) if keep else -1
        if idx >= 0:
            self.load_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
        self.load_theme_btn.setEnabled(self.load_combo.count() > 0)

    @staticmethod
    def _display_name(raw, path):
        nm = raw.get("name") if isinstance(raw, dict) else None
        return nm.strip() if isinstance(nm, str) and nm.strip() else Path(path).stem

    def _load_selected(self):
        path = self.load_combo.currentData()
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            raw = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Load failed", str(e))
            return
        entry = _theme_from_dict(raw)
        if entry is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Load failed", "That file is not a valid theme.")
            return
        # A loaded file replaces the theme being edited, not part of it.
        self._preset = entry["preset"]
        self._accent = entry["accent"]
        self._tokens = dict(entry["tokens"])
        self._undo = None
        self.undo_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.name_edit.setText(self._display_name(raw, path)[:MAX_NAME_LEN])
        self._refresh_chips()
        self._schedule()
        self.status.setText(f"Loaded {Path(path).name}.")

    def _save(self):
        display = self.name_edit.text().strip() or DEFAULT_NAME
        d = ThemePage._themes_dir()
        target = d / (_safe_stem(display) + ".json")
        try:
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Save failed", str(e))
            return
        if target.exists() and QMessageBox.question(
                self, "Replace theme", f"{target.name} already exists. Replace it?") != QMessageBox.Yes:
            return
        pal = self._pal()
        tokens = dict(self._tokens)
        tokens.update({k: pal[k] for k in CHIP_KEYS if k != "accent"})
        # Export format, the shape gui_theme_page._theme_from_dict reads back.
        data = {"name": display, "theme_preset": self._preset, "accent": self._accent,
                "theme_tokens": tokens}
        try:
            target.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Save failed", str(e))
            return
        self.name_edit.setText(display)
        self._scan_files(select=str(target))      # new file shows in the dropdown, selected
        self.themeSaved.emit(str(target))
        self.status.setText(f"Saved \u201c{display}\u201d as {target.name}.")

def _family(font_stack):
    for part in font_stack.split(","):
        part = part.strip().strip('"')
        if part and not part.startswith("-"):
            return part
    return "Segoe UI"


def _px(v, d=0.0):
    """'14px' -> 14.0"""
    try:
        return float(str(v).lower().replace("px", "").strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return d


def _num(v, d=1.0):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return d


def _soft_color(v):
    """'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' -> a QColor with alpha, or None. Palette
    tokens are hex, but a preset may carry a CSS rgba() string for a faint
    border (Batch 3: Glass's border_soft); QColor does not parse that form,
    so the preview converts it by hand. The alpha may be 0..1 or 0..255."""
    try:
        m = re.match(r"rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*"
                     r"(?:,\s*([0-9.]+)\s*)?\)", str(v or "").strip())
        if not m:
            return None
        a = float(m.group(4)) if m.group(4) is not None else 1.0
        alpha = int(round(a * 255)) if a <= 1 else int(a)
        return QColor(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)),
                      max(0, min(255, alpha)))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _pick_color(initial, parent, title):
    """Color dialog with Qt's own dialog forced, so its "Pick Screen Color"
    eye dropper (sample any pixel on screen) is always there; a native
    dialog would not have it. Returns an invalid QColor when cancelled."""
    dlg = QColorDialog(QColor(initial), parent)
    dlg.setWindowTitle(title)
    dlg.setOption(QColorDialog.DontUseNativeDialog, True)
    if dlg.exec() == QDialog.Accepted:
        return dlg.currentColor()
    return QColor()


class FlowLayout(QLayout):
    """Wraps its items onto new rows when the width runs out."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None, spacing=8):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._items = []
        self._sp = spacing
        self.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

    def addItem(self, item):
        self._items.append(item)

    def count(self):
        return len(self._items)

    def itemAt(self, i):
        return self._items[i] if 0 <= i < len(self._items) else None

    def takeAt(self, i):
        return self._items.pop(i) if 0 <= i < len(self._items) else None

    def hasHeightForWidth(self):
        return True

    def heightForWidth(self, w):
        return self._do(QRect(0, 0, w, 0), True)

    def setGeometry(self, rect):
        super().setGeometry(rect)
        self._do(rect, False)

    def sizeHint(self):
        return self.minimumSize()

    def minimumSize(self):
        s = QSize()
        for it in self._items:
            s = s.expandedTo(it.minimumSize())
        return s

    def _do(self, rect, test):
        x, y, row_h = rect.x(), rect.y(), 0
        for it in self._items:
            sz = it.sizeHint()
            if x + sz.width() > rect.right() + 1 and row_h > 0:
                x = rect.x()
                y += row_h + self._sp
                row_h = 0
            if not test:
                it.setGeometry(QRect(QPoint(x, y), sz))
            x += sz.width() + self._sp
            row_h = max(row_h, sz.height())
        return y + row_h - rect.y()


class MiniPreview(QWidget):
    """A small painted copy of the main window, drawn from the tokens. It
    scales with its width, so it stays readable at any dialog size."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.t = resolve_palette({})
        sp = QSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        sp.setHeightForWidth(True)
        self.setSizePolicy(sp)
        self.setMinimumWidth(320)

    def set_tokens(self, t):
        self.t = t
        self.update()

    def hasHeightForWidth(self):
        return True

    def heightForWidth(self, w):
        return int(w * 0.43)

    def sizeHint(self):
        return QSize(560, 314)

    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        t = self.t
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        w = self.width()
        h = int(w * 0.43)
        s = w / 560.0
        fam = _family(t["font"])
        # Batch 2: the preview follows the preset's shape tokens. This card is
        # about half the size of the app window, so lengths are halved.
        K = 0.5
        rad = _px(t.get("radius"), 10) * K
        rad_sm = _px(t.get("radius_sm"), 6) * K
        ps = _num(t.get("pad_scale"), 1.0)
        bw = _num(t.get("border_w"), 1.0)
        fmul = _num(t.get("font_scale"), 1.0)
        bold_all = str(t.get("font_weight") or "normal").lower() in ("bold", "600", "700")
        pf = 0.6 + 0.4 * ps                       # row pitch follows the density
        # Batch 3: border_w is drawn as-is — 0 really means no border (the
        # old max(1.0, ...) floor hid the Glass preset's shape). A preset
        # with border_soft (Glass) instead gets a faint 1px line on its
        # panel / table / input boxes, drawn by box(..., soft_border=True).
        bpen = bw * max(1.0, s * 0.7)             # border thickness
        soft = _soft_color(t.get("border_soft"))

        def font(px, bold=False, mono=False):
            f = QFont(_family(t["font_mono"]) if mono else fam)
            f.setPixelSize(max(7, int(px * s * fmul)))
            f.setBold(bold or (bold_all and not mono))
            return f

        def text(x, y, wd, ht, s_, color, fnt, flags=Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignLeft):
            p.setFont(fnt)
            p.setPen(QColor(color))
            p.drawText(QRectF(x * s, y * s, wd * s, ht * s), int(flags), s_)

        def box(x, y, wd, ht, fill, border=None, r=6, soft_border=False):
            r = max(0.0, min(r, wd / 2.0, ht / 2.0))
            if soft_border and soft is not None:
                p.setPen(QPen(soft, max(1.0, s)))   # the faint 1px line
            elif border and bpen > 0:
                p.setPen(QPen(QColor(border), bpen))
            else:
                p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(QColor(fill) if fill else Qt.NoBrush)
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(x * s, y * s, wd * s, ht * s), r * s, r * s)

        box(0.5, 0.5, 559, h / s - 1, t["bg_base"], t["border"], rad * 1.5)
        # sidebar
        box(1, 1, 120, h / s - 2, t["bg_side"], None, rad * 1.5)
        text(12, 10, 100, 16, "\u2193 VIDEO GRABBER", t["text"], font(8, True))
        for i, name in enumerate(["All", "Active", "Finished", "Failed", "Video"]):
            y = 36 + i * 24 * pf
            if i == 0:
                box(8, y, 104, 20, t["bg_sel"], None, rad_sm)
            text(18, y, 90, 20, name, t["text"] if i == 0 else t["text_soft"], font(9, i == 0))
        # toolbar
        box(122, 1, 437, 36, t["bg_panel"], None, 0)
        box(132, 8, 70, 22, t["accent"], None, rad)
        text(132, 8, 70, 22, "+ Add URL", t["text_on_accent"], font(9, True), Qt.AlignCenter)
        for i, name in enumerate(["Start", "Pause", "Stop"]):
            text(212 + i * 48, 8, 46, 22, name, t["text_soft"], font(9), Qt.AlignCenter)
        box(440, 8, 108, 22, t["bg_input"], t["border"], rad, soft_border=True)
        text(448, 8, 90, 22, "Search\u2026", t["text_dim"], font(8))
        # table
        top = 46
        box(130, top, 420, 150, t["bg_panel"], t["border"], rad, soft_border=True)
        box(131, top + 1, 418, 22, t["bg_elevated"], None, rad_sm)
        for x, label in ((140, "Name"), (300, "Size"), (350, "Progress"), (480, "Status")):
            text(x, top + 1, 70, 22, label, t["text_muted"], font(8, True))
        rows = [("Studio session part 4.mp4", "212 MB", 62, "Loading", t["text_soft"]),
                ("Home _ X (2).mp4", "122 KB", 100, "Done", t["accent"]),
                ("watch (2) (1).mp4", "48 MB", 30, "Paused", t["warning"]),
                ("clip-0412.mp4", "0 B", 0, "Error", t["error"])]
        for i, (n, sz, pct, st, col) in enumerate(rows):
            y = top + 26 + i * 30 * pf
            if i == 1:
                box(132, y - 2, 416, 28, t["bg_sel"], None, rad_sm)
            text(140, y, 150, 24, n if len(n) < 24 else n[:22] + "\u2026", t["text"], font(9))
            text(300, y, 50, 24, sz, t["text_muted"], font(9))
            box(350, y + 8, 80, 8, t["bg_elevated"], None, min(rad_sm, 4))
            if pct:
                box(350, y + 8, 80 * pct / 100.0, 8, t["accent"], None, min(rad_sm, 4))
            text(440, y, 36, 24, "%d%%" % pct, t["text_soft"], font(8))
            text(480, y, 60, 24, st, col, font(9, True))
        # log
        box(130, 204, 420, 22, t["bg_input"], t["border"], rad, soft_border=True)
        text(138, 204, 400, 22, "18:35:10  Job 564 started: Studio session part 4.mp4",
             t["text_muted"], font(8, mono=True))
        p.end()


class PresetTile(QAbstractButton):
    doubleClicked = Signal()

    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self, e):
        # Swallow it: the first click already selected the tile, and letting
        # the base class turn the second press into another click would
        # toggle the preview straight back off.
        if e.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.doubleClicked.emit()
            e.accept()
            return
        super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(e)

    def __init__(self, key, ring, label_color, parent=None, tokens=None, title=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.key = key
        self.ring = ring
        self.label_color = label_color
        # tokens/title are for tiles built from a theme file in the themes
        # folder; the built-in presets leave both unset.
        self._tokens = tokens
        self._title = title or PRESET_NAMES.get(key, key)
        self.setCheckable(True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedSize(132, 86)
        self.setToolTip(self._title)
        self.setAccessibleName(self._title)

    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        t = self._tokens or THEME_PRESETS[self.key]
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        r = QRectF(1.5, 1.5, self.width() - 3, 58)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(self.ring if self.isChecked() else t["border_hi"]),
                      2.5 if self.isChecked() else 1))
        p.setBrush(QColor(t["bg_base"]))
        _rr = max(0.0, _px(t.get("radius"), 10) * 0.7)
        p.drawRoundedRect(r, _rr, _rr)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(t["bg_panel"]))
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(10, 10, 34, 40), 4, 4)
        for i, c in enumerate((t["bg_elevated"], t["bg_elevated"], t["bg_elevated"])):
            p.setBrush(QColor(c))
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(52, 12 + i * 13, 70, 9), 3, 3)
        p.setBrush(QColor(t["accent"]))
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(52, 12, 42, 9), 3, 3)
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(14, 16, 26, 7), 3, 3)
        f = QFont(self.font())
        f.setPixelSize(12)
        f.setBold(self.isChecked())
        p.setFont(f)
        p.setPen(QColor(self.label_color))
        p.drawText(QRectF(4, 62, self.width() - 8, 22), Qt.AlignCenter,
                   p.fontMetrics().elidedText(self._title, Qt.ElideRight, self.width() - 8))
        p.end()


_NUM_TOKENS = {"pad_scale": (0.6, 1.5), "border_w": (0, 6), "font_scale": (0.7, 1.3)}


def _theme_from_dict(d):
    """Normalize a theme file's JSON into a dict the page can preview and
    apply, or None when it holds nothing usable. Accepts the Export format
    (theme_preset / accent / theme_tokens / shell_*) and a flat file that is
    just {"bg_base": "#...", ...}. Unknown keys and invalid colors are
    dropped, so a bad file can never put junk into theme_tokens."""
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        return None
    base = THEME_PRESETS["amoled_black"]
    allowed = set(base) | set(DERIVED)
    non_color = {"radius", "radius_pill", "font", "font_mono", "radius_sm", "radius_chip",
                 "border_soft"}

    def clean(toks):
        out = {}
        for k, v in (toks or {}).items():
            if k in _NUM_TOKENS:      # layout tokens that are plain numbers (v5.5, Batch 2)
                lo, hi = _NUM_TOKENS[k]
                if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and lo <= v <= hi:
                    out[k] = float(v)
                continue
            if k == "font_weight":
                if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip().lower() in ("normal", "500", "600", "bold", "700"):
                    out[k] = v.strip().lower()
                continue
            if k == "accent" or k not in allowed or not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip():
                continue
            if k in non_color or QColor(v.strip()).isValid():
                out[k] = v.strip()
        return out

    wrapped = "theme_preset" in d or "theme_tokens" in d
    toks = clean(d.get("theme_tokens") if isinstance(d.get("theme_tokens"), dict) else {}) \
        if wrapped else clean(d)
    preset = d.get("theme_preset") if d.get("theme_preset") in PRESET_NAMES else "amoled_black"
    acc = d.get("accent")
    accent = acc.strip() if isinstance(acc, str) and QColor(acc.strip()).isValid() else None
    if not toks and not accent and not (wrapped and d.get("theme_preset") in PRESET_NAMES):
        return None
    accent = accent or THEME_PRESETS[preset]["accent"]
    out = {"preset": preset, "accent": accent, "tokens": toks,
           "pal": resolve_palette({"theme_preset": preset, "accent": accent,
                                   "theme_tokens": dict(toks)})}
    for k in ("shell_enabled", "shell_backlight", "frame_cream"):
        if k in d:
            out[k] = bool(d[k])
    if d.get("shell_color") in SHELLS:
        out["shell_color"] = d["shell_color"]
    if isinstance(d.get("shell_colors"), dict):
        out["shell_colors"] = ThemePage._clean_shell_colors(d["shell_colors"])
    return out


class Swatch(QAbstractButton):
    def __init__(self, color, ring, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.color = color
        self.ring = ring
        self.setCheckable(True)
        self.setFixedSize(30, 30)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setToolTip(color)
        self.setAccessibleName("Accent " + color)

    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        if self.isChecked():
            p.setPen(QPen(QColor(self.ring), 2))
            p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
            p.drawEllipse(QRectF(1.5, 1.5, 27, 27))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(self.color))
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(6, 6, 18, 18))
        p.end()


def _card(title, hint=None):
    f = QFrame()
    f.setObjectName("Card")
    lay = QVBoxLayout(f)
    lay.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 16, 16)
    lay.setSpacing(10)
    t = QLabel(title)
    t.setObjectName("CardTitle")
    lay.addWidget(t)
    if hint:
        h = QLabel(hint)
        h.setObjectName("CardHint")
        h.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(h)
    return f, lay
