        self._toggle_fine(self.fine_toggle.isChecked())
        self._apply_detail()
        self._refresh()

    # ---- layout: preview beside the controls when wide, above when narrow ----
    def _relayout(self, width):
        wide = width >= 900
        if wide == self._wide:
            return
        self._wide = wide
        for w in (self.preview_card, self.controls):
            self._grid.removeWidget(w)
        if wide:
            self._grid.addWidget(self.controls, 0, 0)
            self._grid.addWidget(self.preview_card, 0, 1, Qt.AlignTop)
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(0, 5)
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(1, 6)
        else:
            self._grid.addWidget(self.preview_card, 0, 0)
            self._grid.addWidget(self.controls, 1, 0)
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(0, 1)
            self._grid.setColumnStretch(1, 0)

    def resizeEvent(self, e):
        super().resizeEvent(e)
        self._relayout(e.size().width())

    # ---- fine-tune rows ----
    def _make_row(self, key, label):
        lay = QHBoxLayout()
        lay.setSpacing(8)
        name = QLabel(label)
        name.setMinimumWidth(150)
        chip = QPushButton()
        chip.setMinimumWidth(110)
        chip.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        chip.setAccessibleName(label)
        chip.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, k=key: self._pick_token(k))
        reset = QToolButton()
        reset.setText("Reset")
        reset.setToolTip("Back to the preset's color")
        reset.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, k=key: self._reset_token(k))
        lay.addWidget(name)
        lay.addWidget(chip)
        lay.addWidget(reset)
        lay.addStretch(1)
        self._rows[key] = (chip, reset, name)
        return lay

    @staticmethod
    def _clean_shell_colors(d):
        """Keep only known parts with a valid color; empty means no override."""
        if not isinstance(d, dict):
            return {}
        return {k: v for k, v in d.items()
                if k in SHELL_PART_KEYS and isinstance(v, str) and v and QColor(v).isValid()}

    def _shell_part(self, key):
        return self._shell_ov.get(key) or SHELLS[self._shell_color].get(key, "#000000")

    def _make_shell_row(self, key, label):
        lay = QHBoxLayout()
        lay.setSpacing(8)
        name = QLabel(label)
        name.setMinimumWidth(150)
        chip = QPushButton()
        chip.setMinimumWidth(110)
        chip.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        chip.setAccessibleName("Shell " + label)
        chip.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, k=key: self._pick_shell_part(k))
        reset = QToolButton()
        reset.setText("Reset")
        reset.setToolTip("Back to the shell's own color")
        reset.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, k=key: self._reset_shell_part(k))
        lay.addWidget(name)
        lay.addWidget(chip)
        lay.addWidget(reset)
        lay.addStretch(1)
        self._shell_rows[key] = (chip, reset, name, label)
        return lay

    def _pick_shell_part(self, key):
        c = _pick_color(self._shell_part(key), self, "Choose color")
        if c.isValid():
            self._shell_ov[key] = c.name()
            self._refresh()

    def _reset_shell_part(self, key):
        self._shell_ov.pop(key, None)
        self._refresh()

    def _tokens(self):
        return resolve_palette({"theme_preset": self._preset, "accent": self._accent,
                                "theme_tokens": dict(self._ov)})

    def _refresh(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "clear_btn"):
            return
        t = self._tokens()
        self.preview.set_tokens(t)
        for key, (chip, reset, name) in self._rows.items():
            col = t[key]
            fg = "#000000" if luminance(col) > 0.4 else "#ffffff"
            chip.setText(col.upper())
            chip.setStyleSheet(f"QPushButton {{ background: {col}; color: {fg}; "
                               f"border: 1px solid {t['border_hi']}; padding: 5px 10px; }}")
            edited = key in self._ov or (key == "accent" and
                                        self._accent.lower() != THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"].lower())
            reset.setVisible(edited)
            name.setText(dict(i for _, g in GROUPS for i in g).get(key, "Frame color")
                         + ("  \u2022" if edited else ""))
        _fr = self._rows.get("frame")
        if _fr:
            _fr[0].setEnabled(self._frame_cream)
        n = len(self._ov)
        self.count_chip.setText(f"{n} customized" if n else "No tweaks")
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(n > 0)
        self.reset_preset_btn.setEnabled(n > 0 or self._accent.lower()
                                         != THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"].lower())
        self.fine_toggle.setText(("\u25BE " if self.fine_toggle.isChecked() else "\u25B8 ")
                                 + "Edit individual colors")
        self.accent_label.setText(f"Current accent: {self._accent.upper()}")
        self.backlight_check.setEnabled(self._shell_on)
        for key, (chip, reset, name, label) in self._shell_rows.items():
            col = self._shell_part(key)
            fg = "#000000" if luminance(col) > 0.4 else "#ffffff"
            chip.setText(col.upper())
            chip.setStyleSheet(f"QPushButton {{ background: {col}; color: {fg}; "
                               f"border: 1px solid {t['border_hi']}; padding: 5px 10px; }}")
            edited = key in self._shell_ov
            chip.setEnabled(self._shell_on)
            reset.setEnabled(self._shell_on)
            reset.setVisible(edited)
            name.setText(label + ("  \u2022" if edited else ""))
        for key, b in self._shell_sw:
            b.setChecked(self._shell_on and key == self._shell_color)
            b.setEnabled(self._shell_on)
        for b in self._swatches:
            b.setChecked(b.color.lower() == self._accent.lower())
        warns = []
        if contrast(t["text"], t["bg_panel"]) < 4.5:
            warns.append("Main text is hard to read on panels.")
        if contrast(t["text_muted"], t["bg_panel"]) < 2.5:
            warns.append("Secondary text is very faint.")
        if contrast(t["accent"], t["bg_base"]) < 2:
            warns.append("The accent barely stands out from the background.")
        self.warn.setText("\u26A0 " + " ".join(warns))
        self.warn.setVisible(bool(warns))
        self.changed.emit()

    # ---- Simple / Detailed (v5.5) ----
    def _apply_detail(self):
        for w in (self.shell_detail, self.frame_card, self.fine_card):
            w.setVisible(self._detail)

    def _set_detail(self, on):
        self._detail = bool(on)
        self._apply_detail()
        if self._detail:
            self.fine_toggle.setChecked(True)     # Detailed reveals the full grid

    # ---- actions ----
    def _toggle_fine(self, on):
        self.fine_body.setVisible(on)
        self._refresh() if hasattr(self, "count_chip") else None

    def _pick_preset(self, key):
        self._preset = key
        self._accent = THEME_PRESETS[key]["accent"]
        for k, tile in self._tiles.items():
            tile.setChecked(k == key)
            tile.update()
        if key == "handheld" and not self.shell_check.isChecked():
            self.shell_check.setChecked(True)     # Handheld brings its shell (still switchable)
        self._refresh()

    def _shell_toggled(self, on):
        self._shell_on = on
        self._refresh()

    def _preset_double_clicked(self, key):
        self._pick_preset(key)
        self.applied.emit()

    def _frame_toggled(self, on):
        self._frame_cream = on
        self._refresh()

    def _backlight_toggled(self, on):
        self._backlight = on
        self._refresh()

    def _pick_shell(self, key):
        self._shell_color = key
        self._shell_on = True
        self.shell_check.setChecked(True)
        self._refresh()

    def _set_accent(self, hexc):
        self._accent = hexc
        self._refresh()

    def _pick_accent(self):
        c = _pick_color(self._accent, self, "Custom accent color")
        if c.isValid():
            self._set_accent(c.name())

    def _pick_token(self, key):
        cur = QColor(self._tokens()[key])
        c = _pick_color(cur, self, "Choose color")
        if not c.isValid():
            return
        if key == "accent":
            self._accent = c.name()
        else:
            self._ov[key] = c.name()
        self._refresh()

    def _reset_token(self, key):
        if key == "accent":
            self._accent = THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"]
        else:
            self._ov.pop(key, None)
        self._refresh()

    def _reset_to_preset(self):
        """Clear every override (and a changed accent): back to the base preset."""
        self._ov = {}
        self._accent = THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"]
        self._refresh()

    def _clear_tweaks(self):
        self._ov = {}
        self._refresh()

    def _reset_all(self):
        self._ov = {}
        self._shell_on = False
        self.shell_check.setChecked(False)
        self._backlight = True
        self.backlight_check.setChecked(True)
        self._shell_ov = {}
        self._frame_cream = False
        self.frame_check.setChecked(False)
        self._pick_preset("amoled_black")

    def _export(self):
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Export theme", str(self._themes_dir() / "theme.json"), "JSON (*.json)")
        if path:
            Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(self.values(for_save=False), indent=2, sort_keys=True),
                                  encoding="utf-8")
            self._scan_themes()

    def _import(self):
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "Import theme", "", "JSON (*.json)")
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            d = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if not isinstance(d, dict):
                raise ValueError("not a theme file")
            preset = d.get("theme_preset")
            self._preset = preset if preset in PRESET_NAMES else self._preset
            self._accent = str(d.get("accent") or THEME_PRESETS[self._preset]["accent"])
            toks = d.get("theme_tokens")
            self._ov = {k: v for k, v in toks.items() if v and k != "accent"} \
                if isinstance(toks, dict) else {}
            for k, tile in self._tiles.items():
                tile.setChecked(k == self._preset)
            self.fine_toggle.setChecked(bool(self._ov))
            self._shell_on = bool(d.get("shell_enabled", self._shell_on))
            sc = d.get("shell_color")
            self._shell_color = sc if sc in SHELLS else self._shell_color
            self.shell_check.setChecked(self._shell_on)
            self._backlight = bool(d.get("shell_backlight", self._backlight))
            self.backlight_check.setChecked(self._backlight)
            self._frame_cream = bool(d.get("frame_cream", self._frame_cream))
            self.frame_check.setChecked(self._frame_cream)
            if isinstance(d.get("shell_colors"), dict):
                self._shell_ov = self._clean_shell_colors(d["shell_colors"])
            self._refresh()
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Import failed", str(e))

    # ---- themes folder (browse, preview, apply, bulk import) ----
    @staticmethod
    def _themes_dir():
        return Path(_settings.HOME) / "themes"

    def _scan_themes(self):
        """(Re)read the .json files in the themes folder, then show the page
        of tiles that holds the current selection (or the current page)."""
        d = self._themes_dir()
        try:
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        sel_path = self._file_sel["path"] if self._file_sel else None
        self._file_entries, self._file_sel = [], None
        try:
            files = sorted((p for p in d.glob("*.json") if p.is_file()),
                           key=lambda p: p.name.lower())[:200]
        except OSError:
            files = []
        for p in files:
            try:
                if p.stat().st_size > 256 * 1024:
                    continue
                raw = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            e = _theme_from_dict(raw)
            if e is None:
                continue
            nm = raw.get("name") if isinstance(raw.get("name"), str) and raw["name"].strip() else p.stem
            e["name"], e["path"] = nm.strip(), str(p)
            self._file_entries.append(e)
            if e["path"] == sel_path:
                self._file_sel = e
                self._page = (len(self._file_entries) - 1) // GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE
        self._file_empty.setVisible(not self._file_entries)
        self.file_apply.setEnabled(self._file_sel is not None)
        self._folder_hint.setText(f"{d}  ({len(self._file_entries)} theme"
                                  f"{'' if len(self._file_entries) == 1 else 's'}). "
                                  "Click a tile to preview it, then Apply. Double-click to apply and close.")
        self._render_page()

    def _page_count(self):
        return max(1, -(-len(self._file_entries) // GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE))

    def _page_step(self, delta):
        self._page = max(0, min(self._page_count() - 1, self._page + delta))
        self._render_page()

    def _render_page(self):
        """Build only the tiles of the current page (12 max, 3 x 4)."""
        self._page = max(0, min(self._page_count() - 1, self._page))
        while self._ff.count():
            it = self._ff.takeAt(0)
            w = it.widget() if it is not None else None
            if w is not None:
                w.setParent(None)
                w.deleteLater()
        self._file_tiles = []
        start = self._page * GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE
        for pos, idx in enumerate(range(start, min(start + GALLERY_PAGE_SIZE,
                                                    len(self._file_entries)))):
            e = self._file_entries[idx]
            tile = PresetTile("amoled_black", self._ring, self._label,
                              tokens=e["pal"], title=e["name"])
            tile._gidx = idx
            tile.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, i=idx: self._select_file_tile(i))
            tile.doubleClicked.connect(lambda i=idx: self._file_double_clicked(i))
            self._ff.addWidget(tile, pos // GALLERY_COLS, pos % GALLERY_COLS)
            tile.setChecked(e is self._file_sel)
            self._file_tiles.append(tile)
        pages = self._page_count()
        self.pg_label.setText(f"Page {self._page + 1} of {pages}")
        self.pg_prev.setEnabled(self._page > 0)
        self.pg_next.setEnabled(self._page < pages - 1)
        self.pg_prev.setVisible(pages > 1)
        self.pg_next.setVisible(pages > 1)
        self.pg_label.setVisible(pages > 1)
        self._ff.invalidate()

    def _file_double_clicked(self, idx):
        self._file_sel = self._file_entries[idx]
        self._apply_file_theme()
        self.applied.emit()

    def _select_file_tile(self, idx):
        e = self._file_entries[idx]
        if self._file_sel is e:                      # click again = cancel the preview
            self._clear_file_selection()
            self._refresh()
            return
        self._file_sel = e
        for tile in self._file_tiles:
            tile.setChecked(getattr(tile, "_gidx", -1) == idx)
            tile.update()
        self.preview.set_tokens(e["pal"])            # preview only: nothing is stored
        self.file_apply.setEnabled(True)
        self._folder_hint.setText(f"Previewing {e['name']}. Press Apply to use it "
                                  "(Save in Settings writes it), or click the tile again to cancel.")

    def _clear_file_selection(self):
        if self._file_sel is None and not any(t.isChecked() for t in self._file_tiles):
            return
        self._file_sel = None
        for tile in self._file_tiles:
            tile.setChecked(False)
            tile.update()
        self.file_apply.setEnabled(False)
        self._folder_hint.setText(f"{self._themes_dir()}  ({len(self._file_entries)} theme"
                                  f"{'' if len(self._file_entries) == 1 else 's'}). "
                                  "Click a tile to preview it, then Apply.")

    def _apply_file_theme(self):
        e = self._file_sel
        if not e:
            return
        self._preset = e["preset"]
        self._accent = e["accent"]
        self._ov = dict(e["tokens"])
        for k, tile in self._tiles.items():
            tile.setChecked(k == self._preset)
            tile.update()
        self.fine_toggle.setChecked(bool(self._ov))
        if "shell_enabled" in e:
            self._shell_on = e["shell_enabled"]
            self.shell_check.setChecked(self._shell_on)
        if "shell_color" in e:
            self._shell_color = e["shell_color"]
        if "shell_backlight" in e:
            self._backlight = e["shell_backlight"]
            self.backlight_check.setChecked(self._backlight)
        if "frame_cream" in e:
            self._frame_cream = e["frame_cream"]
            self.frame_check.setChecked(self._frame_cream)
        if "shell_colors" in e:
            self._shell_ov = dict(e["shell_colors"])
        self._refresh()

    def _open_themes_dir(self):
        d = self._themes_dir()
        try:
            d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(d)))

    def _import_folder(self):
        src = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Import themes from folder", "")
        if not src:
            return
        dest = self._themes_dir()
        added = skipped = 0
        try:
            dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            same = Path(src).resolve() == dest.resolve()
            files = sorted(p for p in Path(src).glob("*.json") if p.is_file())[:500]
        except OSError as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Import failed", str(e))
            return
        if not same:
            for p in files:
                try:
                    if p.stat().st_size > 256 * 1024:
                        skipped += 1
                        continue
                    if _theme_from_dict(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))) is None:
                        skipped += 1
                        continue
                    target, n = dest / p.name, 2
                    while target.exists():            # never overwrite an existing theme
                        target = dest / f"{p.stem} ({n}){p.suffix}"
                        n += 1
                    shutil.copy2(p, target)
                    added += 1
                except (OSError, ValueError):
                    skipped += 1
        self._scan_themes()
        if same:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Import folder",
                                    "That is already the themes folder. Tiles refreshed.")
        else:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Import folder",
                                    f"Added {added} theme(s) to the themes folder"
                                    + (f"; skipped {skipped} file(s) that were not valid themes."
                                       if skipped else "."))

    def values(self, for_save=True):
        # v5.5: the server merges dict settings key by key, so a color that was
        # reset or cleared has to be sent as "" or the old override stayed in
        # settings after Save. Exports keep only the real overrides.
        if for_save:
            _keys = {k for k in self._rows if k != "accent"} | set(self._ov)
            _tokens = {k: self._ov.get(k, "") for k in sorted(_keys)}
        else:
            _tokens = dict(self._ov)
        out = {"theme_preset": self._preset, "accent": self._accent,
                "theme_tokens": _tokens, "shell_enabled": self._shell_on,
                "shell_color": self._shell_color, "shell_backlight": self._backlight, "frame_cream": self._frame_cream,
                # every key is sent ("" = no override) so the server's key-by-key
                # dict merge can never leave a reset color behind
                "shell_colors": {k: self._shell_ov.get(k, "") for k in SHELL_PART_KEYS}}
        if for_save:
            out["theme_detail_mode"] = "detailed" if self._detail else "simple"
        return out
"""gui_toolkit.py - Media Toolkit: a standalone visual mini-editor.

Preview a video (QMediaPlayer), pick a range on a painted timeline with two
draggable handles, then Compress, Trim or make a GIF. Exports run ffmpeg
through QProcess (never on the UI thread, with a progress bar and a safe
cancel), and the finished file is loaded straight back into the preview.

Output always lands next to the original and never overwrites it:
  <name>_compressed.mp4 / <name>_trimmed.<ext> / <name>_clip.gif
(a " (2)" is added if that name is taken).

Keys: Space play/pause, I set start, O set end, , and . step one frame.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QProcess, QRectF, Qt, QThread, QTimer, QUrl, Signal
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QMovie, QPainter, QPen, QKeySequence, QShortcut
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication, QButtonGroup, QCheckBox, QComboBox, QDialog, QDoubleSpinBox,
    QFileDialog, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QLineEdit, QMessageBox, QProgressBar,
    QPushButton, QRadioButton, QSizePolicy, QSlider, QStackedWidget, QTabWidget,
    QVBoxLayout, QWidget,
)

try:
    from PySide6.QtMultimedia import QAudioOutput, QMediaDevices, QMediaPlayer
    from PySide6.QtMultimediaWidgets import QVideoWidget
    HAVE_MM = True
except Exception:          # preview is optional; export still works
    HAVE_MM = False

MEDIA_EXTS = {".mp4", ".mkv", ".avi", ".webm", ".mov", ".m4v", ".flv", ".wmv",
              ".ts", ".mpg", ".mpeg", ".3gp", ".ogv", ".mp3", ".m4a", ".aac",
              ".wav", ".flac", ".ogg", ".opus"}
MIN_GAP_MS = 100


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def is_media_file(path):
    return Path(str(path)).suffix.lower() in MEDIA_EXTS


def _bin(name):
    """ffmpeg/ffprobe: bundled copy if the app found one, else PATH."""
    try:
        from engines import find_ffmpeg_dir
        d = find_ffmpeg_dir()
        if d:
            for cand in (f"{name}.exe", name):
                if (Path(d) / cand).is_file():
                    return str(Path(d) / cand)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return name


def fmt_time(ms, frac=False):
    ms = max(0, int(round(ms)))
    s, milli = divmod(ms, 1000)
    h, rem = divmod(s, 3600)
    m, sec = divmod(rem, 60)
    out = f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{sec:02d}"
    return f"{out}.{milli:03d}" if frac else out


def parse_time(text):
    """'90', '1:30', '00:01:30.5' -> milliseconds, or None if invalid."""
    parts = str(text or "").strip().split(":")
    if not parts or len(parts) > 3 or not all(re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?", p) for p in parts):
        return None
    secs = 0.0
    for p in parts:
        secs = secs * 60 + float(p)
    return int(round(secs * 1000))


def unique_out(src, suffix, ext):
    """Same folder as the source, <stem><suffix><ext>; never the source itself
    and never an existing file (adds ' (2)', ' (3)' ...)."""
    src = Path(src)
    ext = ext if ext.startswith(".") else "." + ext
    cand = src.with_name(f"{src.stem}{suffix}{ext}")
    n = 2
    while cand.exists() or cand == src:
        cand = src.with_name(f"{src.stem}{suffix} ({n}){ext}")
        n += 1
    return cand


def _theme_colors():
    d = {"accent": "#26c6da", "track": "#1a1a24", "edge": "#33333f", "text": "#e6e6eb",
         "dim": "#8a8a95"}
    try:
        from palette import resolve_palette
        from settings import STATE
        p = resolve_palette(STATE)
        d.update(accent=p["accent"], track=p["bg_elevated"], edge=p["border_hi"],
                 text=p["text"], dim=p["text_muted"])
    except Exception:
        pass
    return d


# ------------------------------------------------------------ ffprobe thread
class _ProbeThread(QThread):
    done = Signal(int, dict)
    failed = Signal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, token, path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._token, self._path = token, str(path)

    def run(self):
        try:
            cmd = [_bin("ffprobe"), "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
                   "format=duration,size,format_name:stream=codec_type,codec_name,width,"
                   "height,r_frame_rate,avg_frame_rate,duration:stream_disposition=attached_pic",
                   "-of", "json", self._path]
            kw = {"creationflags": 0x08000000} if sys.platform == "win32" else {}
            r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, errors="replace",
                               timeout=45, **kw)
            data = json.loads(r.stdout or "{}")
            fmt = data.get("format") or {}
            streams = data.get("streams") or []
            vid = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
                        and not (s.get("disposition") or {}).get("attached_pic")), None)
            aud = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), None)
            dur = fmt.get("duration") or (vid or aud or {}).get("duration")
            dur_ms = int(float(dur) * 1000)
            if dur_ms <= 0:
                raise ValueError("no duration")
            fps = 30.0
            if vid:
                for key in ("avg_frame_rate", "r_frame_rate"):
                    num, _, den = str(vid.get(key) or "0/0").partition("/")
                    try:
                        v = float(num) / float(den or 1)
                    except (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
                        v = 0
                    if 1 <= v <= 240:
                        fps = v
                        break
            self.done.emit(self._token, {
                "duration_ms": dur_ms,
                "has_video": vid is not None, "has_audio": aud is not None,
                "width": int((vid or {}).get("width") or 0),
                "height": int((vid or {}).get("height") or 0),
                "fps": fps, "vcodec": (vid or {}).get("codec_name") or "",
                "size": int(fmt.get("size") or 0),
            })
        except Exception as e:
            self.failed.emit(self._token, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")


# ------------------------------------------------------------ painted timeline
class TimelineSlider(QSlider):
    """A QSlider whose value is the playhead (ms), painted with a highlighted
    selection range and two draggable handles (start / end)."""
    scrubbed = Signal(int)          # user moved the playhead
    startChanged = Signal(int)
    endChanged = Signal(int)

    PAD = 12
    # Batch 4 #6: a handle is grabbed within GRAB px of the centre of its
    # painted body (the old test was 9 px from the line, which is narrower than
    # the handle looks). While dragging, seeks and field updates are emitted at
    # most every EMIT_MS so the handle follows the mouse smoothly.
    GRAB = 14
    EMIT_MS = 16

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(Qt.Horizontal, parent)
        self.setFixedHeight(48)
        self.setMouseTracking(True)
        self._start, self._end = 0, 0
        self._show_sel = True
        self._drag = None
        self._grab_dx = 0.0          # where inside the handle the press landed
        self._pending = None         # (kind, value) waiting to be emitted
        self._last_emit = 0.0
        self._emit_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._emit_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._emit_timer.timeout.connect(self._flush)
        self._c = _theme_colors()

    # -- state
    def setRangeMs(self, dur):
        self.setRange(0, max(1, int(dur)))
        self._start, self._end = 0, int(dur)
        self.update()

    def setSelection(self, s, e):
        self._start, self._end = int(s), int(e)
        self.update()

    def selection(self):
        return self._start, self._end

    def setSelectionVisible(self, on):
        self._show_sel = on
        self.update()

    # -- geometry
    def _x(self, ms):
        span = max(1, self.width() - 2 * self.PAD)
        return self.PAD + span * ms / max(1, self.maximum())

    def _ms(self, x):
        span = max(1, self.width() - 2 * self.PAD)
        return int(max(0, min(1, (x - self.PAD) / span)) * self.maximum())

    def _hit(self, x):
        if not self._show_sel:
            return "scrub"
        # The painted start handle sits just left of its line and the end
        # handle just right of its line (see paintEvent), so measure from the
        # centre of each body.
        ds = abs(x - (self._x(self._start) - 3))
        de = abs(x - (self._x(self._end) + 3))
        if min(ds, de) <= self.GRAB:
            # Handles stacked at the same spot: pick by which side the click is on.
            if ds == de:
                return "start" if x < self._x(self._start) else "end"
            return "start" if ds < de else "end"
        return "scrub"

    # -- mouse
    def mousePressEvent(self, e):
        if e.button() != Qt.LeftButton or not self.isEnabled():
            return
        x = e.position().x()
        self._drag = self._hit(x)
        # Remember how far from the handle's line the press landed, so the
        # handle keeps that offset instead of snapping its line to the cursor.
        if self._drag == "start":
            self._grab_dx = x - self._x(self._start)
        elif self._drag == "end":
            self._grab_dx = x - self._x(self._end)
        else:
            self._grab_dx = 0.0
        self.setSliderDown(True)
        self._apply(x)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, e):
        if self._drag:
            self._apply(e.position().x())
        elif self.isEnabled():
            self.setCursor(Qt.SizeHorCursor if self._hit(e.position().x()) != "scrub"
                           else Qt.PointingHandCursor)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, e):
        if self._drag:
            self._drag = None
            self._emit_timer.stop()
            self._flush()                 # the final position is always delivered
            self.setSliderDown(False)

    def _flush(self):
        if self._pending is None:
            return
        kind, value = self._pending
        self._pending = None
        self._last_emit = time.monotonic()
        if kind == "start":
            self.startChanged.emit(value)
        elif kind == "end":
            self.endChanged.emit(value)
        self.scrubbed.emit(value)

    def _queue_emit(self, kind, value):
        self._pending = (kind, value)
        if time.monotonic() - self._last_emit >= self.EMIT_MS / 1000.0:
            self._flush()
        elif not self._emit_timer.isActive():
            self._emit_timer.start(self.EMIT_MS)

    def _apply(self, x):
        ms = self._ms(x - self._grab_dx)
        if self._drag == "start":
            self._start = max(0, min(ms, self._end - MIN_GAP_MS))
            self.setValue(self._start)
            self._queue_emit("start", self._start)
        elif self._drag == "end":
            self._end = min(self.maximum(), max(ms, self._start + MIN_GAP_MS))
            self.setValue(self._end)
            self._queue_emit("end", self._end)
        else:
            self.setValue(ms)
            self._queue_emit("scrub", ms)
        self.update()

    # -- paint
    def paintEvent(self, _e):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        c = self._c
        cy, h = self.height() / 2, 10
        groove = QRectF(self.PAD, cy - h / 2, self.width() - 2 * self.PAD, h)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(c["edge"]), 1))
        p.setBrush(QColor(c["track"]))
        p.drawRoundedRect(groove, 5, 5)
        enabled = self.isEnabled() and self.maximum() > 1
        if enabled and self._show_sel:
            xs, xe = self._x(self._start), self._x(self._end)
            sel = QColor(c["accent"])
            sel.setAlpha(150)
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(sel)
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(xs, cy - h / 2, max(2, xe - xs), h), 5, 5)
            for x, left in ((xs, True), (xe, False)):
                r = QRectF(x - (8 if left else 2), cy - 15, 10, 30)
                p.setPen(QPen(QColor(c["text"]), 1))
                p.setBrush(QColor(c["accent"]))
                p.drawRoundedRect(r, 3, 3)
        if enabled:
            x = self._x(self.value())
            p.setPen(QPen(QColor(c["text"]), 2))
            p.drawLine(QPointF(x, 4), QPointF(x, self.height() - 4))
            p.setBrush(QColor(c["text"]))
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, 5), 3.5, 3.5)
        p.end()

class ToolkitDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, source_path=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Media Toolkit")
        self.setAcceptDrops(True)
        self.resize(940, 800)
        self.setMinimumSize(780, 680)

        self._src = None
        self._info = {}
        self._dur_ms = 0
        self._fps = 30.0
        self._token = 0
        self._probes = []
        self._proc = None
        self._out = None
        self._total_ms = 1
        self._stdout_buf = ""
        self._stderr_tail = ""
        self._cancelled = False
        self._result = None
        self._result_is_gif = False
        self._movie = None
        self._mode = "source"          # "source" | "result"
        self._play_sel = False

        self._player = None
        self._build_ui()
        self._build_player()
        self._wire_shortcuts()
        self._set_loaded(False)
        if source_path:
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self.load_source(source_path))

    def _build_compress(self):
        w = QWidget()

        self.c_slider.setValue(28)

                                                      self.c_quality.setChecked(True)))
        srow = QHBoxLayout()
        srow.addWidget(self.c_slider, 1)
        srow.addWidget(self.c_val)
        self.c_size = QRadioButton("Target size")
        self.c_mb = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.c_mb.setRange(1, 100000)
        self.c_mb.setDecimals(1)
        self.c_mb.setValue(50)
        self.c_mb.setSuffix(" MB")
        self.c_mb.valueChanged.connect(lambda _v: (self.c_size.setChecked(True),
                                                   self._update_estimate()))
        self.c_size.toggled.connect(lambda _on: self._update_estimate())
        self.c_sel = QCheckBox("Only compress the selected range")
        self.c_sel.toggled.connect(lambda _on: self._update_estimate())
        self.c_est = QLabel("")
        self.c_est.setObjectName("CardHint")
        self.c_est.setWordWrap(True)
        for x in (self.c_quality,):
            lay.addWidget(x)
        lay.addLayout(srow)
        row2 = QHBoxLayout()
        row2.addWidget(self.c_size)
        row2.addWidget(self.c_mb)
        row2.addStretch(1)
        lay.addLayout(row2)
        lay.addWidget(self.c_sel)
        lay.addWidget(self.c_est)

    def _build_gif(self):

        self.g_preset.addItem("High Quality (1080p)", "hq")

        self.g_hint = QLabel("")
        self.g_hint.setObjectName("CardHint")
        self.g_hint.setWordWrap(True)

        lay.addWidget(self.g_preset)
        lay.addWidget(self.g_hint)
        lay.addStretch(1)
        self._update_gif_hint()
        return w

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- player
    def _build_player(self):
        self._audio = None
        if not HAVE_MM:
            return
        self._player = QMediaPlayer(self)
        # Only attach audio when the PC has an output device; creating a
        # QAudioOutput without one can crash Qt Multimedia.
        # VG_TOOLKIT_NO_AUDIO=1 forces silent preview (headless / diagnostics).
        try:
            has_audio_dev = (not os.environ.get("VG_TOOLKIT_NO_AUDIO")
                             and bool(QMediaDevices.audioOutputs()))
        except Exception:
            has_audio_dev = False
        if has_audio_dev:
            self._audio = QAudioOutput(self)
            self._audio.setVolume(0.8)
            self._player.setAudioOutput(self._audio)
        else:
            self.mute.setEnabled(False)
            self.mute.setToolTip("No audio output device found")
        self._player.setVideoOutput(self.video)
        self._player.positionChanged.connect(self._on_position)
        self._player.durationChanged.connect(self._on_player_duration)
        self._player.playbackStateChanged.connect(self._on_state)
        self._player.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_player_error)

    def _wire_shortcuts(self):
        for key, fn in (("Space", self._toggle_play), ("I", lambda: self._set_marker("start")),
                        ("O", lambda: self._set_marker("end")),
                        (",", lambda: self._step(-1)), (".", lambda: self._step(1))):
            sc = QShortcut(QKeySequence(key), self)
            sc.setContext(Qt.WindowShortcut)
            sc.activated.connect(lambda f=fn: self._shortcut(f))

    def _shortcut(self, fn):
        # Plain-key shortcuts must not steal typing from the time fields.
        if isinstance(QApplication.focusWidget(), (QLineEdit, QDoubleSpinBox)):
            return
        if self.isEnabled() and self._src is not None and self._proc is None:
            fn()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- loading
    def _browse(self):
        start = str(self._src.parent) if self._src else str(Path.home())
        exts = " ".join("*" + e for e in sorted(MEDIA_EXTS))
        p, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(self, "Choose a video", start,
                                           f"Media ({exts});;All files (*)")
        if p:
            self.load_source(p)

    def dragEnterEvent(self, e):
        if self._proc is None and e.mimeData().hasUrls() and any(
                u.isLocalFile() and is_media_file(u.toLocalFile()) for u in e.mimeData().urls()):
            e.acceptProposedAction()

    def dropEvent(self, e):
        for u in e.mimeData().urls():
            if u.isLocalFile() and is_media_file(u.toLocalFile()):
                e.acceptProposedAction()
                QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda p=u.toLocalFile(): self.load_source(p))
                return

    def load_source(self, path):
        path = Path(path)
        if self._proc is not None:
            return
        if not path.is_file():
            self.status.setText(f"File not found: {path}")
            return
        self._stop_playback()
        self._clear_result()
        self._src, self._info, self._mode = path, {}, "source"
        self._token += 1
        self._set_loaded(False)
        self.src_label.setText(f"Source: {path.name}")
        self.info_label.setText("Reading metadata\u2026")
        self.status.setText("")
        self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        self.bar.setValue(0)
        if self._player is not None:
            self._player.setSource(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path)))
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(1)
        t = _ProbeThread(self._token, path, self)
        t.done.connect(self._on_probe)
        t.failed.connect(self._on_probe_failed)
        t.finished.connect(lambda th=t: self._probes.remove(th) if th in self._probes else None)
        self._probes.append(t)
        t.start()

    def _on_probe(self, token, info):
        if token != self._token:
            return
        self._info = info
        self._dur_ms = info["duration_ms"]
        self._fps = info["fps"]
        self.timeline.setRangeMs(self._dur_ms)
        self.timeline.setValue(0)
        self._sync_marker_edits()
        bits = []
        if info["has_video"]:
            bits.append(f"{info['width']}x{info['height']}")
            bits.append(f"{info['fps']:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".") + " fps")
            if info["vcodec"]:
                bits.append(info["vcodec"])
        else:
            bits.append("audio only")
        bits.append(fmt_time(self._dur_ms))
        if info["size"]:
            bits.append(f"{info['size'] / 1048576:.1f} MB")
        self.info_label.setText("  \u00b7  ".join(bits))
        if info["size"]:
            self.c_mb.blockSignals(True)
            self.c_mb.setValue(max(1.0, round(info["size"] / 1048576 / 2, 1)))
            self.c_mb.blockSignals(False)
        self._set_loaded(True)
        self._update_estimate()
        self._update_gif_hint()
        self._on_position(0)

    def _on_probe_failed(self, token, msg):
        if token != self._token:
            return
        self.info_label.setText("")
        self.status.setText(f"Couldn't read this file: {msg}")

    def _set_loaded(self, ok):
        vid = bool(self._info.get("has_video"))
        for w in (self.b_prev, self.b_play, self.b_next, self.b_playsel, self.timeline,
                  self.start_edit, self.end_edit, self.b_set_start, self.b_set_end,
                  self.b_reset, self.b_export):
            w.setEnabled(ok)
        # Compress / GIF need a video stream.
        self.tabs.setTabEnabled(0, ok and vid)
        self.tabs.setTabEnabled(2, ok and vid)
        if ok and not vid and self.tabs.currentIndex() != 1:
            self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(1)
        if not ok:
            self.sel_label.setText("Start: 00:00:00 | End: 00:00:00 | Duration: 00:00:00")

    # -------------------------------------------------- transport / sync
    def _toggle_play(self):
        if self._mode == "result" and self._result_is_gif and self._movie:
            self._movie.setPaused(self._movie.state() == QMovie.Running)
            self.b_play.setText("\u25b6  Play" if self._movie.state() != QMovie.Running
                                else "\u23f8  Pause")
            return
        if self._player is None:
            return
        self._play_sel = False
        if self._player.playbackState() == QMediaPlayer.PlayingState:
            self._player.pause()
        else:
            self._player.play()

    def _on_state(self, st):
        playing = st == QMediaPlayer.PlayingState
        self.b_play.setText("\u23f8  Pause" if playing else "\u25b6  Play")

    def _step(self, direction):
        if self._player is None or self._mode == "result" and self._result_is_gif:
            return
        self._player.pause()
        self._play_sel = False
        ms = int(round(1000.0 / (self._fps or 30.0)))
        pos = max(0, min(self.timeline.maximum(), self._player.position() + direction * ms))
        self._player.setPosition(pos)
        self.timeline.setValue(pos)

    def _on_scrub(self, ms):
        self._play_sel = False
        if self._player is not None:
            self._player.setPosition(ms)
        self._update_pos_label(ms)

    def _on_position(self, ms):
        if not self.timeline.isSliderDown():
            self.timeline.setValue(ms)
        self._update_pos_label(ms)
        if self._play_sel and self._mode == "source":
            _s, e = self.timeline.selection()
            if ms >= e:
                self._play_sel = False
                self._player.pause()
                self._player.setPosition(e)

    def _on_player_duration(self, ms):
        if self._mode == "result" and ms > 0:
            self.timeline.setRangeMs(ms)
            self.timeline.setSelectionVisible(False)

    def _on_player_error(self, _err, msg):
        if msg:
            self.status.setText(f"Preview problem: {msg} (export still works)")

    def _update_pos_label(self, ms):
        self.pos_label.setText(f"{fmt_time(ms)} / {fmt_time(self.timeline.maximum())}")

    def _play_selection(self):
        if self._player is None:
            return
        s, e = self.timeline.selection()
        self._player.setPosition(s)
        self.timeline.setValue(s)
        self._play_sel = True
        self._player.play()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- markers
    def _set_marker(self, which):
        if self._src is None or self._mode != "source":
            return
        pos = self._player.position() if self._player else self.timeline.value()
        s, e = self.timeline.selection()
        if which == "start":
            s = max(0, min(pos, e - MIN_GAP_MS))
        else:
            e = min(self._dur_ms, max(pos, s + MIN_GAP_MS))
        self.timeline.setSelection(s, e)
        self._sync_marker_edits()

    def _edit_marker(self, which):
        edit = self.start_edit if which == "start" else self.end_edit
        ms = parse_time(edit.text())
        s, e = self.timeline.selection()
        if ms is not None:
            if which == "start":
                s = max(0, min(ms, e - MIN_GAP_MS))
            else:
                e = min(self._dur_ms, max(ms, s + MIN_GAP_MS))
            self.timeline.setSelection(s, e)
        self._sync_marker_edits()

    def _reset_selection(self):
        if self._src is None:
            return
        self.timeline.setSelection(0, self._dur_ms)
        self._sync_marker_edits()

    def _sync_marker_edits(self):
        s, e = self.timeline.selection()
        self.start_edit.setText(fmt_time(s, True))
        self.end_edit.setText(fmt_time(e, True))
        self.sel_label.setText(
            f"Start: {fmt_time(s)} | End: {fmt_time(e)} | Duration: {fmt_time(e - s)}")
        self._update_estimate()
        self._update_gif_hint()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ hints
    def _selection_s(self):
        s, e = self.timeline.selection()
        return s / 1000.0, (e - s) / 1000.0

    def _update_estimate(self):
        if not self._info or not self._info.get("has_video"):
            self.c_est.setText("")
            return
        dur = self._selection_s()[1] if self.c_sel.isChecked() else self._dur_ms / 1000.0
        if self.c_size.isChecked() and dur > 0:
            kbps = self.c_mb.value() * 8192 / dur - (128 if self._info.get("has_audio") else 0)
            src_mb = self._info.get("size", 0) / 1048576
            msg = f"About {kbps / 1000:.2f} Mbps of video over {fmt_time(dur * 1000)}."
            if kbps < 50:
                msg = "Target is too small for this length. Raise it or shorten the range."
            elif src_mb and self.c_mb.value() >= src_mb:
                msg += " That is not smaller than the original."
            self.c_est.setText(msg)
        else:
            self.c_est.setText("Re-encodes to H.264 + AAC (MP4). Typical CRF: 23 high quality, "
                               "28 balanced, 32+ small.")

    def _update_trim_hint(self, *_):
        if self.t_exact.isChecked():
            self.t_hint.setText("Re-encodes to MP4 (H.264, CRF 18) so the cut lands on the exact "
                                "frames you picked. Slower than a copy.")
        else:
            self.t_hint.setText("Instant and lossless (stream copy). The cut snaps to the nearest "
                                "keyframe, so the clip may begin slightly early.")

    def _update_gif_hint(self, *_):
        if not hasattr(self, "g_hint"):
            return
        dur = self._selection_s()[1]
        hq = self.g_preset.currentData() == "hq"
        base = ("1080p max, 20 fps, best dithering: big files." if hq
                else "480p, 12 fps: small and shareable.")
        warn = ""
        if dur > (10 if hq else 20):
            warn = "  Long selections make large GIFs; consider a shorter range."
        self.g_hint.setText(base + warn)

    def _tab_changed(self, i):
        self.b_export.setText(("Compress", "Trim", "Make GIF")[i])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ export
    def _base_args(self):
        return ["-n", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-progress", "pipe:1", "-nostats"]

    def _build_export(self):
        """-> (args, out_path, total_ms) or raises ValueError."""
        src, info = self._src, self._info
        s_ms, e_ms = self.timeline.selection()
        has_a = info.get("has_audio")
        tab = self.tabs.currentIndex()
        a = self._base_args()
        if tab == 0:                                                  # Compress
            whole = not self.c_sel.isChecked()
            st, du = (0.0, self._dur_ms / 1000.0) if whole else self._selection_s()
            if du <= 0:
                raise ValueError("The range is empty.")
            if not whole:
                a += ["-ss", f"{st:.3f}"]
            a += ["-i", str(src)]
            if not whole:
                a += ["-t", f"{du:.3f}"]
            a += ["-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "0:a:0?",
                  "-vf", "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2",
                  "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
            if self.c_size.isChecked():
                v_k = int(self.c_mb.value() * 8192 / du - (128 if has_a else 0))
                if v_k < 50:
                    raise ValueError("Target size is too small for this length.")
                a += ["-b:v", f"{v_k}k", "-maxrate", f"{int(v_k * 1.5)}k",
                      "-bufsize", f"{v_k * 3}k"]
            else:
                a += ["-crf", str(self.c_slider.value())]
            if has_a:
                a += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k"]
            a += ["-movflags", "+faststart"]
            out = unique_out(src, "_compressed", ".mp4")
            total = int(du * 1000)
        elif tab == 1:                                                # Trim
            st, du = self._selection_s()
            if du <= 0:
                raise ValueError("The range is empty.")
            a += ["-ss", f"{st:.3f}", "-i", str(src), "-t", f"{du:.3f}",
                  "-map", "0:v:0?", "-map", "0:a:0?"]
            if self.t_exact.isChecked():
                a += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "18", "-preset", "veryfast",
                      "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
                if has_a:
                    a += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
                a += ["-movflags", "+faststart"]
                out = unique_out(src, "_trimmed", ".mp4")
            else:
                a += ["-c", "copy", "-avoid_negative_ts", "make_zero"]
                out = unique_out(src, "_trimmed", src.suffix or ".mp4")
            total = int(du * 1000)
        else:                                                         # GIF
            st, du = self._selection_s()
            if du <= 0:
                raise ValueError("The range is empty.")
            if du > 120:
                raise ValueError("GIFs are limited to 2 minutes. Shorten the range.")
            hq = self.g_preset.currentData() == "hq"
            h, fps = (1080, 20) if hq else (480, 12)
            pal = ("palettegen=max_colors=256:stats_mode=full",
                   "paletteuse=dither=sierra2_4a") if hq else (
                   "palettegen=stats_mode=diff",
                   "paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5")
            # Never upscale: min(target height, source height).
            vf = (f"fps={fps},scale=-2:min({h}\\,ih):flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];"
                  f"[s0]{pal[0]}[p];[s1][p]{pal[1]}")
            a += ["-ss", f"{st:.3f}", "-t", f"{du:.3f}", "-i", str(src),
                  "-vf", vf, "-loop", "0"]
            out = unique_out(src, "_clip", ".gif")
            total = int(du * 1000)
        a.append(str(out))
        return a, out, max(1, total)

    def _start_export(self):
        if self._src is None or self._proc is not None:
            return
        if self._mode != "source":
            self._show_view("source")
        try:
            args, out, total = self._build_export()
        except ValueError as e:
            self.status.setText(str(e))
            return
        self._stop_playback()
        self._out, self._total_ms = out, total
        self._cancelled = False
        self._stdout_buf = self._stderr_tail = ""
        self._proc = QProcess(self)
        self._proc.setProgram(_bin("ffmpeg"))
        self._proc.setArguments(args)
        self._proc.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(self._on_proc_out)
        self._proc.readyReadStandardError.connect(self._on_proc_err)
        self._proc.finished.connect(self._on_proc_finished)
        self._proc.errorOccurred.connect(self._on_proc_error)
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.bar.setRange(0, 0)                       # busy until first progress line
        self.status.setText(f"Working on {out.name}\u2026")
        self._proc.start()

    def _set_busy(self, busy):
        self.b_cancel.setVisible(busy)
        self.b_export.setVisible(not busy)
        for w in (self.tabs, self.open_btn, self.timeline, self.start_edit, self.end_edit,
                  self.b_set_start, self.b_set_end, self.b_reset, self.b_playsel,
                  self.view_orig, self.view_res, self.b_edit_result):
            w.setEnabled(not busy)

    def _on_proc_out(self):
        self._stdout_buf += bytes(self._proc.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        *lines, self._stdout_buf = self._stdout_buf.split("\n")
        speed = ""
        us = None
        for ln in lines:
            k, _, v = ln.strip().partition("=")
            if k in ("out_time_us", "out_time_ms") and v.lstrip("-").isdigit():
                us = int(v)                      # both keys are microseconds
            elif k == "speed":
                speed = v
        if us is not None and us >= 0:
            if self.bar.maximum() == 0:
                self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
            pct = max(0, min(99, int(us / 1000 * 100 / self._total_ms)))
            self.bar.setValue(pct)
            self.status.setText(f"{pct}%" + (f"  \u00b7  {speed}" if speed and speed != "N/A" else ""))

    def _on_proc_err(self):
        self._stderr_tail = (self._stderr_tail + bytes(
            self._proc.readAllStandardError()).decode("utf-8", "replace"))[-2000:]

    def _on_proc_error(self, err):
        if err == QProcess.FailedToStart and self._proc is not None:
            self._stderr_tail = "ffmpeg could not be started. Is it installed or bundled?"
            self._finish_export(failed=True)

    def _on_proc_finished(self, code, _status):
        if self._proc is None:
            return
        ok = (code == 0 and self._out is not None and self._out.exists()
              and self._out.stat().st_size > 0 and not self._cancelled)
        self._finish_export(failed=not ok)

    def _finish_export(self, failed):
        proc, out = self._proc, self._out
        self._proc = None
        if proc is not None:
            proc.deleteLater()
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        if self._cancelled or failed:
            try:
                if out is not None and out.exists():
                    out.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
            self.bar.setValue(0)
            if self._cancelled:
                self.status.setText("Export cancelled.")
            else:
                tail = " ".join((self._stderr_tail or "").strip().splitlines()[-3:])
                self.status.setText("Failed: " + (tail[:300] or "ffmpeg reported an error."))
            self._restore_source_preview()
            return
        self.bar.setValue(100)
        mb = out.stat().st_size / 1048576
        self.status.setText(f"Saved: {out.name}  ({mb:.1f} MB)  in {out.parent}")
        self._set_result(out)

    def _cancel_export(self):
        if self._proc is None:
            return
        self._cancelled = True
        self.status.setText("Cancelling\u2026")
        try:
            self._proc.write(b"q")                   # ask ffmpeg to stop cleanly
        except Exception:
            pass
        QTimer.singleShot(1500, self._kill_if_running)

    def _kill_if_running(self):
        if self._proc is not None and self._proc.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
            self._proc.kill()

    # ----------------------------------------------- in-app result preview
    def _set_result(self, path):
        self._result = path
        self._result_is_gif = path.suffix.lower() == ".gif"
        for w in (self.view_orig, self.view_res, self.b_folder, self.b_edit_result):
            w.setVisible(True)
        self.view_res.setChecked(True)
        self._show_view("result")

    def _clear_result(self):
        self._stop_gif()
        self._result = None
        for w in (self.view_orig, self.view_res, self.b_folder, self.b_edit_result):
            w.setVisible(False)

    def _restore_source_preview(self):
        if self._src is not None and self._player is not None and self._mode == "source":
            self._player.setSource(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(self._src)))
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(1)

    def _show_view(self, which):
        if self._proc is not None:
            return
        self._stop_playback()
        self._stop_gif()
        if which == "result" and self._result is not None:
            self._mode = "result"
            self.view_res.setChecked(True)
            self._edit_controls(False)
            if self._result_is_gif:
                self._play_gif(self._result)
            elif self._player is not None:
                self.timeline.setSelectionVisible(False)
                self._player.setSource(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(self._result)))
                self.stack.setCurrentIndex(1)
                self._player.play()
        else:
            self._mode = "source"
            self.view_orig.setChecked(True)
            self._edit_controls(True)
            self.timeline.setSelectionVisible(True)
            if self._src is not None:
                s, e = self.timeline.selection()
                self.timeline.setRangeMs(self._dur_ms)
                self.timeline.setSelection(s, e)
                self._restore_source_preview()
                self._on_position(0)
            self._sync_marker_edits()

    def _edit_controls(self, on):
        for w in (self.start_edit, self.end_edit, self.b_set_start, self.b_set_end,
                  self.b_reset, self.b_playsel):
            w.setEnabled(on)
        gif = self._mode == "result" and self._result_is_gif
        self.timeline.setEnabled(not gif)
        self.b_prev.setEnabled(not gif)
        self.b_next.setEnabled(not gif)

    def _play_gif(self, path):
        self._movie = QMovie(str(path))
        self._movie.jumpToFrame(0)
        size = self._movie.currentImage().size()
        if size.isValid():
            box = self.stack.size()
            self._movie.setScaledSize(size.scaled(box.width() - 8, box.height() - 8,
                                                  Qt.KeepAspectRatio))
        self.gif_label.setMovie(self._movie)
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
        self._movie.start()
        self.b_play.setText("\u23f8  Pause")

    def _stop_gif(self):
        if self._movie is not None:
            self._movie.stop()
            self.gif_label.setMovie(None)
            self._movie.deleteLater()
            self._movie = None

    def _stop_playback(self):
        self._play_sel = False
        if self._player is not None:
            self._player.pause()

    def _show_in_folder(self):
        p = self._result
        if not p or not Path(p).exists():
            return
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            subprocess.Popen(["explorer", "/select,", str(Path(p))])
        else:
            from PySide6.QtGui import QDesktopServices
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(Path(p).parent)))

    def _edit_result(self):
        if self._result is not None and self._proc is None:
            self.load_source(self._result)

    # --------------------------------------------------------- safe exit
    def done(self, r):
        if self._proc is not None:
            if QMessageBox.question(
                    self, "Export in progress",
                    "An export is still running. Cancel it and close?",
                    QMessageBox.Yes | QMessageBox.No, QMessageBox.No) != QMessageBox.Yes:
                return
            self._cancelled = True
            proc, out = self._proc, self._out
            self._proc = None
            try:
                proc.finished.disconnect()
                proc.kill()
                proc.waitForFinished(3000)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                if out is not None and out.exists():
                    out.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self._shutdown()
        super().done(r)

    def _shutdown(self):
        self._token += 1                      # ignore any late probe results
        self._stop_gif()
        if self._player is not None:
            self._player.stop()
            self._player.setSource(QUrl())    # release the file handle (Windows)
        for t in list(self._probes):
            t.wait(2000)
"""Job lifecycle: registry, state, snapshot persistence, new_job."""
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json
import os
import re
import threading
import time

import settings
from settings import (STATE, category_for, safe_filename, guess_filename, detect_type,
                      guess_ext_from_head, stat_for, is_junk_stem, clean_title,
                      generated_name, source_site_for)
from logging_setup import log


_ON_NEW_JOB_HOOKS = []
_SHOW_DIALOG_HOOKS = []


def register_new_job_hook(fn):
    """GUI registers a callable here; called from any thread when a job is queued."""
    _ON_NEW_JOB_HOOKS.append(fn)


def register_show_dialog_hook(fn):
    """GUI registers a callable here; called from any thread when the
    extension wants the pre-download confirmation dialog."""
    _SHOW_DIALOG_HOOKS.append(fn)


def _fire_show_dialog_hooks(payload):
    for fn in _SHOW_DIALOG_HOOKS:
        try:
            fn(payload)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"show-dialog hook failed: {e}")


def _fire_new_job_hooks(job):
    global _LAST_HOOK_TS
    with _NEW_JOB_HOOK_LOCK:
        now = time.time()
        if now - _LAST_HOOK_TS < 1.5:
            return
        _LAST_HOOK_TS = now
    for fn in _ON_NEW_JOB_HOOKS:
        try:
            fn(job)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"new-job hook failed: {e}")


JOBS = {}
JOB_COUNTER = 0
JOB_LOCK = threading.Lock()

# Debounce for new-job hooks: a 50-item batch must not raise the window
# 50 times (each raise is a hide/show flicker on Windows).
_NEW_JOB_HOOK_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_LAST_HOOK_TS = 0.0

_SNAPSHOT_LOCK = threading.Lock()


def save_jobs_snapshot():
    """Persist a plain (non-Event) view of jobs so history survives restarts."""
    # Serialized: /convert's progress thread and a finishing download can
    # otherwise clobber each other's .tmp file.
    with _SNAPSHOT_LOCK:
        try:
            snap = {}
            for jid, j in list(JOBS.items()):
                # referer and user_agent are persisted so a queued/downloading
                # job that reloads as "stopped" can still be resumed against
                # hosts that check them. The cookie stays out on purpose:
                # session cookies on disk are a privacy tradeoff not taken.
                snap[jid] = {k: v for k, v in list(j.items())
                             if k not in ("pause_evt", "stop_evt", "cookie", "error")}
            # Cap history at MAX_HISTORY jobs — always keep non-done jobs,
            # fill the rest with the newest done ones.
            MAX_HISTORY = 2000
            if len(snap) > MAX_HISTORY:
                entries = sorted(snap.items(),
                                 key=lambda kv: kv[1].get("created_ts", 0),
                                 reverse=True)
                kept = {}
                done_count = 0
                for jid, j in entries:
                    if j.get("status") != "done":
                        kept[jid] = j
                    elif done_count < MAX_HISTORY:
                        kept[jid] = j
                        done_count += 1
                snap = kept
            # Prune in-memory done jobs too so the GUI doesn't list thousands.
            if len(JOBS) > MAX_HISTORY + 500:
                done = sorted(((jid, j) for jid, j in list(JOBS.items())
                               if j.get("status") == "done"),
                              key=lambda kv: kv[1].get("completed_ts")
                                             or kv[1].get("created_ts", 0))
                for jid, _ in done[:-MAX_HISTORY]:
                    JOBS.pop(jid, None)
            tmp = settings.JOBS_PATH.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
            tmp.write_text(json.dumps(snap, indent=2))
            os.replace(tmp, settings.JOBS_PATH)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"couldn't save job history: {e}")



def _migrate_extensionless(job):
    """One-shot fix for restored jobs whose file landed with no extension."""
    try:
        # _dest_for, not stat_for: stat_for renames job["filename"] to
        # "name (2).ext" when size_done is 0, which is a side effect a
        # read-only migration must not have.
        p = settings._dest_for(job)
        if p.suffix or not p.exists():
            return
        ext = os.path.splitext(urlparse(job.get("url", "")).path)[1]
        if not ext:
            return
        target = p.with_suffix(ext)
        if target.exists():
            return
        os.replace(p, target)
        job["filename"] = target.name
        log(f"migrated extensionless file: {p.name} → {target.name}")
        save_jobs_snapshot()
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"extensionless migration failed: {e}")


def _repair_zero_size(job):
    """One-shot fixup for done jobs that display 0 B: the file exists on
    disk, but size_total was never set (yt-dlp post-processing threw)."""
    if job.get("size_total") or job.get("status") != "done":
        return False
    try:
        # _dest_for, not stat_for: stat_for renames job["filename"] when
        # size_done is 0 (which is exactly this case). The category is left
        # alone on purpose: _dest_for builds the folder from it, and the
        # file is already sitting in that folder.
        p = settings._dest_for(job)
        if p.exists() and p.stat().st_size > 0:
            job["size_total"] = job["size_done"] = p.stat().st_size
            log(f"repaired zero-size job {job.get('id')}: {job['filename']} "
                f"({job['size_total']} bytes)")
            return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"zero-size repair failed for job {job.get('id')}: {e}")
    return False


_PRIO_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_PRIO_LAST = 0.0


def _next_priority():
    """Strictly increasing start-order value (creation time, nudged so two
    jobs created in the same tick never tie)."""
    global _PRIO_LAST
    with _PRIO_LOCK:
        _PRIO_LAST = max(time.time(), _PRIO_LAST + 1e-6)
        return _PRIO_LAST


def start_order_key(j):
    """Dispatcher order: lower starts first. Reordering permutes these values."""
    return j.get("priority") or j.get("created_ts") or 0


def reorder_job(jid, action):
    """Move a queued job within the start order. action: top, up, down,
    bottom. Only queued jobs take part (others have no queue position).
    Returns the new 0-based position among queued jobs, or None when the
    job isn't queued. Raises KeyError for an unknown id."""
    if action not in ("top", "up", "down", "bottom"):
        raise ValueError(f"bad reorder action: {action}")
    job = JOBS[jid]
    if job.get("status") != "queued":
        return None
    # list(): a concurrent new_job() must not resize JOBS mid-iteration.
    queued = sorted((x for x in list(JOBS.values()) if x.get("status") == "queued"),
                    key=start_order_key)
    values = [start_order_key(x) for x in queued]
    i = next(n for n, x in enumerate(queued) if x is job)
    if action == "top":
        queued.insert(0, queued.pop(i)); i = 0
    elif action == "bottom":
        queued.append(queued.pop(i)); i = len(queued) - 1
    elif action == "up" and i > 0:
        queued[i - 1], queued[i] = queued[i], queued[i - 1]; i -= 1
    elif action == "down" and i < len(queued) - 1:
        queued[i + 1], queued[i] = queued[i], queued[i + 1]; i += 1
    # Hand the same sorted values back out in the new order: the relative
    # order against jobs created later is untouched.
    for x, v in zip(queued, values):
        x["priority"] = v
    return i


def _migrate_job(j):
    """Backfill v4 job fields on a restored pre-v4 (v3.3) snapshot dict so
    no code path can KeyError on fields added after the snapshot was made."""
    defaults = {
        "phase": "idle",
        "format_id": None, "target_format": None,
        "completed_ts": None,
        "size_total": 0, "size_done": 0, "speed": "", "error": None,
        "referer": None, "cookie": None, "user_agent": None,
        "created_ts": time.time(),
        # Session D. Deliberately NOT defaulted: "subdir" and "playlist_dir"
        # (playlist_dir's absence is what marks "not probed yet").
        "download_playlist": False,
        "playlist_id": None, "playlist_title": None,
        "playlist_index": None, "playlist_url": None,
        # v5
        "auto_name": False, "retry_count": 0, "retry_after": 0,
        "failed_ts": None,
    }
    for k, v in defaults.items():
        j.setdefault(k, v)
    j.setdefault("priority", j.get("created_ts") or time.time())
    # v5: backfill the source site from the file URL for older jobs.
    if "source_site" not in j:
        j["source_site"] = source_site_for(j.get("url"))
    return j


_PLAYLIST_FILE_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{3,} - ")


def resolve_playlist_dir(job):
    """Find the playlist folder a legacy whole-playlist job wrote into.

    Returns the folder name, or "" when there is not exactly one candidate
    (ambiguity resolves to "open the category folder", never to a guess).
    Candidate = immediate subfolder of the job's category dir holding a file
    named like "NNN - ..." modified inside this job's time window."""
    try:
        cat_dir = settings._dest_for(job).parent
        if not cat_dir.is_dir():
            return ""
        lo = (job.get("created_ts") or 0) - 60
        done_ts = job.get("completed_ts")
        hi = (done_ts + 300) if done_ts else None
        found = []
        for sub in cat_dir.iterdir():
            if not sub.is_dir():
                continue
            hit = False
            for i, f in enumerate(sub.iterdir()):
                if i > 5000:
                    break
                if not _PLAYLIST_FILE_RE.match(f.name):
                    continue
                try:
                    m = f.stat().st_mtime
                except OSError:
                    continue
                if m >= lo and (hi is None or m <= hi):
                    hit = True
                    break
            if hit:
                found.append(sub.name)
        return found[0] if len(found) == 1 else ""
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"playlist folder lookup failed for job {job.get('id')}: {e}")
        return ""


def _is_legacy_playlist_job(j):
    # Before Session D, download_playlist=True meant one job that walks a whole
    # playlist. Session D queues playlists as one job per item
    # (download_playlist=False, playlist_id set). download_playlist=True now
    # appears only on pre-Session-D jobs and on jobs made with "Legacy
    # whole-playlist mode" or by API callers - all share the batch-1 layout.
    return bool(j.get("download_playlist")) and not j.get("playlist_id")


def _migrate_playlist_dir(job):
    """One-shot: resolve the playlist folder for a legacy playlist job so the
    GUI can open it. Returns True when the job changed (caller saves once)."""
    if not _is_legacy_playlist_job(job) or "playlist_dir" in job:
        return False
    if job.get("status") not in ("done", "stopped", "error"):
        return False
    name = resolve_playlist_dir(job)
    job["playlist_dir"] = name
    if name:
        log(f"migrated playlist folder: job {job.get('id')} -> {name!r}")
    else:
        log(f"playlist folder not resolved for job {job.get('id')}")
    return True


def load_jobs_snapshot():
    if settings.JOBS_PATH.exists():
        try:
            snap = json.loads(settings.JOBS_PATH.read_text())
            migrated = False
            for jid, j in snap.items():
                j["pause_evt"] = threading.Event()
                j["stop_evt"] = threading.Event()
                _migrate_job(j)
                if j.get("status") in ("downloading", "queued", "held"):
                    repair_status(j, "stopped")
                JOBS[jid] = j
                _migrate_extensionless(j)
                if _repair_zero_size(j):
                    migrated = True
                if _migrate_playlist_dir(j):
                    migrated = True
            if migrated:
                save_jobs_snapshot()
            global JOB_COUNTER
            # Ignore non-numeric keys: int() on one used to raise, leave the
            # counter at 0, and let the next job reuse "1" and overwrite it.
            JOB_COUNTER = max([int(k) for k in JOBS.keys()
                               if str(k).isascii() and str(k).isdigit()] + [0])
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"couldn't load job history: {e}")



def next_job_id():
    global JOB_COUNTER
    with JOB_LOCK:
        JOB_COUNTER += 1
        # Never hand out an id that is already taken (a counter that fell
        # behind the loaded history would otherwise overwrite that job).
        while str(JOB_COUNTER) in JOBS:
            JOB_COUNTER += 1
        return str(JOB_COUNTER)



def _resolution_suffix(resolution):
    """1920x1080 -> 1080p; anything else -> alnum-only (may be empty)."""
    res = str(resolution or "").strip()
    m = re.match(r"^\d+x(\d+)$", res)
    if m:
        return f"{m.group(1)}p"
    return re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z]+", "", res)


def _playlist_subdir(title):
    """Folder name for a playlist's items: filesystem-safe, <= 60 chars,
    no trailing dots/spaces, "Playlist" when nothing usable is left."""
    if not str(title or "").strip():
        return "Playlist"
    name = safe_filename(str(title))[:60].rstrip(". ")
    return name or "Playlist"


def new_job(url, filename=None, category=None, referer=None, cookie=None,
            user_agent=None, job_type=None, format_id=None, target_format=None,
            resolution=None, multi=False, download_playlist=False, defer=False,
            playlist_id=None, playlist_title=None, playlist_index=None,
            playlist_url=None, snapshot=True, created_ts=None, page_url=None):
    log(f"new_job: filename={filename!r} url_basename={guess_filename(url)!r}")
    jid = next_job_id()
    jtype = job_type or detect_type(url)
    fname = safe_filename(filename) if filename else guess_filename(url)
    # Caller-supplied names (e.g. document.title from the extension) often
    # have no extension — borrow one from the URL, then Content-Type, then
    # fall back by job type.
    if not os.path.splitext(fname)[1]:
        ext = os.path.splitext(guess_filename(url))[1]
        if not ext:
            ext = guess_ext_from_head(url)
        if not ext:
            ext = ".mp4" if jtype == "ytdlp" else ".bin"
        if not fname.lower().endswith(ext.lower()):
            fname = fname + ext
    # Double-extension guard: a title/url combo can yield "name.mp4.mp4".
    # Collapse repeated trailing extensions ("name.mp4.mp4" -> "name.mp4").
    _b, _e = os.path.splitext(fname)
    while _e and _b.lower().endswith(_e.lower()):
        log(f"new_job: collapsing double extension {fname!r} -> {_b!r}")
        fname = _b
        _b, _e = os.path.splitext(fname)
    log(f"new_job: after extension logic fname={fname!r}")
    # v5 naming: strip "(3) " / " - YouTube" noise from caller-supplied
    # titles, and replace names that say nothing ("watch", "12345", "index")
    # with site_date_time. yt-dlp jobs flagged auto_name use the real video
    # title as the filename instead (see engines.download).
    auto_named = False
    _stem, _ext = os.path.splitext(fname)
    _clean = clean_title(_stem)
    if _clean and _clean != _stem:
        fname, _stem = _clean + _ext, _clean
    if is_junk_stem(_stem):
        # {domain}_{date}_{type}.{ext}; m3u8/mpd become mp4
        fname = safe_filename(generated_name(url, category, _ext))
        auto_named = not (multi and resolution)
        log(f"new_job: junk name {_stem!r} -> {fname!r} (auto_name={auto_named})")
    # Session 10: multi-quality checklist - when the caller queued several
    # formats for one URL, disambiguate with the resolution suffix
    # ("Video.mp4" -> "Video_1080p.mp4"). Single-format keeps old naming.
    if multi and resolution:
        suffix = _resolution_suffix(resolution)
        if suffix:
            _stem, _ext = os.path.splitext(fname)
            fname = f"{_stem}_{suffix}{_ext}"
            log(f"new_job: multi-quality suffix -> {fname!r}")
    job_cat = category or category_for(fname)

    # Apply per-site rules
    try:
        netloc = urlparse(url).netloc
    except ValueError:
        netloc = ""
    for rule in STATE.get("rules", []):
        if not isinstance(rule, dict):
            continue
        pattern = rule.get("domain", "").strip().lstrip("*.")
        if pattern and (netloc == pattern or netloc.endswith("." + pattern)):
            if "category" in rule:
                job_cat = rule["category"]
            break

    # Session D: per-item playlist jobs get their own folder under the
    # category dir (consumed only by settings._dest_for).
    subdir = _playlist_subdir(playlist_title) if playlist_title else None
    # new_job is the one place (besides repair_status at load time) that
    # seeds a job's status directly instead of going through transition():
    # a brand-new job has no prior state to transition from. It starts as
    # "queued" or "held" here, and becomes "skipped" below when its file
    # type is disabled. Every later change goes through transition().
    JOBS[jid] = {
        "id": jid, "url": url, "filename": fname,
        "category": job_cat,
        "type": jtype, "status": "held" if defer else "queued", "phase": "idle",
        "format_id": format_id, "target_format": target_format,
        "download_playlist": download_playlist,
        "playlist_id": playlist_id, "playlist_title": playlist_title,
        "playlist_index": playlist_index, "playlist_url": playlist_url,
        "completed_ts": None,
        "auto_name": auto_named,
        "source_site": source_site_for(page_url, referer, url),
        "retry_count": 0, "retry_after": 0,
        "priority": _next_priority(), "failed_ts": None,
        "size_total": 0, "size_done": 0, "speed": "", "error": None,
        "referer": referer, "cookie": cookie, "user_agent": user_agent,
        "created_ts": created_ts if created_ts is not None else time.time(),
        "pause_evt": threading.Event(), "stop_evt": threading.Event(),
    }
    if subdir:
        JOBS[jid]["subdir"] = subdir
    if playlist_id:
        log(f"new_job: playlist item {playlist_index} of {playlist_id!r} "
            f"-> subdir {subdir!r}")
    ext = os.path.splitext(fname)[1].lstrip(".").lower()
    if ext and STATE.get("file_types_overrides", {}).get(ext) is False:
        # Seeded directly (see the note above JOBS[jid]): there is no
        # SKIP transition because a skipped job never started.
        JOBS[jid]["status"] = "skipped"
        log(f"job {jid}: skipped — '.{ext}' is disabled in Options → File Types")
        if snapshot:
            save_jobs_snapshot()
        return jid
    if settings.get_shutdown_pending():
        os.system("shutdown /a")
        settings.set_shutdown_pending(False)
