QUIPS = [
    "Warming up the engines…",
    "Asking GitHub nicely…",
    "Building a backup cocoon…",
    "Greasing the gears…",
    "Counting every last byte…",
    "Almost there, probably…",
]

PHASES = [("check", "Check for updates"), ("backup", "Back up current version"),
          ("download", "Download"), ("extract", "Extract"),
          ("swap", "Install")]


class LogoMark(QWidget):
    """The app logo, redrawn as vectors and alive: the green arrow
    bobs down into the white tray; while a download runs the tray
    fills green in step with it; on success the arrow lands with a
    soft glow and stays home."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFixedSize(104, 104)
        self._mode = "working"        # working | downloading | done | failed
        self._fill = 0.0              # tray fill 0..1 (download progress)
        self._t = 0.0
        self._landed = 0.0            # glow strength after landing
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._timer.start(33)

    def set_mode(self, mode):
        self._mode = mode
        if mode == "done":
            self._landed = 1.0
        self.update()

    def set_fill(self, frac):
        self._fill = max(0.0, min(1.0, frac))
        self.update()

    def _tick(self):
        self._t += 0.033
        if self._mode == "done" and self._landed > 0:
            self._landed = max(0.0, self._landed - 0.02)
        self.update()

    def _bob(self):
        import math
        if self._mode == "done":
            return 6.0
        if self._mode == "failed":
            return 0.0
        speed = 2.6 if self._mode == "downloading" else 1.8
        return (math.sin(self._t * speed) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 6.0

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QRectF
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        scale = min(self.width(), self.height()) / 100.0
        p.scale(scale, scale)
        green = QColor(BRAND["green"])
        tray_col = QColor(BRAND["tray"])
        if self._mode == "failed":
            green = QColor("#c2554f")
            tray_col = QColor("#9aa3ad")

        # tile
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(BRAND["tile_edge"]), 1.4))
        p.setBrush(QColor(BRAND["tile"]))
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(5, 5, 90, 90), 20, 20)

        bob = self._bob()
        # landing glow (pulses with the bob; flashes on done)
        glow_a = 0
        if self._mode in ("working", "downloading"):
            glow_a = int(40 + 60 * (bob / 6.0))
        elif self._mode == "done":
            glow_a = int(120 * self._landed) + 30
        if glow_a > 0:
            g = QColor(green)
            g.setAlpha(min(glow_a, 140))
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(g)
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(50, 79), 21, 5.5)

        # tray fill (download progress pooling in the tray)
        if self._fill > 0:
            fh = 12.0 * self._fill
            g = QColor(green)
            g.setAlpha(190)
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(g)
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(34.5, 74 - fh, 31, fh), 3, 3)

        # tray (white U, proportions from the icon master)
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.moveTo(29.5, 55)
        path.lineTo(29.5, 69)
        path.quadTo(29.5, 77, 37.5, 77)
        path.lineTo(62.5, 77)
        path.quadTo(70.5, 77, 70.5, 69)
        path.lineTo(70.5, 55)
        p.setPen(QPen(tray_col, 5.6, Qt.SolidLine, Qt.RoundCap, Qt.RoundJoin))
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.drawPath(path)

        # arrow (flat green, geometry from the icon master; the same-
        # colour round-joined stroke softens the corners like the icon)
        arrow = QPainterPath()
        arrow.moveTo(45, 17)
        arrow.lineTo(55, 17)
        arrow.lineTo(55, 37)
        arrow.lineTo(64, 37)
        arrow.lineTo(50, 64)
        arrow.lineTo(36, 37)
        arrow.lineTo(45, 37)
        arrow.closeSubpath()
        p.save()
        p.translate(0, bob)
        p.setPen(QPen(green, 1.8, Qt.SolidLine, Qt.RoundCap, Qt.RoundJoin))
        p.setBrush(green)
        p.drawPath(arrow)
        p.restore()
        p.end()


class UpdaterWindow(QWidget):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Video Grabber - Updating")
        self.resize(470, 404)
        self.setStyleSheet(QSS)
        lay = QVBoxLayout(self)
        lay.setAlignment(Qt.AlignTop)

        self.logo = LogoMark()
        lay.addWidget(self.logo, alignment=Qt.AlignHCenter)
        t = QLabel("Updating Video Grabber")
        t.setObjectName("title")
        t.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        lay.addWidget(t)
        self.quip = QLabel("")
        self.quip.setObjectName("quip")
        self.quip.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        lay.addWidget(self.quip)
        self.status = QLabel("Preparing…")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.status.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        lay.addWidget(self.status)

        self.steps = {}
        for key, label in PHASES:
            row = QLabel(f"○  {label}")
            row.setProperty("class", "step")
            row.setStyleSheet("color: #69758a; font-size: 12px;")
            lay.addWidget(row)
            self.steps[key] = row

        self.bar = QProgressBar()
        self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        lay.addWidget(self.bar)
        self._bar_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self.bar, b"value", self)
        self._bar_anim.setDuration(240)
        self._bar_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self.stats = QLabel("")
        self.stats.setObjectName("stats")
        self.stats.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        lay.addWidget(self.stats)

        self.close_btn = QPushButton("Close")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.close_btn.clicked.connect(self.close)
        lay.addWidget(self.close_btn, alignment=Qt.AlignRight)

        self._quip_i = 0
        self._quip_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._quip_timer.timeout.connect(self._next_quip)
        self._quip_timer.start(2800)

        self.exit_code = 0
        self.worker = UpdateWorker()
        self.worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self.worker.status.connect(self.status.setText)
        self.worker.phase.connect(self._on_phase)
        self.worker.stats.connect(self.stats.setText)
        self.worker.finished_ok.connect(self._ok)
        self.worker.failed.connect(self._fail)
        self.worker.start()

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        # Never let a stray close kill the worker mid-swap and report
        # exit 0 (success) to the supervisor for a half-written app:
        # while an update is running, the window simply refuses to
        # close. (This guard existed in the pre-animation updater and
        # was lost in the rewrite; the Close button below is the way
        # out once the worker has finished.)
        if self.worker.isRunning():
            self.status.setText("Updating... please wait for it to finish.")
            event.ignore()
            return
        event.accept()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- slots ---
    _busy = False

    def _next_quip(self):
        if self._busy:
            self._quip_i = (self._quip_i + 1) % len(QUIPS)
            self.quip.setText(QUIPS[self._quip_i])

    def _on_phase(self, phase):
        order = [k for k, _ in PHASES]
        idx = order.index(phase) if phase in order else len(order)
        for i, (key, label) in enumerate(PHASES):
            row = self.steps[key]
            if phase == "done" or i < idx:
                row.setText(f"✓  {label}")
                row.setStyleSheet("color: #4caf50; font-size: 12px;")
            elif i == idx:
                row.setText(f"◉  {label}")
                row.setStyleSheet("color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px;")
            else:
                row.setText(f"○  {label}")
                row.setStyleSheet("color: #69758a; font-size: 12px;")
        self._busy = phase in ("check", "extract", "swap")
        if self._busy:
            self._bar_anim.stop()
            self.bar.setRange(0, 0)            # indeterminate pulse
            self.quip.setText(QUIPS[self._quip_i])
        else:
            if self.bar.maximum() == 0:
                self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
            self.quip.setText("")
        if phase == "download":
            self.logo.set_mode("downloading")
        elif phase == "done":
            self.logo.set_mode("done")

    def _on_progress(self, value):
        if value <= 25:
            frac = value / 25.0 * 0.15
        elif value <= 70:
            frac = 0.15 + (value - 25) / 45.0 * 0.85
        else:
            frac = 1.0
        self.logo.set_fill(frac)
        if self.bar.maximum() == 0:
            return
        self._bar_anim.stop()
        self._bar_anim.setStartValue(self.bar.value())
        self._bar_anim.setEndValue(value)
        self._bar_anim.start()

    def _ok(self, msg):
        self.stats.setText("")
        self.status.setText(msg)
        self._on_phase("done")
        if self.bar.maximum() == 0:
            self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        self.bar.setValue(100)
        self.logo.set_mode("done")
        self.exit_code = 0
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        QTimer.singleShot(1400, self.close)

    def _fail(self, msg):
        self.status.setText(f"Update failed: {msg}\nThe supervisor will try the "
                            "fallback updater, or relaunch the current version.")
        self.logo.set_mode("failed")
        self.quip.setText("")
        if self.bar.maximum() == 0:
            self.bar.setRange(0, 100)
        self.exit_code = 2
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    win = UpdaterWindow()
    win.show()
    app.exec()
    return win.exit_code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
# vg_state.py: the ONE shared state module for the Supervisor
# Architecture (contract section 2). Stdlib only. Imported by
# launcher.py (bundled into the supervisor exe), updater_ui.py and
# gui_qt.py (shipped in app\), and recovery_ui.py (bundled into
# recovery.exe). Before this module existed, the state and lock code
# lived in four hand-synced copies; they had already started to drift.
#
# The contract, in one place:
#   state file  %LOCALAPPDATA%\VideoGrabber\recovery_state.json
#               (VG_STATE_DIR overrides the directory, for tests)
#   lock        recovery_state.lock next to it, content "pid:token"
#   writes      atomic: write tmp file, os.replace over the real one
#   unknown     keys in the JSON are preserved on rewrite
#   runs[] and  fix_attempts[] are pruned to the newest 20 on save
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

# The state format is FROZEN at this version (post-audit fix 4):
# vg_state.py is bundled into the long-lived supervisor AND shipped
# in app\ where thin updates replace it, so the two copies can be
# different ages. A copy that meets a state file written by a NEWER
# schema refuses to run instead of guessing at fields it does not
# know. Raising this number is a deliberate, breaking act.
SCHEMA_VERSION = 1

STATE_FILENAME = "recovery_state.json"
LOCK_FILENAME = "recovery_state.lock"
LOG_FILENAME = "recovery.log"
LOG_ROTATE_BYTES = 512_000

DEFAULT_STATE = {
    "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
    "crash_count": 0,
    "last_good_version": None,
    "blacklist": [],
    "runs": [],
    "update_pending": False,
    "last_paths": {"data_home": "", "install_dir": ""},
    "last_release_list": [],
    "current_version": None,
    "fix_attempts": [],
    "last_update_result": None,
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- paths ----
def state_dir() -> Path:
    override = os.environ.get("VG_STATE_DIR")
    if override:
        return Path(override)
    base = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA")
    if base:
        return Path(base) / "VideoGrabber"
    return Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local" / "VideoGrabber"


def state_file() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / STATE_FILENAME


def lock_file() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / LOCK_FILENAME


def log_file() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / LOG_FILENAME


def backups_dir() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / "backups"


def staging_dir() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / "staging"


def boot_flag() -> Path:
    return state_dir() / "boot_recovery.flag"


def install_root(dev_fallback=None) -> Path:
    """Where the install lives. VG_INSTALL_ROOT wins (the supervisor
    sets it for the updater); then the path recorded in state; then,
    frozen, the exe's folder (or its parent for the recovery folder, which sits
    one level down); in source runs the caller's own folder stands in.
    """
    override = os.environ.get("VG_INSTALL_ROOT")
    if override:
        return Path(override)
    try:
        recorded = (load_state().get("last_paths") or {}).get("install_dir") or ""
    except Exception:
        recorded = ""
    if recorded and Path(recorded).is_dir():
        return Path(recorded)
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        exe_dir = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
        return exe_dir.parent if exe_dir.name.lower() == "recovery" else exe_dir
    if dev_fallback is not None:
        return Path(dev_fallback)
    return Path.cwd()


# ------------------------------------------------------------ processes ----
def pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
    if not pid or pid <= 0:
        return False
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            import ctypes
            k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
            handle = k32.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)  # QUERY_LIMITED
            if not handle:
                return False
            code = ctypes.c_ulong(0)
            k32.GetExitCodeProcess(handle, ctypes.byref(code))
            k32.CloseHandle(handle)
            return code.value == 259  # STILL_ACTIVE
        except Exception:
            return False
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 0)
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- lock ----
class StateLock:
    """PID + token lock for the state file.

    Stale takeover (the owner pid is dead) is done by ATOMIC RENAME,
    never by unlinking the live path: the old code unlinked the path
    directly, and in the gap another process could create a FRESH lock
    that the unlink then deleted. Here the stale file is renamed to a
    private grave name first; its content is re-read from the grave
    and compared with what we decided was stale; only an exact match
    is deleted. If the grave holds someone else's fresh lock, it is
    renamed back untouched and we simply wait.

    A lock whose owner is alive is never taken. If a live writer holds
    the lock past the timeout we proceed WITHOUT it (and say so via
    the logger): a lock must never brick the app it protects.
    """

    def __init__(self, timeout: float = 2.5, path: Path = None, logger=None):
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.path = Path(path) if path else lock_file()
        self.logger = logger
        self.held = False
        self._borrowed = False
        self._token = uuid.uuid4().hex

    def _content(self) -> str:
        return f"{os.getpid()}:{self._token}"

    @staticmethod
    def _parse(raw: str):
        raw = (raw or "").strip()
        if ":" in raw:
            pid_s, _, token = raw.partition(":")
        else:
            pid_s, token = raw, ""
        try:
            return int(pid_s or 0), token
        except ValueError:
            return 0, token

    def _read(self):
        try:
            return self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError:
            return None

    def __enter__(self):
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        deadline = time.time() + self.timeout
        while True:
            try:
                fd = os.open(str(self.path),
                             os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
                os.write(fd, self._content().encode())
                os.close(fd)
                self.held = True
                return self
            except FileExistsError:
                raw = self._read()
                if raw is None:
                    continue  # vanished between create and read; retry
                pid, token = self._parse(raw)
                if pid == 0:
                    # An empty or unparseable lock: either a creator
                    # caught mid-write (a window of microseconds) or
                    # the corpse of one killed between create and
                    # write. Only the corpse is safe to take, so age
                    # decides: untouched for 5 s means abandoned.
                    # (Before this, a pid-0 lock was NEVER stale, and
                    # every writer burned its full timeout and then
                    # proceeded unlocked, forever.)
                    try:
                        age = time.time() - self.path.stat().st_mtime
                    except OSError:
                        age = 99.0
                    if age > 5.0 and self._take_over_stale(raw):
                        continue
                if pid == os.getpid():
                    # Same process already holds it (nested mutate):
                    # borrow it; our exit must not release the outer lock.
                    self.held = True
                    self._borrowed = True
                    return self
                if pid and not pid_alive(pid):
                    if self._take_over_stale(raw):
                        continue  # stale lock disposed of; retry create
                if time.time() >= deadline:
                    if self.logger:
                        self.logger(
                            f"state lock held by live pid {pid}; "
                            "proceeding unlocked")
                    return self
                time.sleep(0.05)
            except OSError:
                return self

    def _take_over_stale(self, expected_raw: str) -> bool:
        """Rename the stale lock aside and verify it really is the
        stale file we read. Returns True when the path is now clear
        (or the stale file is disposed of), False to keep waiting."""
        grave = self.path.with_name(
            self.path.name + f".stale-{os.getpid()}-{self._token[:8]}")
        try:
            os.replace(self.path, grave)
        except OSError:
            return False  # someone else moved it first; re-read and wait
        try:
            grave_raw = grave.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError:
            grave_raw = None
        if grave_raw is not None and grave_raw.strip() != (expected_raw or "").strip():
            # We renamed a FRESH lock that replaced the stale one in
            # the gap. Put it back untouched; never delete it.
            try:
                if not self.path.exists():
                    os.replace(grave, self.path)
            except OSError:
                pass
            return False
        try:
            grave.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        return True

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        if self.held and not self._borrowed:
            try:
                raw = self._read()
                if raw is not None:
                    _, token = self._parse(raw)
                    if token == self._token:
                        self.path.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.held = False
        return False


def schema_gate_error():
    """None when the on-disk state is safe for this copy to touch; a
    message when its schema_version is NEWER than SCHEMA_VERSION
    (post-audit fix 4). A missing or unreadable file is fine: the
    load path already falls back to defaults."""
    try:
        data = json.loads(state_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        v = data.get("schema_version")
        if isinstance(v, int) and v > SCHEMA_VERSION:
            return (f"recovery_state.json has schema_version {v}, but "
                    f"this build only understands {SCHEMA_VERSION}. "
                    "Update Video Grabber (full setup) before running "
                    "this component.")
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- state ----
def load_state() -> dict:
    try:
        data = json.loads(state_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            merged = dict(DEFAULT_STATE)
            merged.update(data)          # unknown keys are preserved
            return merged
    except Exception:
        pass
    return dict(DEFAULT_STATE)


def save_state(state: dict) -> None:
    state_dir().mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    state["runs"] = list(state.get("runs") or [])[-20:]
    state["fix_attempts"] = list(state.get("fix_attempts") or [])[-20:]
    tmp = state_dir() / f"{STATE_FILENAME}.tmp-{os.getpid()}"
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, state_file())        # atomic


_MUTATE_RLOCK = threading.RLock()


def mutate_state(fn, logger=None):
    """Read-modify-write under the state lock. fn(state) -> result."""
    with _MUTATE_RLOCK:
        with StateLock(logger=logger):
            state = load_state()
            result = fn(state)
            save_state(state)
            return result


# ------------------------------------------------------- update results ----
def set_update_result(tag, ok: bool, message: str) -> None:
    def _set(state):
        state["last_update_result"] = {
            "tag": tag, "ok": bool(ok), "message": str(message),
            "time": int(time.time())}
    mutate_state(_set)


def pop_update_result():
    """Read last_update_result and clear it in the same locked pass,
    so the GUI shows it exactly once."""
    def _pop(state):
        result = state.get("last_update_result")
        state["last_update_result"] = None
        return result
    return mutate_state(_pop)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ log ----
def recovery_log(msg: str, source: str = "recovery") -> None:
    """Append to recovery.log, rotating at 512 KB (one .1 kept)."""
    try:
        state_dir().mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = log_file()
        try:
            if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > LOG_ROTATE_BYTES:
                os.replace(path, path.with_name(path.name + ".1"))
        except OSError:
            pass
        with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} {source} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- hashes ---
def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
"""ytdlp_update.py: update yt-dlp without shipping a new app release (v5).

How it works
  * update_ytdlp() downloads the newest yt-dlp wheel from PyPI, verifies its
    sha256, and stages the `yt_dlp` package in <data>/ytdlp-pending/.
    Nothing the running process has imported is touched.
  * activate() runs at startup, BEFORE yt_dlp is imported. It promotes a
    ready pending update to <data>/ytdlp-override/ and, when that override
    is newer than the bundled copy, puts it first on sys.path so it shadows
    the bundled package. Plugins (bgutil etc.) and yt-dlp's optional extras
    keep coming from the bundled site-packages.
  * rollback() deletes the override so the bundled version is used again.

Updates take effect on the next app launch. Source runs without a
LOCALAPPDATA directory use ~/.videograbber instead.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

from logging_setup import log

PYPI_JSON = "https://pypi.org/pypi/yt-dlp/json"
_VER_RE = re.compile(r"__version__\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]")

# Last result of check/update, for /update-status.
STATUS = {"checked_ts": 0, "latest": "", "staged": "", "error": ""}


def _data_dir():
    base = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA")
    root = Path(base) / "VideoGrabber" if base else Path.home() / ".videograbber"
    return root / "ytdlp"


def _override_dir():
    return _data_dir() / "ytdlp-override"


def _pending_dir():
    return _data_dir() / "ytdlp-pending"


def version_key(v):
    """'2026.08.19' / '2026.8.19.123' -> comparable tuple of ints."""
    return tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", v or "")) or (0,)


def _read_pkg_version(root):
    try:
        text = (Path(root) / "yt_dlp" / "version.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        m = _VER_RE.search(text)
        return m.group(1) if m else ""
    except OSError:
        return ""


def bundled_version():
    try:
        from importlib.metadata import version, PackageNotFoundError
        try:
            return version("yt-dlp")
        except PackageNotFoundError:
            return ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def override_version():
    return _read_pkg_version(_override_dir())


def active_version():
    """Version yt-dlp will actually run (or is running)."""
    if "yt_dlp" in sys.modules:
        try:
            from yt_dlp.version import __version__
            return __version__
        except Exception:
            pass
    ov, bv = override_version(), bundled_version()
    if ov and version_key(ov) > version_key(bv):
        return ov
    return bv or ov


def activate():
    """Call once at startup before anything imports yt_dlp."""
    try:
        _promote_pending()
        ov = override_version()
        if not ov:
            return
        bv = bundled_version()
        if bv and version_key(ov) <= version_key(bv):
            log(f"yt-dlp override {ov} is not newer than bundled {bv}; ignoring")
            return
        if "yt_dlp" in sys.modules:
            log(f"yt-dlp override {ov} found but yt_dlp is already imported; "
                f"it will apply after the next restart")
            return
        sys.path.insert(0, str(_override_dir()))
        log(f"yt-dlp override active: {ov} (bundled: {bv or 'unknown'})")
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"yt-dlp override activation failed (using bundled): {e}")


def _promote_pending():
    pend, over = _pending_dir(), _override_dir()
    if not (pend / "READY").is_file() or not (pend / "yt_dlp").is_dir():
        return
    old = over.with_name(over.name + ".old")
    try:
        if old.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(old, ignore_errors=True)
        if over.exists():
            over.rename(old)
        pend.rename(over)
        (over / "READY").unlink(missing_ok=True)
        log(f"yt-dlp update applied: {override_version()}")
    except OSError as e:
        log(f"yt-dlp update could not be applied: {e}")
        # Put the previous override back if the swap half-completed.
        try:
            if old.exists() and not over.exists():
                old.rename(over)
        except OSError:
            pass


def rollback():
    """Remove the override (and any staged update); bundled yt-dlp is used
    again after restart. Returns True if something was removed."""
    removed = False
    for d in (_override_dir(), _pending_dir(),
              _override_dir().with_name("ytdlp-override.old")):
        if d.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
            removed = True
    if removed:
        log("yt-dlp override removed; bundled version applies after restart")
    return removed


def _get(url, timeout=30):
    req = Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "VideoGrabber-ytdlp-update"})
    return urlopen(req, timeout=timeout)


def check_latest():
    """Return (latest_version, wheel_url, sha256) from PyPI."""
    with _get(PYPI_JSON, 20) as r:
        data = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    latest = (data.get("info") or {}).get("version") or ""
    for f in data.get("urls") or []:
        name = f.get("filename") or ""
        if f.get("packagetype") == "bdist_wheel" and name.endswith("py3-none-any.whl"):
            return latest, f.get("url"), (f.get("digests") or {}).get("sha256", "")
    raise RuntimeError("no universal wheel found on PyPI")


def update_ytdlp(force=False):
    """Stage the newest yt-dlp if it is newer than the active version.
    Returns a status dict; never raises."""
    STATUS["checked_ts"] = time.time()
    STATUS["error"] = ""
    try:
        latest, url, sha = check_latest()
        STATUS["latest"] = latest
        current = active_version()
        if not force and version_key(latest) <= version_key(current):
            log(f"yt-dlp {current} is up to date (latest {latest})")
            return {"updated": False, "current": current, "latest": latest}
        if not url or not sha:
            raise RuntimeError("PyPI response missing wheel url or checksum")
        pend = _pending_dir()
        if pend.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(pend, ignore_errors=True)
        pend.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        whl = pend / "yt_dlp.whl"
        log(f"yt-dlp: downloading {latest}")
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with _get(url, 120) as r, open(whl, "wb") as f:
            while True:
                chunk = r.read(1 << 16)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                h.update(chunk)
                f.write(chunk)
        if h.hexdigest().lower() != sha.lower():
            raise RuntimeError("checksum mismatch; download discarded")
        pend_real = pend.resolve()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(whl) as zf:
            members = [m for m in zf.infolist()
                       if m.filename.startswith("yt_dlp/") and not m.is_dir()]
            if not members:
                raise RuntimeError("wheel has no yt_dlp package")
            for m in members:
                target = (pend / m.filename).resolve()
                if not target.is_relative_to(pend_real):
                    raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe path in wheel: {m.filename}")
            for m in members:
                zf.extract(m, pend)
        whl.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        got = _read_pkg_version(pend)
        if got != latest:
            raise RuntimeError(f"staged version {got!r} does not match {latest!r}")
        (pend / "READY").write_text(latest, encoding="utf-8")
        STATUS["staged"] = latest
        log(f"yt-dlp {latest} staged; applies on next app launch")
        return {"updated": True, "current": current, "latest": latest}
    except Exception as e:
        STATUS["error"] = str(e)
        log(f"yt-dlp update failed: {e}")
        shutil.rmtree(_pending_dir(), ignore_errors=True)
        return {"updated": False, "error": str(e)}


def status():
    return {
        "bundled": bundled_version(),
        "override": override_version(),
        "active": active_version(),
        "staged": STATUS["staged"] or (
            (_pending_dir() / "READY").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
            if (_pending_dir() / "READY").is_file() else ""),
        "latest": STATUS["latest"],
        "checked_ts": STATUS["checked_ts"],
        "error": STATUS["error"],
    }
# AppHost.spec — the app host (app_host.py, the former launcher),
# frozen as VideoGrabberApp.exe. Onedir, windowed, thin: PySide6 /
# numpy / PIL / yt-dlp are loaded at runtime from
# runtime\site-packages, never bundled here.
#
# hiddenimports is GENERATED, not curated. History: yt_dlp, requests
# and flask are excluded from the analysis and loaded at runtime, so
# PyInstaller never sees their import graphs, and the frozen host
# died one module at a time (http.cookies, logging.handlers,
# optparse, xml.etree, fileinput, ...) as each was hand-added to a
# list. A curated list can only ever contain the modules that have
# already crashed, so this spec enumerates the standard library of
# the build Python from disk instead.
#
# The enumeration is fenced to the TRUE standard library, three
# ways, because the first version of this generator also walked a
# root that contained the build machine's site-packages, named
# third-party submodules as hidden imports, dragged numpy into the
# host (its PyInstaller hook bundles numpy.libs), and tripped the
# pipeline's "host stays thin" check:
#   1. only the sysconfig "stdlib" root is walked (plus DLLs\ for
#      the C accelerators); "platstdlib" is NOT trusted, it can
#      point at the whole installation;
#   2. any "site-packages" directory met during the walk is pruned;
#   3. every surviving name must have its top-level component in
#      sys.stdlib_module_names, and the heavy excluded packages are
#      filtered out by name as a final belt-and-braces pass.
# Test suites and the Tk GUI toolkit are skipped (the app never
# uses them and they bloat or destabilise the build). Unresolvable
# names are warnings to PyInstaller, never errors.
import os
import sys
import sysconfig


def _all_stdlib_hiddenimports():
    skip_dirs = {"__pycache__", "test", "tests", "idlelib",
                 "turtledemo", "tkinter", "turtle", "site-packages"}
    roots = set()
    try:
        p = sysconfig.get_path("stdlib")
        if p:
            roots.add(p)
    except Exception:
        pass
    # Windows builds keep the C accelerator modules in DLLs\
    roots.add(os.path.join(sys.base_prefix, "DLLs"))
    names = set()
    for base in roots:
        if not base or not os.path.isdir(base):
            continue
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip_dirs]
            rel = os.path.relpath(root, base)
            pkg = "" if rel == "." else rel.replace(os.sep, ".")
            if pkg.split(".")[0] in skip_dirs:
                continue
            for f in files:
                if not f.endswith((".py", ".pyd", ".so")):
                    continue
                stem = f.split(".")[0]
                if not stem.isidentifier():
                    continue
                if stem == "__init__":
                    if pkg:
                        names.add(pkg)
                else:
                    names.add(pkg + "." + stem if pkg else stem)
    # Fence 3a: nothing whose top level is not a genuine stdlib
    # module of THIS Python may survive, wherever the walk went.
    stdlib_tops = getattr(sys, "stdlib_module_names", None)
    if stdlib_tops is not None:
        names = {n for n in names if n.split(".")[0] in stdlib_tops}
    # Fence 3b: the excluded heavyweights, by name, unconditionally.
    heavy = ("numpy", "PIL", "PySide6", "yt_dlp", "streamlink")
    names = {n for n in names if n.split(".")[0] not in heavy}
    # Fence 3c: modules that only drag Tcl/Tk or demo code into the host.
    unwanted = {"turtle", "_tkinter", "tkinter", "idlelib", "turtledemo",
                "ensurepip", "this", "antigravity", "__phello__"}
    names = {n for n in names if n.split(".")[0] not in unwanted}
    return sorted(names)


def _runtime_dlls():
    """DLLs the thin host must carry so PySide6 / shiboken6 can load from
    runtime\\site-packages. PySide6 wheels are abi3 builds that link
    python3.dll (the stable-ABI forwarder), which PyInstaller does not
    bundle on its own (it only ships python3XX.dll), and Qt needs the
    MSVC C++ runtime. PyInstaller never saw these dependencies because
    PySide6 is excluded from the analysis. Existing files only."""
    found = []
    p = os.path.join(sys.base_prefix, "python3.dll")
    if os.path.isfile(p):
        found.append((p, "."))
    sysdir = os.path.join(os.environ.get("SystemRoot", r"C:\Windows"), "System32")
    for n in ("msvcp140.dll", "msvcp140_1.dll", "msvcp140_2.dll",
              "vcruntime140_1.dll", "concrt140.dll"):
        p = os.path.join(sysdir, n)
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            found.append((p, "."))
    print("AppHost.spec: extra runtime DLLs:", [os.path.basename(x[0]) for x in found])
    return found


a = Analysis(
    ['app_host.py'],
    pathex=[],
    binaries=_runtime_dlls(),
    datas=[],
    hiddenimports=_all_stdlib_hiddenimports() + [
        # Third-party modules we are now bundling
        'requests', 'flask',
    ],
    hookspath=[],
    runtime_hooks=[],
    excludes=['numpy', 'PIL', 'PySide6', 'yt_dlp', 'streamlink'],
    noarchive=False,
)
pyz = PYZ(a.pure)
exe = EXE(
    pyz, a.scripts, [],

    name='VideoGrabberApp',
    debug=False, bootloader_ignore_signals=False, strip=False,

rem restore.bat: manual rollback. Moves app.old\, VideoGrabberApp.exe.old
rem and VideoGrabberApp_internal.old back into place, then relaunches
rem (VideoGrabber.exe is the supervisor; it starts the app). Refuses to
rem run while the app host (VideoGrabberApp.exe) is open: Windows file
rem locks. Optional %1 overrides the install root; the default is this
rem script's own folder, which IS the install root (fix 16: no
rem hardcoded user path ships in the zip).
rem Note: Recovery's Restore Backup (AppData backups) is the primary
rem path; this script covers the updater's .old copies.

if not defined ROOT set "ROOT=%~dp0"
if "%ROOT:~-1%"=="\" set "ROOT=%ROOT:~0,-1%"

tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq VideoGrabberApp.exe" 2>NUL | find /I "VideoGrabberApp.exe" >NUL
if not errorlevel 1 (
    echo restore.bat: Video Grabber is still running - close Video Grabber first.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)

if not exist "%ROOT%\app.old" (
    echo restore.bat: no app.old in "%ROOT%" - nothing to restore.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)

rem The current app\ is the broken one; the rollback copy replaces it.
if exist "%ROOT%\app" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\app"

if errorlevel 1 (
    echo restore.bat: restore failed - rename app.old failed.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)

    if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" del /f /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" 2>NUL
    rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" "VideoGrabberApp.exe"
    if errorlevel 1 (
        echo restore.bat: restore failed - rename VideoGrabberApp.exe.old failed. Not relaunching a mixed install.
        endlocal
        exit /b 1
    )
)

    if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal"
    rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old" "VideoGrabberApp_internal"
    if errorlevel 1 (
        echo restore.bat: restore failed - rename VideoGrabberApp_internal.old failed. Not relaunching a mixed install.
        endlocal
        exit /b 1
    )
)

@echo off
setlocal enableextensions
rem updater.bat: the post-exit swapper. Called by the supervisor in
rem two situations:
rem   (a) FALLBACK: updater_ui.py exited non-zero. The bat performs
rem       the whole swap from the pkg the updater staged.
rem   (b) HOST mode (%4 = "host"): updater_ui succeeded but staged
rem       host files (VideoGrabberApp.exe / VideoGrabberApp_internal).
rem       It cannot swap those itself: its own process is running
rem       inside them. The supervisor calls the bat once that process
rem       has exited, and the bat swaps ONLY the host files.
rem Arguments: %1 = install root, %2 = staged pkg, %3 = release tag,
rem %4 = optional mode ("host").
rem
rem Discipline: renames always work where deletes fail; every step is
rem error-checked; on failure we roll back only what THIS run changed
rem (DID_* flags, reverse order). The pkg is COPIED from, never moved
rem or deleted, so a failed rollback can never destroy the only copy
rem of the new files; staging is wiped by the next update run. This
rem script never launches the app: the supervisor relaunches.

set "ROOT=%~1"
set "PKG=%~2"
set "NEWTAG=%~3"
set "MODE=%~4"
set "DID_APP="
set "DID_EXE="
set "DID_INT="

if not defined ROOT (echo usage: updater.bat ^<install-root^> ^<staged-pkg^> ^<tag^> [host] & exit /b 1)
if not defined PKG  (echo usage: updater.bat ^<install-root^> ^<staged-pkg^> ^<tag^> [host] & exit /b 1)

rem Wait for the app host to exit, at most ~30 seconds (fix 9: the
rem old loop waited forever, and a ghost host would hang the whole
rem update with the supervisor blocked inside this call). The match
rem is by full image path under THIS install root where PowerShell
rem can answer; the name-only tasklist check is the fallback for when
rem PowerShell itself cannot run.
set /a TRIES=0
:waitloop
set "RUNNING="
set "PSCHECK="
for /f "delims=" %%P in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-Process VideoGrabberApp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like '%ROOT%\*' }; if ($p) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }" 2^>NUL') do set "PSCHECK=%%P"
if "%PSCHECK%"=="yes" set "RUNNING=1"
if "%PSCHECK%"=="" (
    tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq VideoGrabberApp.exe" 2>NUL | find /I "VideoGrabberApp.exe" >NUL
    if not errorlevel 1 set "RUNNING=1"
)
if defined RUNNING (
    set /a TRIES+=1
    if %TRIES% GEQ 30 (
        echo updater.bat: VideoGrabberApp.exe still running after ~30s - aborting untouched.
        endlocal
        exit /b 1
    )
    timeout /t 1 /nobreak >NUL
    goto waitloop
)

if "%MODE%"=="host" goto :host_preflight

rem Preflight (full mode): refuse to touch anything unless BOTH the
rem staged pkg and the current install look like real app folders.
if not exist "%PKG%\app\server.py" (
    echo updater.bat: staged pkg has no app\server.py - aborting untouched.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)
if not exist "%ROOT%\app\server.py" (
    echo updater.bat: no app\server.py at "%ROOT%" - nothing to update.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)
goto :clear_leftovers

:host_preflight
if not exist "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" if not exist "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" (
    echo updater.bat: host mode but the pkg has no host files - aborting untouched.
    endlocal
    exit /b 1
)

:clear_leftovers
rem Clear leftovers from a previous aborted cycle BEFORE renaming
rem anything, so a rollback can never mistake a stale copy for this
rem run's backup. In host mode the app folder is not ours to clear.
if not "%MODE%"=="host" if exist "%ROOT%\app.old" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\app.old"
if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" del /f /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" 2>NUL
if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old"

if not "%MODE%"=="host" if exist "%ROOT%\app.old" goto :blocked
if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" goto :blocked
if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old" goto :blocked
goto :swap

:blocked
echo updater.bat: previous update leftovers are locked - aborting untouched.
endlocal
exit /b 1

:swap
if "%MODE%"=="host" goto :swap_exe
rename "%ROOT%\app" "app.old"
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
set "DID_APP=1"
robocopy "%PKG%\app" "%ROOT%\app" /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP >NUL
if errorlevel 8 goto :fail

:swap_exe
rem App host exe: rename-then-replace (del on an .exe is unreliable).
if not exist "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" goto :no_exe
if not exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" goto :copy_exe
rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" "VideoGrabberApp.exe.old"
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
set "DID_EXE=1"
:copy_exe
copy /y "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" >NUL
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
set "DID_EXE=1"
:no_exe

rem The host's bundled bits ride in the zip too; same rename pattern.
if not exist "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" goto :no_internal
if not exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" goto :copy_internal
rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" "VideoGrabberApp_internal.old"
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
set "DID_INT=1"
:copy_internal
robocopy "%PKG%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" /E /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP >NUL
if errorlevel 8 goto :fail
set "DID_INT=1"
:no_internal

rem Supervisor files are never in a thin package (contract: the
rem supervisor ships with the full setup only, like Recovery).

rem Stamp the installed version so update checks compare against
rem what is actually on disk.
if defined NEWTAG (echo %NEWTAG%)> "%ROOT%\install-version.txt"

endlocal
exit /b 0

:fail
rem Roll back only what THIS run changed, in reverse order.
if "%DID_INT%"=="1" (
    if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old" (
        if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal"
        rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal.old" "VideoGrabberApp_internal"
    ) else (
        rem No .old means this run copied the folder onto an install
        rem that had none; rolling back removes the copy, so a failed
        rem swap never leaves half of the new host behind.
        if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp_internal"
    )
)
if "%DID_EXE%"=="1" (
    if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" (
        if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" del /f /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" 2>NUL
        rename "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe.old" "VideoGrabberApp.exe"
    ) else (
        rem Same rule for the exe: no .old, so delete the copy.
        if exist "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" del /f /q "%ROOT%\VideoGrabberApp.exe" 2>NUL
    )
)
if "%DID_APP%"=="1" (
    if exist "%ROOT%\app.old" (
        if exist "%ROOT%\app" rmdir /s /q "%ROOT%\app"
        rename "%ROOT%\app.old" "app"
    )
)
echo updater.bat: swap failed - rolled back to the previous version. The staged pkg is untouched at "%PKG%".
endlocal
exit /b 1

          $null = $p.Handle
          if (-not $p.WaitForExit(120000)) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; throw "host smoke test hung" }
          if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            $log = Join-Path $env:VG_ROOT 'launcher.log'
            if (Test-Path $log) { Get-Content $log -Tail 120 }
            $sp = Join-Path $env:VG_ROOT 'runtime/site-packages'

              $txt = [System.Text.Encoding]::Latin1.GetString([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path))
              $names = [regex]::Matches($txt, '(?i)[a-z0-9_\-\.]+\.dll') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.ToLower() } | Sort-Object -Unique
              foreach ($n in $names) {
                if ($n -like 'api-ms-*' -or $n -like 'ext-ms-*') { continue }
                $hit = $dirs | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_ $n) } | Select-Object -First 1
                if (-not $hit) { Write-Host "DLL candidate not found for ${f}: $n" }
              }
            }
            throw "host smoke test failed, exit $($p.ExitCode)"
          }
          Write-Host "Host smoke test: OK"

      - name: "(a) crash x3 -> Recovery"
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $exe = Join-Path $env:VG_ROOT 'VideoGrabber.exe'
          $tag = "v${env:GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}"

          & (Join-Path $scratch 'restore.bat') $scratch
          if (Select-String -Path (Join-Path $scratch 'app/server.py') -Pattern 'swap-marker-b' -Quiet) { throw "rollback failed" }
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          Get-Process VideoGrabber, VideoGrabberApp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
          Remove-Item (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'VideoGrabber') -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          
          $hostPkg = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'vg host pkg'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $hostPkg | Out-Null
          Copy-Item (Join-Path $scratch 'VideoGrabberApp.exe') $hostPkg
          Copy-Item (Join-Path $scratch 'VideoGrabberApp_internal') $hostPkg -Recurse
          Set-Content (Join-Path $hostPkg 'VideoGrabberApp_internal/host-marker.txt') 'host-marker-b'
          Set-Content $runner ('call "{0}" "{1}" "{2}" "vTESTHOST" "host"' -f $bat, $scratch, $hostPkg)
          & $runner
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "host mode exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $scratch 'VideoGrabberApp_internal/host-marker.txt'))) { throw "host mode failed" }

      - name: "(c) duplicate host refused"
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $hostExe = Join-Path $env:VG_ROOT 'VideoGrabberApp.exe'
          $first = Start-Process $hostExe -PassThru
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 8
          $second = Start-Process $hostExe -PassThru
          if (-not $second.WaitForExit(15000)) { Stop-Process -Id $second.Id -Force; throw "second host not refused" }
          Stop-Process -Id $first.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

      - name: "(d) kill supervisor kills host"
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $exe = Join-Path $env:VG_ROOT 'VideoGrabber.exe'
          $sup = Start-Process $exe -PassThru
          $hostProc = $null
          foreach ($i in 1..30) {
            $hostProc = Get-Process VideoGrabberApp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($hostProc) { break }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if (-not $hostProc) { throw "no host spawned" }
          Stop-Process -Id $sup.Id -Force
          foreach ($i in 1..15) {
            if (-not (Get-Process -Id $hostProc.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { break }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if (Get-Process -Id $hostProc.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Stop-Process -Id $hostProc.Id -Force; throw "host survived supervisor" }

  publish:
    needs: [build, integration]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Promote the release
        run: gh release edit "v${{ github.run_number }}" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --prerelease=false// background.js — Universal Video Grabber
// Responsibilities:
//   1. Sniff network traffic for direct video URLs (mp4/HLS/DASH/etc).
//   2. Keep a per-tab list of detected candidates (used by the popup).
//   3. Relay "download this" requests from the in-page overlay (content.js)
//      to the local desktop app, attaching cookies/referer/UA so yt-dlp
//      can authenticate the same way the browser did.

const BACKEND_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5757";

// --- CIRCUIT BREAKER: Prevent browser lockups if the desktop app is dead ---
const originalFetch = self.fetch;
self.fetch = function(...args) {
    // If it's not a request to the local app, let it pass through normally.
    if (args[0] && typeof args[0] === 'string' && !args[0].includes('127.0.0.1') && !args[0].includes('localhost')) {
        return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    }
    // If it IS a request to the app, add a strict timeout.
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2000); // 2-second max wait
    
    const options = args[1] || {};
    options.signal = controller.signal;
    args[1] = options;
    
    return originalFetch.apply(this, args).finally(() => clearTimeout(timeoutId));
};
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// v4.3: extension settings (popup cog). vgsettings.js holds the defaults and
// vgNormalize(). VGCFG is kept current by storage.onChanged; until the first
// read lands it holds the defaults, so nothing is dropped on a cold wake.
importScripts("vgsettings.js");
let VGCFG = vgNormalize({});
chrome.storage.local.get(VG_SETTINGS_KEY).then(
  (st) => { VGCFG = vgNormalize(st[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]); },
  () => {}
);
chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
  if (area === "local" && changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]) {
    VGCFG = vgNormalize(changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY].newValue);
  }
});

// v4.3: which tab is active in each window, for the "Active tab only" sniffer
// mode. Empty until the first query lands, and snifferAllows() treats empty as
// "allow", so a cold wake never drops a request.
const ACTIVE_TABS = new Map();   // windowId -> active tabId
try {
  chrome.tabs.query({ active: true }).then((tabs) => {
    for (const t of tabs) ACTIVE_TABS.set(t.windowId, t.id);
  }, () => {});
  chrome.tabs.onActivated.addListener((info) => { ACTIVE_TABS.set(info.windowId, info.tabId); });
  chrome.windows.onRemoved.addListener((windowId) => { ACTIVE_TABS.delete(windowId); });
} catch (e) { /* tracking unavailable: sniffer stays on all tabs */ }

function snifferAllows(tabId) {
  if (VGCFG.snifferMode !== "active") return true;
  if (!ACTIVE_TABS.size) return true;
  for (const id of ACTIVE_TABS.values()) if (id === tabId) return true;
  return false;
}

const MEDIA_EXT_REGEX = /\.(mp4|m4v|mov|webm|mkv|avi|divx|flv|wmv|mpg|mpeg|ts|m2ts|mts|vob|ogv|rm|rmvb|asf|mxf|3gp|3g2|m3u8|mpd|mp3|m4a|aac|wav|flac|opus|ogg|wma|aiff|aif|alac|ape|m4b|mid|midi|amr|jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|heic|heif|bmp|svg|ico|tif|tiff|jxl|psd|raw|dng|cr2|nef|xcf|pdf|epub|mobi|azw3|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|txt|md|rtf|odt|ods|odp|csv|tsv|json|xml|yaml|yml|zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|tgz|bz2|xz|lz|lzma|zst|cab|iso|img|exe|msi|dmg|deb|rpm|apk|appimage|appx|bat|cmd|sh|ps1|jar|ttf|otf|woff2?|eot)(\?|#|$)/i;
const MEDIA_CT_REGEX = /^(video\/|audio\/|image\/|application\/(vnd\.apple\.mpegurl|x-mpegurl|dash\+xml|pdf|zip|x-7z-compressed|x-rar-compressed|x-tar|x-gzip|x-msdownload|x-msi|vnd\.openxmlformats-officedocument|vnd\.ms-excel|vnd\.ms-powerpoint|msword|epub\+zip)|application\/octet-stream)/i;

// tabId -> Map(dedupKey -> item). The key is the URL minus chunk-range
// query params (see dedupKey); item.url / item.originalUrl keep the URL as it
// was first detected.
const videoMap = new Map();

// 6.4: a chunked stream (e.g. googlevideo) is requested as many URLs that
// differ only in these params. They must not each become a list entry.
const CHUNK_PARAMS = new Set(["range", "rn", "rbum"]);
const MAX_ITEMS_PER_TAB = 200;

function dedupKey(url) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    const kept = [];
    for (const [k, v] of u.searchParams) {
      if (!CHUNK_PARAMS.has(k.toLowerCase())) kept.push([k, v]);
    }
    const q = new URLSearchParams(kept).toString();
    return u.origin + u.pathname + (q ? "?" + q : "");
  } catch (e) {
    return url;
  }
}

// v4.2: short-window de-dup for the network sniffer. Ad iframes and polled
// playlists can report the same URL many times a second. Same tab + same
// dedup key inside SNIFF_DEDUP_MS is ignored, unless the repeat carries
// information the stored entry lacks (size / content-type from the response
// headers arrives after the request event for the same URL).
const SNIFF_DEDUP_MS = 5000;
const RECENT_SNIFF = new Map();   // "tabId|dedupKey" -> timestamp

function clearRecentFor(tabId) {
  const prefix = tabId + "|";
  for (const k of RECENT_SNIFF.keys()) {
    if (k.startsWith(prefix)) RECENT_SNIFF.delete(k);
  }
}

// 6.2: the service worker is torn down after ~30 s idle and the in-memory Map
// goes with it, so the per-tab list is mirrored into chrome.storage.session
// (cleared when the browser closes) and hydrated again on startup.
const VIDEO_MAP_KEY = "videoMapState";
let _persistTimer = null;

function writeVideoMap() {
  try {
    const out = {};
    for (const [tabId, m] of videoMap) {
      if (m.size) out[tabId] = Array.from(m.values());
    }
    return chrome.storage.session.set({ [VIDEO_MAP_KEY]: out }).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
}

// Debounced: webRequest can fire hundreds of times a second on a busy page.
function persistVideoMap(immediate) {
  if (immediate) {
    clearTimeout(_persistTimer);
    _persistTimer = null;
    return writeVideoMap();
  }
  if (_persistTimer) return;
  _persistTimer = setTimeout(() => { _persistTimer = null; writeVideoMap(); }, 300);
}

// Resolves once the saved list has been merged in. Message handlers that
// read the list wait on it so a popup opened right after a worker restart
// doesn't see an empty list.
const videoMapReady = (async () => {
  try {
    const st = await chrome.storage.session.get(VIDEO_MAP_KEY);
    const saved = st[VIDEO_MAP_KEY] || {};
    let openTabs = null;
    try { openTabs = new Set((await chrome.tabs.query({})).map((t) => t.id)); } catch (e) {}
    for (const [tabKey, items] of Object.entries(saved)) {
      const tabId = Number(tabKey);
      if (openTabs && !openTabs.has(tabId)) continue;   // tab closed meanwhile
      if (!videoMap.has(tabId)) videoMap.set(tabId, new Map());
      const m = videoMap.get(tabId);
      for (const it of items || []) {
        if (!it || !it.url) continue;
        const key = dedupKey(it.url);
        if (!m.has(key)) m.set(key, it);   // never clobber what was sniffed since startup
      }
      while (m.size > MAX_ITEMS_PER_TAB) m.delete(m.keys().next().value);
    }
  } catch (e) { /* session storage unavailable: start empty */ }
})();

// ---- HLS/DASH: keep only the top-level manifest per stream ----------------
// A player fetches master.m3u8, then one variant playlist per rendition
// (index-f2-v1-a1.m3u8, chunklist_720p.m3u8, ...) plus hundreds of .ts/.m4s
// segments. Only the top-level manifest is useful: yt-dlp/ffmpeg resolve the
// variants themselves. A variant is skipped when a master from the same or a
// parent folder is already listed, and a late master replaces its variants.
const MANIFEST_RE = /\.(m3u8|mpd)(\?|#|$)/i;
const SEGMENT_RE = /\.(ts|m4s|m2ts|mts)(\?|#|$)/i;
const VARIANT_NAME_RE = /(-f\d+|-v\d+|-a\d+|chunklist|media[_-]?\d|[_-]\d{3,4}p|^\d{3,4}p?\.|variant|rendition|segment|frag|audio[_-]|video[_-]|^video\.|^audio\.)/i;

function manifestInfo(url) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (!MANIFEST_RE.test(u.pathname + u.search)) return null;
    const cut = u.pathname.lastIndexOf("/");
    const dir = u.origin + u.pathname.slice(0, cut + 1);
    const base = u.pathname.slice(cut + 1);
    const isDash = /\.mpd$/i.test(u.pathname);
    // .mpd files are always top-level; only m3u8 has the master/variant split.
    return { dir, isVariant: !isDash && VARIANT_NAME_RE.test(base) };
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

function tabHasManifest(tabId) {
  const m = videoMap.get(tabId);
  if (!m) return false;
  for (const it of m.values()) if (manifestInfo(it.url)) return true;
  return false;
}

// True when this manifest should NOT be listed (a variant of a known master,
// or a second variant in a folder that already has one). Also drops variants
// that a newly arriving master supersedes.
function manifestSuperseded(m, url) {
  const info = manifestInfo(url);
  if (!info) return false;
  const others = [];
  for (const [k, it] of m) {
    const oi = manifestInfo(it.url);
    if (oi) others.push([k, it, oi]);
  }
  if (info.isVariant) {
    for (const [, , oi] of others) {
      if (!oi.isVariant && info.dir.startsWith(oi.dir)) return true;   // master known
      if (oi.isVariant && oi.dir === info.dir) return true;             // keep first only
    }
    return false;
  }
  for (const [k, , oi] of others) {
    if (oi.isVariant && oi.dir.startsWith(info.dir)) m.delete(k);       // master wins
  }
  return false;
}

function addItem(tabId, item) {
  if (tabId === undefined || tabId < 0) return;
  if (!videoMap.has(tabId)) videoMap.set(tabId, new Map());
  const m = videoMap.get(tabId);
  const key = dedupKey(item.url);
  if (item.source !== "overlay") {
    const rk = tabId + "|" + key;
    const nowTs = Date.now();
    const last = RECENT_SNIFF.get(rk);
    if (last !== undefined && nowTs - last < SNIFF_DEDUP_MS) {
      const ex = m.get(key);
      const adds = ex && ((item.size && !ex.size) || (item.contentType && !ex.contentType));
      if (ex && !adds) return;
    }
    RECENT_SNIFF.set(rk, nowTs);
    if (RECENT_SNIFF.size > 1000) {
      for (const [k, ts] of RECENT_SNIFF) {
        if (nowTs - ts >= SNIFF_DEDUP_MS) RECENT_SNIFF.delete(k);
      }
    }
  }
  if (!m.has(key) && manifestSuperseded(m, item.url)) return;
  if (m.has(key)) {
    // Don't overwrite real data with empty data: keep the existing size /
    // content-type when the new entry lacks them.
    const ex = m.get(key);
    if (!item.size && ex.size) item.size = ex.size;
    if (!item.contentType && ex.contentType) item.contentType = ex.contentType;
    item.timestamp = ex.timestamp;
    // The first-detected URL stays the item's URL (and the original).
    item.url = ex.url;
    item.originalUrl = ex.originalUrl || ex.url;
  } else {
    item.timestamp = Date.now();
    item.originalUrl = item.url;
  }
  m.set(key, item);
  // Cap the per-tab list: Map keeps insertion order, so the oldest go first.
  while (m.size > MAX_ITEMS_PER_TAB) m.delete(m.keys().next().value);
  setBadge(tabId, String(m.size));
  chrome.action.setBadgeBackgroundColor({ tabId, color: "#2e7d32" }).catch(() => {});
  persistVideoMap();
}

// Chrome reports tabId -1 for requests and navigations that have no tab (prerender,
// some extension and service-worker requests). setBadgeText throws SYNCHRONOUSLY on a
// negative tabId, so a .catch() never runs; check the id and wrap the call instead.
function setBadge(tabId, text) {
  if (typeof tabId !== "number" || tabId < 0) return;
  try {
    chrome.action.setBadgeText({ tabId, text }).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    // Tab closed or id invalid: nothing to badge.
  }
}

chrome.webRequest.onBeforeRequest.addListener(
  (details) => {
    if (details.tabId < 0) return;
    if (!snifferAllows(details.tabId)) return;
    // HLS/DASH segments are noise once the tab has a manifest to download.
    if (SEGMENT_RE.test(details.url) && tabHasManifest(details.tabId)) return;
    if (MEDIA_EXT_REGEX.test(details.url)) {
      addItem(details.tabId, { url: details.url, source: "url-pattern", contentType: null });
    }
  },
  { urls: ["<all_urls>"], types: ["media", "xmlhttprequest", "other", "image", "font"] }
);

chrome.webRequest.onHeadersReceived.addListener(
  (details) => {
    if (details.tabId < 0) return;
    if (!snifferAllows(details.tabId)) return;
    const headers = details.responseHeaders || [];
    const ct = headers.find((h) => h.name.toLowerCase() === "content-type");
    const cl = headers.find((h) => h.name.toLowerCase() === "content-length");
    const size = cl ? parseInt(cl.value, 10) || 0 : 0;
    if (SEGMENT_RE.test(details.url) && tabHasManifest(details.tabId)) return;
    if (ct && MEDIA_CT_REGEX.test(ct.value)) {
      addItem(details.tabId, { url: details.url, source: "content-type",
        contentType: ct.value, size });
    } else if (size > 0 && MEDIA_EXT_REGEX.test(details.url)) {
      addItem(details.tabId, { url: details.url, source: "url-pattern",
        contentType: null, size });
    }
  },
  { urls: ["<all_urls>"], types: ["media", "xmlhttprequest", "other"] },
  ["responseHeaders", "extraHeaders"]
);

chrome.webNavigation.onBeforeNavigate.addListener((details) => {
  if (details.frameId === 0) {
    videoMap.delete(details.tabId);
    clearRecentFor(details.tabId);
    setBadge(details.tabId, "");
    persistVideoMap(true);
  }
});

// 6.3: single-page apps change the URL with pushState/replaceState and never
// fire onBeforeNavigate, so the previous "page"'s media piled up in the list.
chrome.webNavigation.onHistoryStateUpdated.addListener((details) => {
  if (details.frameId === 0) {
    videoMap.delete(details.tabId);
    clearRecentFor(details.tabId);
    setBadge(details.tabId, "");
    persistVideoMap(true);
  }
});

chrome.tabs.onRemoved.addListener((tabId) => {
  videoMap.delete(tabId);
  clearRecentFor(tabId);
  persistVideoMap();
});

async function cookieHeaderFor(url) {
  try {
    const cookies = await chrome.cookies.getAll({ url });
    return cookies.map((c) => `${c.name}=${c.value}`).join("; ");
  } catch (e) {
    return "";
  }
}

// Same-host check used to decide whether page cookies may accompany an item.
function sameHost(a, b) {
  try {
    return new URL(a).hostname.toLowerCase() === new URL(b).hostname.toLowerCase();
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

// Cookies for an item: always the item's own URL first. The page's cookies
// are only a fallback when the item lives on the page's own host, so session
// cookies never travel to a third-party CDN.
async function cookieHeaderForItem(url, pageUrl) {
  const own = await cookieHeaderFor(url).catch(() => "");
  if (own) return own;
  if (pageUrl && sameHost(url, pageUrl)) {
    return await cookieHeaderFor(pageUrl).catch(() => "");
  }
  return "";
}

// Last /health outcome. A success younger than HEALTH_CACHE_MS lets the
// blob-hook state query (VG_STATE) answer without touching /health, so a busy
// backend can't flip the hook to "not armed" in the middle of a click.
const HEALTH_CACHE_MS = 30000;
let lastHealthCheck = 0;   // timestamp of the last successful /health, 0 = none / last one failed

async function checkBackend() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/health`, { method: "GET" });
    lastHealthCheck = res.ok ? Date.now() : 0;
    return res.ok;
  } catch (e) {
    lastHealthCheck = 0;
    return false;
  }
}

// Same as checkBackend, but trusts a successful check made < 30 s ago.
async function checkBackendCached() {
  if (lastHealthCheck && Date.now() - lastHealthCheck < HEALTH_CACHE_MS) return true;
  return checkBackend();
}

async function getApiToken() {
  const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
  return apiToken || "";
}

async function authedFetch(path, options = {}) {
  const token = await getApiToken();
  const headers = { ...(options.headers || {}), "X-API-Token": token };
  const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}${path}`, { ...options, headers });
  if (res.status === 401) {
    return { res, unpaired: true };
  }
  return { res, unpaired: false };
}

let _pairInFlight = null; // module-level guard: concurrent wakes share one pair attempt
async function pairIfNeeded() {
  // Auto-pairing: if no token is stored, ask the desktop app for one.
  // The app only answers on localhost and only once per session.
  const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
  if (apiToken) return;
  if (!_pairInFlight) {
    _pairInFlight = (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/pair`, { method: "POST" });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.token) {
            await chrome.storage.local.set({ apiToken: data.token });
            console.debug("Video Grabber: paired automatically");
          }
        } else {
          console.debug("Video Grabber: pair request rejected (", res.status, ")");
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.debug("Video Grabber: auto-pair failed (app not running?)", e);
      }
    })();
    // Let the next wake retry if this attempt failed.
    _pairInFlight = _pairInFlight.then(() => { _pairInFlight = null; },
                                       () => { _pairInFlight = null; });
  }
  return _pairInFlight;
}

chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(() => {
  pairIfNeeded();
});

// Service-worker module scope runs on every wake-up — covers the case where
// the app started after the extension was installed.
pairIfNeeded();

// ---- v5.2: copy the app's theme into storage so the pill follows it.
async function refreshTheme() {
  try {
    const { res, unpaired } = await authedFetch("/theme");
    if (unpaired || !res.ok) return;
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ theme: await res.json() });
  } catch (e) { /* app not running: keep the last saved theme */ }
}
refreshTheme();

// ---- v5: site favicon, sent once per domain so the app can show a source icon.
const _faviconTried = new Set();
async function noteFavicon(pageUrl) {
  try {
    const host = new URL(pageUrl).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "").toLowerCase();
    if (!host || _faviconTried.has(host) || /^[\d.:]+$/.test(host)) return;
    _faviconTried.add(host);
    const { faviconSent = {} } = await chrome.storage.local.get("faviconSent");
    if (faviconSent[host]) return;
    const u = new URL(chrome.runtime.getURL("/_favicon/"));
    u.searchParams.set("pageUrl", pageUrl);
    u.searchParams.set("size", "32");
    const r = await fetch(u.toString());
    if (!r.ok) { _faviconTried.delete(host); return; }
    const blob = await r.blob();
    if (blob.type !== "image/png" || blob.size > 60000) return;
    const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const fr = new FileReader();
      fr.onload = () => resolve(fr.result);
      fr.onerror = () => reject(fr.error);
      fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
    const { res } = await authedFetch("/favicon", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ domain: host, data_url: dataUrl }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      faviconSent[host] = Date.now();
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ faviconSent });
    } else {
      _faviconTried.delete(host);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.debug("Video Grabber: favicon skipped", e);
  }
}

// Pill / context menu -> the app's Add dialog (or auto-queue if the user
// ticked "don't show again" in the app).
async function showAddDialogFor(msg) {
  const alive = await checkBackend();
  if (!alive) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Video Grabber app isn't running." };
  }
  const cookie = await cookieHeaderForItem(msg.url, msg.pageUrl);
  try {
    const { res, unpaired } = await authedFetch("/show-add-dialog", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        url: msg.url,
        filename: msg.filename || null,
        referer: msg.pageUrl,
        page_url: msg.pageUrl,
        cookie: cookie,
        user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
        format_id: msg.format_id || null,
        target_format: msg.target_format || null,
        download_playlist: msg.download_playlist || false,
        pick_playlist: msg.pick_playlist || false,
      }),
    });
    if (unpaired) {
      return { ok: false, error: "Not paired yet." };
    }
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (res.ok) noteFavicon(msg.pageUrl || msg.url);
    return { ok: res.ok, job_id: data.job_id, auto_queued: data.auto_queued,
             duplicate_of: data.duplicate_of || null, error: data.error };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
}

// ---- v5: right-click "Download with Video Grabber"
function ensureContextMenus() {
  try {
    chrome.contextMenus.removeAll(() => {
      chrome.contextMenus.create({
        id: "vg-link", title: "Download with Video Grabber",
        contexts: ["link", "video", "audio", "image"],
      });
      chrome.contextMenus.create({
        id: "vg-page", title: "Send this page to Video Grabber",
        contexts: ["page"],
      });
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}
chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(ensureContextMenus);
chrome.contextMenus.onClicked.addListener(async (info, tab) => {
  // v4.2: right-clicking an image skips the DOM and the Add dialog: srcUrl
  // goes straight to the queue. Links, video and audio keep the old path.
  if (info.mediaType === "image" && info.srcUrl) {
    if (/^(blob|data):/i.test(info.srcUrl)) {
      commandNotify("Can't send this image, the page built it in memory.");
      return;
    }
    const imgResp = await sendToBackend({
      url: info.srcUrl,
      pageUrl: (tab && tab.url) || info.pageUrl || info.srcUrl,
    });
    commandNotify(imgResp.ok
      ? (imgResp.duplicate_of ? "Image already in your list" : "Image sent to queue!")
      : (imgResp.error || "Couldn't send that to the app."));
    return;
  }
  const url = info.linkUrl || info.srcUrl || info.pageUrl;
  if (!url || /^(blob|data):/i.test(url)) return;
  const resp = await showAddDialogFor({
    url, pageUrl: (tab && tab.url) || info.pageUrl || url,
  });
  if (!resp.ok && VGCFG.notifyActions) {
    try {
      chrome.notifications.create("", {
        type: "basic",
        iconUrl: chrome.runtime.getURL("icons/icon128.png"),
        title: "Video Grabber",
        message: resp.error || "Couldn't send that to the app.",
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  }
});

// ---- E6: keyboard shortcuts (manifest "commands") --------------------------
// download-media (Ctrl+Shift+D): send the active tab's largest detected media
// through the same path as RELAY_DOWNLOAD. open-add-dialog (Ctrl+Shift+A):
// open the app's Add dialog for the tab's page, same path as SHOW_ADD_DIALOG.
// Both read the per-tab list directly: a service worker can't message itself,
// and this is the same data GET_VIDEOS returns.
function commandNotify(message) {
  if (!VGCFG.notifyActions) return;   // v4.3: Settings > Notifications
  try {
    chrome.notifications.create("", {
      type: "basic",
      iconUrl: chrome.runtime.getURL("icons/icon128.png"),
      title: "Video Grabber",
      message: String(message || ""),
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}

const MEDIA_ITEM_REGEX = /\.(mp4|m4v|mov|webm|mkv|avi|m3u8|mpd|mp3|m4a|aac|wav|flac|opus|ogg)(\?|#|$)/i;

// Largest item wins (unknown sizes count as 0), newest breaks ties. Pictures,
// fonts and documents only compete when the tab has no audio/video at all.
function pickLargestItem(items) {
  const isMedia = (it) => MEDIA_ITEM_REGEX.test(it.url)
    || /^(video|audio)\//i.test(it.contentType || "")
    || /mpegurl|dash\+xml/i.test(it.contentType || "");
  const media = items.filter(isMedia);
  const pool = media.length ? media : items;
  let best = null;
  for (const it of pool) {
    if (!best
        || (it.size || 0) > (best.size || 0)
        || ((it.size || 0) === (best.size || 0) && (it.timestamp || 0) >= (best.timestamp || 0))) {
      best = it;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

chrome.commands.onCommand.addListener(async (command, tab) => {
  try {
    let t = tab;
    if (!t || !t.id || !t.url) {
      [t] = await chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, lastFocusedWindow: true });
    }
    if (!t || !/^https?:/i.test(t.url || "")) {
      commandNotify("Open a web page first.");
      return;
    }
    if (command === "download-media") {
      await videoMapReady;
      const m = videoMap.get(t.id);
      const best = pickLargestItem(m ? Array.from(m.values()) : []);
      if (!best) {
        commandNotify("No media detected on this page yet. Play it first.");
        return;
      }
      const resp = await sendToBackend({ url: best.url, pageUrl: t.url });
      commandNotify(resp.ok ? "Sent to Video Grabber \u2713" : (resp.error || "Couldn't send that to the app."));
    } else if (command === "open-add-dialog") {
      const resp = await showAddDialogFor({ url: t.url, pageUrl: t.url });
      if (!resp.ok) commandNotify(resp.error || "Couldn't open the app's Add dialog.");
    }
  } catch (e) {
    commandNotify("Shortcut failed: " + String(e));
  }
});

async function sendToBackend({ url, pageUrl, filename, format_id, target_format }) {
  const alive = await checkBackend();
  if (!alive) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Video Grabber app isn't running. Launch the desktop app, then try again." };
  }
  const cookie = await cookieHeaderForItem(url, pageUrl);
  try {
    const { res, unpaired } = await authedFetch("/download", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        url,
        referer: pageUrl,
        page_url: pageUrl,
        cookie: cookie,
        user_agent: navigator.userAgent,
        filename: filename || null,
        format_id: format_id || null,
        target_format: target_format || null,
      }),
    });
    if (unpaired) {
      return { ok: false, error: "Not paired yet — open the extension's Options page and paste in the pairing token from the desktop app." };
    }
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (res.ok) noteFavicon(pageUrl || url);
    return { ok: res.ok, job_id: data.job_id,
             duplicate_of: data.duplicate_of || null, error: data.error };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: String(e) };
  }
}

// Mirror of the intercept setting so the downloads listener never has to
// await storage before it can cancel. Loaded once per service-worker start
// and kept current by storage.onChanged.
//
// Batch 3: the setting itself now lives in vgSettings (vgsettings.js) — the
// single source of truth that the popup's Downloads toggle and the options
// page toggle both edit. The old standalone "interceptDownloads" storage
// key is read ONCE here as a migration fallback: when vgSettings has never
// carried the switch, a legacy value is adopted and written into vgSettings
// so both toggles show the truth; from then on the legacy key is ignored.
let interceptDownloads = false;
let interceptLoaded = false;
const interceptReady = (async () => {
  try {
    const st = await chrome.storage.local.get([VG_SETTINGS_KEY, "interceptDownloads"]);
    const raw = st[VG_SETTINGS_KEY];
    if (raw && typeof raw === "object" && typeof raw.interceptDownloads === "boolean") {
      interceptDownloads = raw.interceptDownloads;
    } else if (typeof st.interceptDownloads === "boolean") {
      interceptDownloads = st.interceptDownloads;
      try {
        await chrome.storage.local.set({
          [VG_SETTINGS_KEY]: vgNormalize({ ...(raw || {}), interceptDownloads }),
        });
      } catch (e) { /* the mirror above already holds the value */ }
    }
  } catch (e) { /* defaults: interception stays off */ }
  interceptLoaded = true;
})();
chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
  if (area === "local" && changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]) {
    interceptDownloads = !!vgNormalize(changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY].newValue).interceptDownloads;
    interceptLoaded = true;
  }
});

chrome.downloads.onCreated.addListener(async (item) => {
  console.debug("[VG] onCreated fired:", (item.url || "").slice(0, 120),
                "byExtensionId:", item.byExtensionId);
  const t0 = Date.now();
  // Only true on the very first event after a cold service-worker wake,
  // before the startup read above has landed. Normally skipped (no await).
  if (!interceptLoaded) await interceptReady;
  if (!interceptDownloads) return;

  if (!item.url) return;
  if (item.url.startsWith("blob:") || item.url.startsWith("data:")) return;
  if (item.byExtensionId === chrome.runtime.id) return;

  // Every intercepted download opens the app's Add dialog; the app decides
  // what to do with it. Only the backend's own traffic (localhost / raw IP)
  // and the extension's own downloads (guarded above) are skipped. Users
  // who don't want the dialog use skip_add_dialog in the app.
  const isLocalhost = /^https?:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\[::1\])/i.test(item.url);
  const isIpAddress = /^https?:\/\/\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}/.test(item.url);
  if (isLocalhost || isIpAddress) return;

  // Cancel first, everything else after: the browser keeps writing until
  // this runs. Note Chrome only creates the download item once the server
  // has answered, so a slow server delays this event no matter what we do;
  // browserLag below shows how much of any delay happened before we ran.
  // The cancel is the first await. If it fails the download has already
  // finished (the browser won the race), so it must never be re-issued below.
  let cancelled = false;
  try {
    await chrome.downloads.cancel(item.id);
    cancelled = true;
  } catch (e) {
    cancelled = false;
  }
  const browserLag = item.startTime ? t0 - Date.parse(item.startTime) : -1;

  // Filename lookup and cookie fetch are independent: run them together.
  const [filename, cookie] = await Promise.all([
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [full] = await chrome.downloads.search({ id: item.id });
        if (full && full.filename) return full.filename.split(/[\\/]/).pop();
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    })(),
    cookieHeaderFor(item.url).catch(() => ""),
  ]);

  let handedOff = false;
  try {
    const { res } = await authedFetch("/show-add-dialog", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
