    let v = "";
    try { v = (el.style && el.style.backgroundImage) || ""; } catch (e) {}
    if (!v || v === "none") return "";
    const m = /url\(\s*(['"]?)(.*?)\1\s*\)/i.exec(v);
    return m && m[2] ? microAbs(m[2].replace(/\\(["'])/g, "$1"), el.baseURI) : "";
  }

  function microUrlFor(el) {
    return el.tagName === "IMG" ? microImageUrl(el) : microBgUrl(el);
  }

  function microEligible(el) {
    if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1) return false;
    if (el === microPill || el === microToast) return false;
    if (el.tagName !== "IMG" && !(el.hasAttribute("style") && microBgUrl(el))) return false;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!(r.width > MICRO_MIN && r.height > MICRO_MIN)) return false;
    return !!microUrlFor(el);
  }

  function microToastShow(text, isErr) {
    if (!microToast || !microToast.isConnected) {
      const t = document.createElement("div");
      t.id = "vg-micro-toast";
      t.style.cssText = `
        all: initial; position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 2147483647;
        max-width: 260px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
        font: 13px/1.3 -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;
        background: ${TH.bg_elevated}f2; color: ${TH.text};
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; display: none;
      `;
      document.documentElement.appendChild(t);
      microToast = t;
    }
    microToast.textContent = text;
    microToast.style.border = `1px solid ${isErr ? TH.error : TH.accent}`;
    microToast.style.display = "block";
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (microToast) microToast.style.opacity = "1"; });
    clearTimeout(microToastTimer);
    microToastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!microToast) return;
      microToast.style.opacity = "0";
      setTimeout(() => { if (microToast) microToast.style.display = "none"; }, 180);
    }, 2200);
  }

  function ensureMicroPill() {
    if (microPill && microPill.isConnected) return microPill;
    ensurePillStyle();
    const p = document.createElement("div");
    p.id = "vg-micro-pill";
    p.className = "vg-micro-pill";
    p.title = "Video Grabber";
    p.style.cssText = `
      all: initial; position: absolute; z-index: 2147483647; display: none;
      align-items: stretch; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden;
      width: ${MICRO_W}px; height: ${MICRO_SIZE}px; border-radius: ${MICRO_SIZE / 2}px;
      background: ${TH.bg_base}e6; color: ${TH.accent};
      border: 1px solid ${TH.accent}; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    `;
    // Left half: the one-click download (unchanged from v7).
    const dl = document.createElement("span");
    dl.title = "Download Image";
    dl.style.cssText = `
      all: initial; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: ${MICRO_SIZE}px; height: ${MICRO_SIZE}px; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer;
    `;
    const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
    const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 24 24");
    svg.setAttribute("width", "14");
    svg.setAttribute("height", "14");
    svg.setAttribute("fill", "none");
    svg.setAttribute("stroke", "currentColor");
    svg.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.6");
    svg.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
    svg.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin", "round");
    svg.style.pointerEvents = "none";
    for (const d of ["M12 4v11", "M7 11l5 5 5-5", "M5 20h14"]) {
      const path = document.createElementNS(NS, "path");
      path.setAttribute("d", d);
      svg.appendChild(path);
    }
    dl.appendChild(svg);
    // Right half: a tiny dropdown arrow that opens the image menu.
    const arrow = document.createElement("span");
    arrow.title = "More image options";
    arrow.textContent = "\u25be";
    arrow.style.cssText = `
      all: initial; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex: 1 1 auto; height: ${MICRO_SIZE}px; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer;
      font: 10px/1 -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; color: ${TH.accent};
      border-left: 1px solid ${TH.accent};
    `;
    p.appendChild(dl);
    p.appendChild(arrow);

    // Keep the site's lightbox / drag handlers from seeing our clicks.
    for (const ev of ["mousedown", "mouseup", "pointerdown", "pointerup", "dblclick"]) {
      p.addEventListener(ev, (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }
    dl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMicro(microTarget);
    });
    arrow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      openMicroMenu(e.clientX, e.clientY, microTarget);
    });
    p.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      clearTimeout(microHideTimer);
      p.style.background = TH.accent;
      p.style.color = TH.bg_base;
    });
    p.addEventListener("mouseleave", (e) => {
      p.style.background = `${TH.bg_base}e6`;
      p.style.color = TH.accent;
      if (pillCtx) return;   // the menu is open: keep the target until it closes
      scheduleMicroHide(e.relatedTarget);
    });
    document.documentElement.appendChild(p);
    microPill = p;
    return p;
  }

  // The configured corner (Batch 3: cfg.microPillPos; top-right by
  // default, as it always was) of the part of the element that is on
  // screen, in page coordinates (the pill is position:absolute on the
  // root element).
  function placeMicro() {
    microPlaceQueued = false;
    const el = microTarget;
    if (!el || !microPill) return;
    if (!el.isConnected) { hideMicro(); return; }
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!(r.width > MICRO_MIN && r.height > MICRO_MIN)
        || r.bottom < 0 || r.top > innerHeight || r.right < 0 || r.left > innerWidth) {
      microPill.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }
    const vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth || innerWidth;
    const vh = document.documentElement.clientHeight || innerHeight;
    const right = Math.min(r.right, vw);
    const left = Math.max(r.left, 0);
    const top = Math.max(r.top, 0);
    const bottom = Math.min(r.bottom, vh);
    const pos = cfg.microPillPos || "tr";
    const px = (pos === "tl" || pos === "bl")
      ? left + scrollX + 6
      : right + scrollX - MICRO_W - 6;
    const py = (pos === "br" || pos === "bl")
      ? bottom + scrollY - MICRO_SIZE - 6
      : top + scrollY + 6;
    microPill.style.left = px + "px";
    microPill.style.top = py + "px";
    microPill.style.display = "flex";
  }

  function showMicro(el) {
    clearTimeout(microHideTimer);
    ensureMicroPill();
    microTarget = el;
    placeMicro();
  }

  function hideMicro() {
    clearTimeout(microHideTimer);
    microTarget = null;
    if (microPill) microPill.style.display = "none";
  }

  function scheduleMicroHide(related) {
    if (related && related.nodeType === 1) {
      if (related === microPill || (microPill && microPill.contains(related))) return;
      if (microTarget && microTarget.contains(related)) return;
    }
    clearTimeout(microHideTimer);
    microHideTimer = setTimeout(hideMicro, 150);
  }

  function microFilenameFor(url) {
    try {
      const last = decodeURIComponent(new URL(url).pathname.split("/").pop() || "");
      if (MICRO_IMG_EXT_RE.test(last)) return last;
    } catch (e) {}
    return undefined;
  }

  function sendMicro(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    const url = microUrlFor(el);   // re-read now: srcset may have changed since hover
    if (!url) { microToastShow("No image URL found", true); return; }
    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
        { type: "RELAY_DOWNLOAD", url, pageUrl: location.href,
          filename: microFilenameFor(url), skipList: true },
        (resp) => {
          if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {
            microToastShow(failLabel(null, chrome.runtime.lastError.message), true);
            return;
          }
          if (resp && resp.ok) {
            microToastShow(resp.duplicate_of ? "Image already in your list" : "Image sent to queue!");
          } else {
            microToastShow(failLabel(resp), true);
          }
        });
    } catch (e) {
      microToastShow("Extension reloading, try again", true);
    }
  }

  // Clipboard write from a content script. Falls back to execCommand, which
  // still works on pages where navigator.clipboard is refused.
  function copyToClipboard(text) {
    const fallback = () => {
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = text;
      ta.style.cssText = "position: fixed; opacity: 0;";
      document.documentElement.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      let ok = false;
      try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) {}
      ta.remove();
      return ok;
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => true, () => fallback());
    }
    return Promise.resolve(fallback());
  }

  function microFormatBytes(n) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return "";
    if (n < 1024) return n + " B";
    if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "") + " KB";
    return (n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "") + " MB";
  }

  function openMicroMenu(x, y, el) {
    if (!el) return;
    const rows = [
      { label: "Download Image", onClick: () => sendMicro(el) },
      { label: "Download ALL Images", onClick: () => downloadAllPageImages() },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Copy Image URL", onClick: () => {
          const url = microUrlFor(el);
          if (!url) { microToastShow("No image URL found", true); return; }
          copyToClipboard(url).then((ok) =>
            microToastShow(ok ? "Image URL copied" : "Couldn't copy the URL", !ok));
        } },
    ];
    // Batch 3: optional file-size header (microPillSize). The size needs a
    // HEAD request, which many hosts refuse or do not expose to content
    // scripts; when it cannot be read, the menu just opens without the
    // line. The wait is capped so the menu never feels stuck.
    if (cfg.microPillSize) {
      const url = microUrlFor(el);
      if (url) {
        new Promise((resolve) => {
          const to = setTimeout(() => resolve(0), 600);
          fetch(url, { method: "HEAD" }).then((r) => {
            clearTimeout(to);
            resolve(parseInt(r.headers.get("content-length") || "0", 10) || 0);
          }).catch(() => { clearTimeout(to); resolve(0); });
        }).then((n) => {
          const label = microFormatBytes(n);
          openPillCtx(x, y, label ? [{ header: "File size: " + label }, ...rows] : rows);
        });
        return;
      }
    }
    openPillCtx(x, y, rows);
  }

  // "Download ALL Images": every <img> on the page that is a real picture
  // (not an icon) with an http(s) URL, de-duplicated. Blob and data URLs are
  // skipped because the desktop app can't fetch them.
  function collectPageImageUrls() {
    const seen = new Set();
    const urls = [];
    for (const img of document.querySelectorAll("img")) {
      const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
      const h = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
      if (Math.max(w, h) < 100) continue;
      const url = microImageUrl(img);
      if (!url || !/^https?:/i.test(url) || seen.has(url)) continue;
      seen.add(url);
      urls.push(url);
    }
    return urls;
  }

  function downloadAllPageImages() {
    const urls = collectPageImageUrls().slice(0, 200);
    if (!urls.length) { microToastShow("No images found on this page", true); return; }
    let sent = 0, dupes = 0, failed = 0, pending = urls.length;
    const finish = () => {
      if (--pending > 0) return;
      const parts = [`Queued ${sent} image(s)`];
      if (dupes) parts.push(`${dupes} already listed`);
      if (failed) parts.push(`${failed} failed`);
      microToastShow(parts.join(", "), failed > 0 && sent === 0);
    };
    microToastShow(`Sending ${urls.length} image(s)\u2026`);
    for (const url of urls) {
      try {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
          { type: "RELAY_DOWNLOAD", url, pageUrl: location.href,
            filename: microFilenameFor(url), skipList: true },
          (resp) => {
            if (chrome.runtime.lastError || !(resp && resp.ok)) failed++;
            else if (resp.duplicate_of) dupes++;
            else sent++;
            finish();
          });
      } catch (e) {
        failed++;
        finish();
      }
    }
  }

  // mouseenter does not bubble but does pass through the capture phase, so one
  // listener on the document sees every element the pointer enters.
  document.addEventListener("mouseenter", (e) => {
    if (siteDisabled || !cfg.microPill) return;
    const t = e.target;
    if (!(t instanceof Element)) return;
    if (t.tagName !== "IMG" && !t.hasAttribute("style")) return;
    if (!microEligible(t)) return;
    showMicro(t);
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener("mouseleave", (e) => {
    if (e.target === microTarget) scheduleMicroHide(e.relatedTarget);
  }, true);
  const microReplace = () => {
    if (!microTarget || microPlaceQueued) return;
    microPlaceQueued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(placeMicro);
  };
  window.addEventListener("scroll", microReplace, { capture: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", microReplace, { passive: true });

  // ---- v6: blob-anchor download bridge (pairs with mainhook.js) -----------
  // mainhook.js (MAIN world, claude.ai only) swallows <a download href=blob:>
  // clicks while armed and posts the Blob here by reference. We upload it to
  // the app's /upload endpoint (same nonce pattern as the recorder). Any
  // failure posts vg-blob-replay so the page re-fires the original click and
  // the browser saves the file as usual. The channel is untrusted: only real
  // Blob objects are accepted, never URLs. The secret is a nuisance barrier,
  // not a security boundary (page scripts can read window messages too).
  (() => {
    const HOOK_HOSTS = ["claude.ai"];   // keep in sync with manifest.json
    if (!HOOK_HOSTS.includes(location.hostname.toLowerCase())) return;

    const BLOB_DEBUG = false;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
    crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
    const SECRET = Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

    let hookEnabled = true;    // blobHookEnabled option, default on
    let lastSync = 0;          // when the cached armed result was stored
    let syncSeq = 0;           // lets a newer sync win over a slower older one
    let lastArmed = null;      // cached armed result (null = nothing yet)
    const ARMED_CACHE_MS = 5000;

    const dbg = (...a) => { if (BLOB_DEBUG) console.debug("[VG] blob bridge:", ...a); };

    function post(msg) {
      try { window.postMessage({ ...msg, source: SECRET }, "*"); } catch (e) {}
    }

    function queryState() {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        try {
          chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "VG_STATE" }, (r) => {
            resolve(chrome.runtime.lastError || !r ? null : r);
          });
        } catch (e) { resolve(null); }
      });
    }

    // Non-forced calls (pointerdown / keydown) reuse the cached result for 5 s
    // so rapid clicks don't spam background.js. syncArmed(true) always runs.
    async function syncArmed(force) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (!force && lastArmed !== null && now - lastSync < ARMED_CACHE_MS) return;
      const seq = ++syncSeq;
      const st = await queryState();
      if (seq !== syncSeq) return;   // a newer sync started meanwhile; its result wins
      let armed;
      if (st === null && lastArmed !== null) {
        // The message to background.js failed (worker waking, busy): keep the
        // last known state instead of disarming. If the app really is gone,
        // uploadBlob re-checks and the click is replayed natively.
        armed = lastArmed && hookEnabled;
      } else {
        armed = !!(hookEnabled && st && st.alive && st.paired && st.intercept);
      }
      lastArmed = armed;
      lastSync = Date.now();
      post({ type: "vg-armed", armed, debug: BLOB_DEBUG });
    }

    function cleanName(name) {
      const n = String(name || "").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\u0000-\u001f]/g, "_").trim().slice(0, 200);
      return n || "download";
    }

    async function uploadBlob(blob, filename) {
      const st = await queryState();
      if (!hookEnabled || !st || !st.alive || !st.paired || !st.intercept) {
        dbg("not ready", st);
        return false;
      }
      // One attempt = fresh one-time nonce + POST. A network failure throws
      // out of fetch(); it is retried once below.
      const attempt = async () => {
        const nresp = await new Promise((resolve) => {
          try {
            chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "GET_UPLOAD_NONCE" }, (r) => {
              resolve(chrome.runtime.lastError ? null : r);
            });
          } catch (e) { resolve(null); }
        });
        if (!nresp || !nresp.ok || !nresp.nonce) { dbg("no nonce", nresp); return { fail: true }; }
        const form = new FormData();
        form.append("file", blob, cleanName(filename));
        const r = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5757/upload", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "X-Upload-Nonce": nresp.nonce },
          body: form,
        });
        return { res: r };
      };
      let out;
      try {
        out = await attempt();
      } catch (e) {
        // NetworkError: wait 500 ms and retry once before giving up (the
        // caller then posts vg-blob-replay).
        dbg("upload network error, retrying", e);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
        out = await attempt();   // a second throw propagates to the caller
      }
      if (out.fail) return false;
      const res = out.res;
      if (!res.ok) { dbg("upload status", res.status); return null; }
      // E7: the app says which category folder it filed the upload under.
      let category = "";
      try {
        const j = await res.json();
        category = typeof j.category === "string" ? j.category : "";
      } catch (e) {}
      return { category };
    }

    window.addEventListener("message", async (e) => {
      if (e.source !== window) return;
      let type, src, id, blob, filename;
      try {
        const d = e.data;
        if (!d || typeof d !== "object") return;
        type = d.type; src = d.source; id = d.id; blob = d.blob; filename = d.filename;
      } catch (err) { return; }
      if (type !== "vg-blob-download" || src !== SECRET) return;
      if (typeof id !== "string" || !(blob instanceof Blob)) return;

      // Ack first, before any async work: stops the page-side watchdog.
      post({ type: "vg-blob-ack", id });
      let ok = false;
      try {
        ok = await uploadBlob(blob, typeof filename === "string" ? filename : "");
      } catch (err) {
        dbg("upload failed", err);
        ok = false;
      }
      if (ok) {
        post({ type: "vg-blob-done", id });
        recNotify("Video Grabber", ok.category ? `Sent to ${ok.category} ✓` : "Sent to app ✓");
      } else {
        post({ type: "vg-blob-replay", id });
      }
    });

    // Armed state can't be observed (the app can start or stop at any time),
    // so refresh on user input, tab focus, option changes and a slow timer.
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => syncArmed(false), true);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", () => syncArmed(false), true);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { if (!document.hidden) syncArmed(true); });
    setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) syncArmed(true); }, 15000);

    try {
      chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((c, area) => {
        if (area !== "local") return;
        if (c.blobHookEnabled) hookEnabled = c.blobHookEnabled.newValue !== false;
        // Batch 3: the intercept switch lives in vgSettings now, so a flip
        // there (not the old standalone key) is what re-arms the hook.
        if (c.blobHookEnabled || c[VG_SETTINGS_KEY] || c.apiToken) syncArmed(true);
      });
      chrome.storage.local.get("blobHookEnabled").then((st) => {
        hookEnabled = st.blobHookEnabled !== false;
      }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => syncArmed(true));
    } catch (e) { syncArmed(true); }
  })();
})();// mainhook.js — Universal Video Grabber
// Runs in the page's MAIN world at document_start (manifest content_scripts
// entry with "world": "MAIN", claude.ai only). It catches blob-anchor
// downloads (<a download href="blob:...">.click()), which never reach the
// app through chrome.downloads, and hands the Blob to content.js (isolated
// world) by reference via window.postMessage. content.js uploads it to the
// app. If anything goes wrong the original click is replayed on a fresh
// object URL, so the browser still saves the file.
//
// The hook only intercepts while "armed". content.js decides that (app
// running + paired + intercept option on + blobHookEnabled on) and pushes it
// in. Not armed means every click falls straight through, unchanged.
(() => {
  const ACK_MS = 1500;   // isolated side must ack within this or we replay natively
  const LRU_CAP = 50;

  let armed = false;
  let secret = null;     // adopted from the first vg-armed message (nuisance barrier only)
  let debug = false;

  const dbg = (...a) => { if (debug) { try { console.log("[VG hook]", ...a); } catch (e) {} } };

  // Originals, captured before anything is patched. click and dispatchEvent
  // are inherited (HTMLElement / EventTarget), so these resolve upward.
  const origCOU = URL.createObjectURL;
  const origRevoke = URL.revokeObjectURL;
  const origClick = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click;
  const origDispatch = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.dispatchEvent;
  const origCreateEl = Document.prototype.createElement;

  const isBlob = (o) => {
    const t = Object.prototype.toString.call(o);
    return t === "[object Blob]" || t === "[object File]";
  };

  // ---- blob-url -> Blob, small LRU --------------------------------------
  const BLOBS = new Map();
  URL.createObjectURL = new Proxy(origCOU, {
    apply(target, thisArg, args) {
      const url = Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
      try {
        if (isBlob(args[0])) {
          BLOBS.delete(url);
          BLOBS.set(url, args[0]);
          while (BLOBS.size > LRU_CAP) BLOBS.delete(BLOBS.keys().next().value);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return url;
    },
  });
  // Drop revoked entries so big blobs aren't pinned for the life of the tab.
  // The click happens before the revoke, and pending downloads hold their own
  // Blob reference, so this is safe.
  URL.revokeObjectURL = new Proxy(origRevoke, {
    apply(target, thisArg, args) {
      try { BLOBS.delete(args[0]); } catch (e) {}
      return Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
    },
  });

  // ---- pending hand-offs: id -> {blob, filename, timer} -----------------
  const PENDING = new Map();

  function newId() {
    return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
  }

  function replay(id) {
    const p = PENDING.get(id);
    if (!p) return;
    PENDING.delete(id);
    clearTimeout(p.timer);
    dbg("replay", id);
    let url = null;
    try {
      url = Reflect.apply(origCOU, URL, [p.blob]);
      const a = Reflect.apply(origCreateEl, document, ["a"]);
      a.href = url;
      a.download = p.filename;
      Reflect.apply(origClick, a, []);   // original click: never re-enters our hook
    } catch (e) {}
    if (url) {
      setTimeout(() => { try { Reflect.apply(origRevoke, URL, [url]); } catch (e) {} }, 60000);
    }
  }

  function blobAnchorInfo(a) {
    try {
      if (!a || typeof a.hasAttribute !== "function" || !a.hasAttribute("download")) return null;
      const href = a.href;
      if (typeof href !== "string" || !href.startsWith("blob:")) return null;
      const blob = BLOBS.get(href);
      if (!blob) return null;
      return { blob, filename: a.getAttribute("download") || "" };
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // True when the click was taken over (caller must NOT run the native click).
  function tryIntercept(a) {
    if (!armed || secret === null) return false;
    const info = blobAnchorInfo(a);
    if (!info) return false;
    const id = newId();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => replay(id), ACK_MS);
    PENDING.set(id, { blob: info.blob, filename: info.filename, timer });
    try {
      window.postMessage(
        { type: "vg-blob-download", source: secret, id, blob: info.blob, filename: info.filename },
        "*");
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      PENDING.delete(id);
      return false;
    }
    dbg("intercepted", id, info.filename);
    return true;
  }

  HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = new Proxy(origClick, {
    apply(target, thisArg, args) {
      if (tryIntercept(thisArg)) return undefined;
      return Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
    },
  });

  HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.dispatchEvent = new Proxy(origDispatch, {
    apply(target, thisArg, args) {
      let isClick = false;
      try { isClick = !!args[0] && args[0].type === "click"; } catch (e) {}
      if (isClick && tryIntercept(thisArg)) return true;
      return Reflect.apply(target, thisArg, args);
    },
  });

  // ---- messages from content.js (isolated world) -------------------------
  window.addEventListener("message", (e) => {
    if (e.source !== window) return;
    let d, type, src, id, isArmed, wantDebug;
    try {
      d = e.data;
      if (!d || typeof d !== "object") return;
      type = d.type; src = d.source; id = d.id;
      isArmed = d.armed; wantDebug = d.debug;
    } catch (err) {
      return;
    }
    if (type === "vg-armed") {
      if (secret === null) {
        if (typeof src !== "string" || src.length < 16) return;
        secret = src;                         // first message wins
      } else if (src !== secret) {
        return;
      }
      armed = isArmed === true;
      debug = wantDebug === true;
      return;
    }
    if (secret === null || src !== secret || typeof id !== "string") return;
    if (type === "vg-blob-ack") {
      const p = PENDING.get(id);
      if (p) clearTimeout(p.timer);           // isolated side has it; stop the watchdog
    } else if (type === "vg-blob-done") {
      const p = PENDING.get(id);
      if (p) { clearTimeout(p.timer); PENDING.delete(id); }
    } else if (type === "vg-blob-replay") {
      replay(id);
    }
  }, false);
})();

(async () => {
  const tokenInput = document.getElementById("token");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("status");

  const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
  if (apiToken) tokenInput.value = apiToken;

  const interceptCheckbox = document.getElementById("interceptDownloads");
  // Batch 3: the switch lives in vgSettings (vgsettings.js) — the same value
  // the popup's Downloads toggle edits, and the one background.js reads.
  // The old standalone "interceptDownloads" key is only a migration
  // fallback: if vgSettings has never carried the switch, adopt the legacy
  // value once (mirrors the migration in background.js).
  {
    const stored = await chrome.storage.local.get([VG_SETTINGS_KEY, "interceptDownloads"]);
    const rawVg = stored[VG_SETTINGS_KEY];
    if (!(rawVg && typeof rawVg.interceptDownloads === "boolean")
        && typeof stored.interceptDownloads === "boolean") {
      const adopted = vgNormalize({ ...(rawVg || {}), interceptDownloads: stored.interceptDownloads });
      try { await chrome.storage.local.set({ [VG_SETTINGS_KEY]: adopted }); } catch (e) {}
      interceptCheckbox.checked = adopted.interceptDownloads;
    } else {
      interceptCheckbox.checked = !!vgNormalize(rawVg).interceptDownloads;
    }
  }
  interceptCheckbox.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const cur = vgNormalize((await chrome.storage.local.get(VG_SETTINGS_KEY))[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]);
    await chrome.storage.local.set({
      [VG_SETTINGS_KEY]: { ...cur, interceptDownloads: interceptCheckbox.checked },
    });
  });
  // Keep this page honest if the popup toggle flips the switch meanwhile.
  chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
    if (area === "local" && changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]) {
      interceptCheckbox.checked = !!vgNormalize(changes[VG_SETTINGS_KEY].newValue).interceptDownloads;
    }
  });

  const blobHookCheckbox = document.getElementById("blobHookEnabled");
  const { blobHookEnabled } = await chrome.storage.local.get("blobHookEnabled");
  blobHookCheckbox.checked = blobHookEnabled !== false;
  blobHookCheckbox.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ blobHookEnabled: blobHookCheckbox.checked });
  });

  document.getElementById("test").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    statusEl.textContent = "Contacting app…";
    statusEl.className = "";
    try {
      const ping = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5757/ping");
      if (ping.status === 404) {
        statusEl.textContent = "App reachable but outdated — update Video Grabber, then retry.";
        statusEl.className = "bad";
        return;
      }
      if (!ping.ok) throw new Error("no response");
      const state = await ping.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (state.paired) {
        if (!tokenInput.value.trim()) {
          statusEl.textContent = "App is paired, but this extension has no token — copy it from the app's Tools menu.";
          statusEl.className = "bad";
          return;
        }
        statusEl.textContent = "App reachable ✓ — already paired this session.";
        statusEl.className = "ok";
        return;
      }
      const res = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5757/pair", { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.token) {
          await chrome.storage.local.set({ apiToken: data.token });
          tokenInput.value = data.token;
          statusEl.textContent = "Paired ✓";
          statusEl.className = "ok";
          return;
        }
      }
      statusEl.textContent = "App reachable but pairing refused — restart the app to re-pair.";
      statusEl.className = "bad";
    } catch (e) {
      statusEl.textContent = "App unreachable — is Video Grabber running?";
      statusEl.className = "bad";
    }
  });

  // v5: show the connection state as soon as the page opens (read-only:
  // /ping never pairs, so this can't use up the once-per-session pairing).
  try {
    const ping = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5757/ping");
    if (ping.ok) {
      const state = await ping.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const paired = state.paired || !!tokenInput.value.trim();
      statusEl.textContent = paired
        ? "App running" + (state.version ? ` (v${state.version})` : "") + (tokenInput.value.trim() ? " ✓" : " but this extension has no token. Press Test connection.")
        : "App running, not paired yet. Press Test connection.";
      statusEl.className = paired && tokenInput.value.trim() ? "ok" : "bad";
    }
  } catch (e) {
    statusEl.textContent = "App not running. Launch Video Grabber, then press Test connection.";
    statusEl.className = "bad";
  }

  document.getElementById("save").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const value = tokenInput.value.trim();
    if (!value) {
      statusEl.textContent = "Paste a token first.";
      statusEl.className = "bad";
      return;
    }
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ apiToken: value });
    statusEl.textContent = "Saved ✓ — try downloading something.";
    statusEl.className = "ok";
  });

const BACKEND_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5757";

// --- CIRCUIT BREAKER: Prevent popup lockups if the app is dead ---
const originalFetch = window.fetch;
window.fetch = function(...args) {
    if (args[0] && typeof args[0] === 'string' && !args[0].includes('127.0.0.1') && !args[0].includes('localhost')) {
        return originalFetch.apply(this, args);
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2000); 
    const options = args[1] || {};
    options.signal = controller.signal;
    args[1] = options;
    return originalFetch.apply(this, args).finally(() => clearTimeout(timeoutId));
};
// -----------------------------------------------------------------

// ---------------- helpers ----------------

function fmtBytes(n) {
  if (!n) return "";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  let i = 0;
  while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }
  return `${n.toFixed(n >= 100 || i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;
}

function fileName(url) {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(url.split("/").pop().split("?")[0] || url);
  } catch (e) {
    return url;
  }
}

// Reddit's CDN names files m2-res_1280p.mp4 / DASH_720.mp4. For those hosts
// use the tab title instead (same sanitizing as content.js sendChoice).
function redditCdnName(url, tab) {
  try {
    if (!/(^|\.)(v|packaged-media)\.redd\.it$/i.test(new URL(url).hostname)) return undefined;
    const title = tab && tab.title;
    const ext = (new URL(url).pathname.match(/(\.(?:mp4|m4v|mov|webm|mkv|mp3|m4a|aac))$/i) || [""])[0];
    if (!title || !ext) return undefined;
    return title.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_").slice(0, 80) + ext;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

// 7.7: CDN chunk URLs end in a long random ID ("AbC123...xyz.mp4"), which says
// nothing. Show what the item is and how big instead; the full URL goes in
// the tooltip. Normal file names are shown as before.
const CHUNK_ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\./;

function chunkLabel(it) {
  const name = fileName(it.url);
  if (!CHUNK_ID_RE.test(name)) return null;
  const ct = (it.contentType || "").toLowerCase();
  const e = extOf(it.url);
  let kind = "Stream";
  if (ct.startsWith("video/") || ["mp4", "m4v", "mov", "webm", "mkv", "avi"].includes(e)) kind = "Video";
  else if (ct.startsWith("audio/") || ["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "flac", "opus", "ogg"].includes(e)) kind = "Audio";
  return `${kind} \u00b7 ${fmtBytes(it.size) || "unknown"}`;
}

function extOf(url) {
  const m = url.match(/\.([a-z0-9]{1,5})(\?|#|$)/i);
  return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : "";
}

function categoryOf(url) {
  const e = extOf(url);
  if (["mp4", "m4v", "mov", "avi", "flv", "wmv", "mpg", "mpeg", "ts", "3gp", "3g2", "m2ts", "mts", "vob", "ogv", "rm", "rmvb", "asf", "mxf", "divx"].includes(e)) return "mp4";
  if (e === "webm" || e === "mkv") return "webm";
  if (e === "m3u8" || e === "mpd") return "m3u8";
  if (["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "flac", "opus", "ogg", "wma", "aiff", "aif", "alac", "ape", "m4b", "mid", "midi", "amr"].includes(e)) return "mp3";
  if (["jpg", "jpeg", "jpe", "png", "gif", "webp", "avif", "heic", "heif", "bmp", "ico", "tif", "tiff", "jxl", "psd", "raw", "dng", "cr2", "nef", "xcf", "svg"].includes(e)) return "image";
  if (["pdf", "doc", "docx", "xls", "xlsx", "ppt", "pptx", "csv", "tsv", "txt", "md", "rtf", "odt", "ods", "odp", "json", "xml", "yaml", "yml", "epub", "mobi", "azw3"].includes(e)) return "doc";
  if (["zip", "rar", "7z", "tar", "gz", "tgz", "bz2", "xz", "lz", "lzma", "zst", "cab", "iso", "img"].includes(e)) return "archive";
  if (["exe", "msi", "dmg", "deb", "rpm", "apk", "appimage", "appx", "bat", "cmd", "sh", "ps1", "jar", "py", "js"].includes(e)) return "programs";
  if (["ttf", "otf", "woff", "woff2", "eot"].includes(e)) return "font";
  return "other";
}

// ---------------- state ----------------

let currentTab = null;
let tabMode = "current";       // "current" | "other"
let otherTabs = [];
let otherSelId = null;
let mediaItems = [];           // rows: {url, size, timestamp, checked, ...}
let filterSet = null;          // null = all visible; else Set of categories
let searchText = "";
let sortMode = "time";         // E5: "time" | "size" | "name" (saved as popupSort)
let _autoTried = false;        // v4.2: single-item auto-download runs once per popup open
const GRAB_CONFIRM_LIMIT = 5;  // v4.2: Grab-all sends above this need a confirmation

// v4.2: small toast at the bottom of the popup.
let _toastTimer = null;
function showToast(text, isErr) {
  const el = document.getElementById("toast");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text;
  el.classList.toggle("err", !!isErr);
  el.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(_toastTimer);
  _toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("show"), 2200);
}

async function checkBackend() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("status");
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/ping`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("bad status");
    const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
    if (!apiToken) {
      statusEl.textContent = "App running, but not paired. Open this extension's Options and test the connection.";
      statusEl.className = "bad";
      return true;
    }
    let extra = "";
    try {
      const q = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/queue-status`, { headers: { "X-API-Token": apiToken } });
      if (q.status === 401) {
        statusEl.textContent = "App running, but the saved token was rejected. Re-pair in Options.";
        statusEl.className = "bad";
        return true;
      }
      if (q.ok) {
        const s = await q.json();
        const bits = [];
        if (s.active) bits.push(`${s.active} downloading`);
        if (s.queued) bits.push(`${s.queued} queued`);
        if (s.youtube_hold_s > 0) bits.push(`YouTube held ${Math.ceil(s.youtube_hold_s / 60)} min`);
        if (s.low_disk) bits.push("low disk space");
        extra = bits.length ? " · " + bits.join(" · ") : "";
      }
    } catch (e) { /* older app without /queue-status: plain status */ }
    statusEl.textContent = "Desktop app connected ✓" + extra;
    statusEl.className = "ok";
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    statusEl.textContent = "Desktop app not running. Launch it, then reopen this popup.";
    statusEl.className = "bad";
    return false;
  }
}

// ---------------- media list ----------------

// E5: Time is newest first (the original behaviour), Size is largest first
// (unknown sizes last), Name is A to Z.
function compareItems(a, b) {
  const byTime = (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0);
  if (sortMode === "size") return (b.size || 0) - (a.size || 0) || byTime;
  if (sortMode === "name") {
    return fileName(a.url).toLowerCase().localeCompare(fileName(b.url).toLowerCase()) || byTime;
  }
  return byTime;
}

function updateSortButton() {
  const btn = document.getElementById("btnSort");
  if (btn) btn.textContent = "Sort: " + { time: "Time", size: "Size", name: "Name" }[sortMode];
}

function setItems(items, tabRef) {
  // Preserve checkbox state across reloads, keyed by URL.
  const prev = new Map(mediaItems.map((i) => [i.url, i.checked]));
  mediaItems = (items || [])
    .slice()
    .sort(compareItems)
    .map((i) => ({
      ...i,
      size: i.size || 0,
      checked: prev.has(i.url) ? prev.get(i.url) : true,
      tabRef,
    }));
  renderMedia();
}

// ---- v5: recent downloads (live) and the per-site pill switch -------------
function fmtB(n) {
  if (!n) return "";
  const u = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]; let i = 0; let v = n;
  while (v >= 1024 && i < u.length - 1) { v /= 1024; i++; }
  return `${v.toFixed(i ? 1 : 0)} ${u[i]}`;
}

async function refreshRecent() {
  const box = document.getElementById("recent");
  const list = document.getElementById("recentList");
  try {
    const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
    if (!apiToken) { box.style.display = "none"; return; }
    const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/jobs`, { headers: { "X-API-Token": apiToken } });
    if (!res.ok) { box.style.display = "none"; return; }
    // Keep the id (the object key) so a row can ask the app to open its folder.
    const jobsObj = await res.json();
    const jobs = Object.entries(jobsObj).map(([key, j]) => ({ ...j, _id: j.id || j.job_id || key }));
    jobs.sort((a, b) => (b.created_ts || 0) - (a.created_ts || 0));
    const recent = jobs.filter((j) => j.status !== "skipped").slice(0, 5);
    if (!recent.length) { box.style.display = "none"; return; }
    list.textContent = "";
    for (const j of recent) {
      const pct = j.size_total ? Math.min(100, Math.round(100 * (j.size_done || 0) / j.size_total))
                               : (j.status === "done" ? 100 : 0);
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "rjob" + (j.status === "error" ? " err" : "");
      const name = document.createElement("span");
      name.className = "rname"; name.textContent = j.filename || j.url; name.title = j.filename || "";
      const bar = document.createElement("div");
      bar.className = "rbar";
      const fill = document.createElement("i"); fill.style.width = pct + "%";
      bar.appendChild(fill);
      const meta = document.createElement("div");
      meta.className = "rmeta";
      const stat = document.createElement("span");
      stat.className = "rstat";
      const retrying = j.status === "queued" && (j.retry_after || 0) > Date.now() / 1000;
      stat.textContent = retrying ? "retrying soon" : j.status + (j.status === "downloading" ? ` ${pct}%` : "");
      if (j.status === "done") {
        stat.classList.add("link");
        stat.title = "Open folder";
        stat.addEventListener("click", () => openJobFolder(j));
      }
      const right = document.createElement("span");
      right.textContent = j.status === "downloading" ? (j.speed || "") : fmtB(j.size_total);
      meta.appendChild(stat); meta.appendChild(right);
      row.appendChild(name); row.appendChild(bar); row.appendChild(meta);
      list.appendChild(row);
    }
    box.style.display = "block";
  } catch (e) {
    box.style.display = "none";
  }
}

// v4.2: ask the app to open Explorer at a finished job's file.
async function openJobFolder(j) {
  try {
    const { apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get("apiToken");
    const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND_BASE}/open-folder`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-API-Token": apiToken || "" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ job_id: j._id, filename: j.filename || null }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { showToast("Opening folder…"); return; }
    const d = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    showToast(d.error || (res.status === 404 ? "Open folder needs a newer Video Grabber app" : "Couldn't open the folder"), true);
  } catch (e) {
    showToast("Desktop app not reachable", true);
  }
}

function startRecent() {
  refreshRecent();
  setInterval(refreshRecent, 1500);
}

async function setupSiteSwitch() {
  const btn = document.getElementById("siteToggle");
  const nameEl = document.getElementById("siteName");
  const row = document.getElementById("siteRow");
  let host = "";
  try {
    const [tab] = await chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true });
    host = new URL(tab.url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "").toLowerCase();
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!host) { row.style.display = "none"; return; }
  nameEl.textContent = host;
  const paint = async () => {
    const { disabledSites = [] } = await chrome.storage.local.get("disabledSites");
    const off = disabledSites.includes(host);
    btn.textContent = off ? "Show pill on this site" : "Hide pill on this site";
  };
  btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const { disabledSites = [] } = await chrome.storage.local.get("disabledSites");
    const next = disabledSites.includes(host)
      ? disabledSites.filter((h) => h !== host) : [...disabledSites, host];
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ disabledSites: next });
    paint();
  });
  paint();
}

const TINY_BYTES = 100 * 1024;

function visibleItems() {
  const hideTiny = document.getElementById("hideTiny");
  const tinyOn = !hideTiny || hideTiny.checked;
  return mediaItems.filter((it) => {
    if (filterSet && !filterSet.has(categoryOf(it.url))) return false;
    // Known-size tiny files are almost always page assets, not downloads.
    // HLS/DASH manifests are tiny by nature, so they are exempt.
    if (tinyOn && it.size > 0 && it.size < TINY_BYTES
        && categoryOf(it.url) !== "m3u8") return false;
    if (searchText) {
      const hay = (it.url + " " + fileName(it.url)).toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(searchText)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}

function renderMedia() {
  const list = document.getElementById("mediaList");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("mediaStatus");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  // Sizes arrive later (HEAD probes), so the order is re-applied every render.
  mediaItems.sort(compareItems);
  updateSortButton();
  const visible = visibleItems();
  const hidden = mediaItems.length - visible.length;
  if (!visible.length) {
    // 7.4: say why the list is empty. Nothing detected vs. all filtered out.
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.className = "empty";
    if (!hidden) {
      empty.textContent = "No media on this page.";
    } else {
      empty.append(`${hidden} item(s) hidden by filter \u2014 `);
      const showAll = document.createElement("button");
      showAll.type = "button";
      showAll.className = "linkbtn";
      showAll.textContent = "Show all";
      showAll.addEventListener("click", showAllItems);
      empty.appendChild(showAll);
    }
    list.appendChild(empty);
  } else {
    for (const it of visible) list.appendChild(rowEl(it));
  }
  const checked = visible.filter((i) => i.checked);
  statusEl.textContent = mediaItems.length
    ? `${checked.length} of ${visible.length} selected` + (hidden ? ` (${hidden} hidden by filter)` : "")
    : "";
  // 7.5: nothing visible and nothing hidden: no status line at all.
  statusEl.style.display = (!visible.length && !hidden) ? "none" : "";
  updateToolbar();
  probeUnknownSizes(visible);
}

// HEAD-probe items whose size is unknown (a few at a time) so the tiny-file
// filter and the size labels have real numbers. Extension pages are exempt
// from CORS thanks to host_permissions.
const _sizeProbed = new Set();
async function probeUnknownSizes(items) {
  const todo = items.filter((i) => !i.size && !_sizeProbed.has(i.url)
                                   && /^https?:/i.test(i.url)).slice(0, 25);
  if (!todo.length) return;
  todo.forEach((i) => _sizeProbed.add(i.url));
  let changed = false;
  const queue = todo.slice();
  const worker = async () => {
    while (queue.length) {
      const it = queue.shift();
      try {
        const r = await fetch(it.url, { method: "HEAD", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000) });
        const n = parseInt(r.headers.get("content-length") || "0", 10) || 0;
        if (n) { it.size = n; changed = true; }
      } catch (e) { /* leave size unknown */ }
    }
  };
  await Promise.all([worker(), worker(), worker(), worker()]);
  if (changed) renderMedia();
}

// E4: 16x16 favicon of the page the item came from, from the browser's own
// favicon cache (needs the "favicon" permission, already declared). The
// letter tile shows until the image loads and stays if it never does.
function faviconEl(it) {
  const tab = it.tabRef || currentTab || {};
  const pageUrl = tab.url || "";
  let host = "";
  try { host = new URL(pageUrl || it.url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ""); } catch (e) {}
  const tile = document.createElement("span");
  tile.className = "fav";
  tile.textContent = (host[0] || "?").toUpperCase();
  if (/^https?:/i.test(pageUrl)) {
    try {
      const u = new URL(chrome.runtime.getURL("/_favicon/"));
      u.searchParams.set("pageUrl", pageUrl);
      u.searchParams.set("size", "16");
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      img.alt = "";
      img.width = 16;
      img.height = 16;
      img.addEventListener("load", () => {
        tile.textContent = "";
        tile.classList.add("has-img");
        tile.appendChild(img);
      });
      img.src = u.toString();
    } catch (e) { /* keep the letter tile */ }
  }
  return tile;
}

// v4.2: the per-row send, shared by the row's download button and the
// single-item auto-download. Same message and filename rules as before.
function dlFilename(it, tab) {
  return redditCdnName(it.url, tab) || (/\.(mp4|m4v|mov|webm|mkv|avi|flv|wmv|mpg|mpeg|mp3|m4a|aac|wav|flac|ogg|opus|wma|aiff|m4b|m3u8|mpd|pdf|zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|tgz|bz2|xz|zst|cab|iso|epub|mobi|azw3|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|txt|md|rtf|odt|ods|odp|csv|tsv|json|xml|yaml|yml|exe|msi|dmg|deb|rpm|apk|appimage|bat|cmd|sh|ps1|jar|jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|heic|heif|bmp|ico|tif|tiff|jxl|psd|raw|woff2?|eot|ttf|otf|3g2|3gp|aif|alac|amr|ape|appx|asf|cr2|divx|dng|img|jpe|js|lz|lzma|m2ts|mid|midi|mts|mxf|nef|ogv|py|rm|rmvb|svg|ts|vob|xcf)(\?|#|$)/i.test(it.url)
          ? fileName(it.url) : undefined);
}

function relayOne(it, tab, cb) {
  chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
    { type: "RELAY_DOWNLOAD", url: it.url, pageUrl: tab.url,
      tabId: tab.id, filename: dlFilename(it, tab) },
    cb
  );
}

function rowEl(it) {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "mrow";

  const cb = document.createElement("input");
  cb.type = "checkbox";
  cb.checked = it.checked;
  cb.addEventListener("change", () => { it.checked = cb.checked; renderMedia(); });

  const name = document.createElement("span");
  name.className = "mname";
  name.textContent = chunkLabel(it)
    || `${fileName(it.url)} — ${fmtBytes(it.size) || "unknown"}`;
  name.title = it.url;   // full URL on hover
  // v4.2: mark the top-level HLS playlist so it isn't mistaken for a sub-stream.
  if (extOf(it.url) === "m3u8" && /master/i.test(fileName(it.url))) {
    const tag = document.createElement("span");
    tag.className = "vtag";
    tag.textContent = "[Master]";
    tag.title = "Top-level playlist (contains every quality)";
    name.appendChild(tag);
  }

  const acts = document.createElement("span");
  acts.className = "macts";

  // ⬇ — same as the old per-row "Send to Grabber"
  const bDl = document.createElement("button");
  bDl.textContent = "⬇";
  bDl.title = "Send to Grabber";
  bDl.addEventListener("click", () => {
    bDl.textContent = "…";
    const tab = it.tabRef || currentTab || {};
    relayOne(it, tab, (resp) => {
      bDl.textContent = "⬇";
      setStatus(resp && resp.ok ? `Sent ${fileName(it.url)} ✓`
                                : (resp && resp.error) || "Failed");
    });
  });

  const bOpen = document.createElement("button");
  bOpen.textContent = "▶";
  bOpen.title = "Open in new tab";
  bOpen.addEventListener("click", () => chrome.tabs.create({ url: it.url }));

  const bCopy = document.createElement("button");
  bCopy.textContent = "📋";
  bCopy.title = "Copy URL";
  bCopy.addEventListener("click", () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(it.url).then(() => setStatus("URL copied ✓"));
  });

  acts.append(bDl, bOpen, bCopy);
  row.append(cb, faviconEl(it), name, acts);
  return row;
}

function setStatus(text) {
  const el = document.getElementById("mediaStatus");
  el.textContent = text;
  el.style.display = "";   // a message must show even when the list is empty
}

// "Show all" in the hidden-by-filter message: every type on, small files
// shown, search cleared.
function showAllItems() {
  document.querySelectorAll("#filterPanel input[value]").forEach((b) => {
    if (b.id !== "hideTiny") b.checked = true;
  });
  const tiny = document.getElementById("hideTiny");
  if (tiny) tiny.checked = false;
  const s = document.getElementById("searchInput");
  if (s) s.value = "";
  searchText = "";
  rebuildFilterSet();
}

// ---------------- toolbar ----------------

function updateToolbar() {
  const checked = visibleItems().filter((i) => i.checked);
  document.getElementById("btnMerge").disabled =
    !checked.some((i) => categoryOf(i.url) === "m3u8");
  document.getElementById("btnDownload").disabled = !checked.length;
  document.getElementById("btnDownload").textContent =
    checked.length ? `Download (${checked.length})` : "Download";
  document.getElementById("btnCopy").disabled = !checked.length;
}

function sendBatch(viaMerge) {
  const checked = visibleItems().filter((i) => i.checked);
  if (!checked.length) return;
  if (viaMerge && checked.some((i) => categoryOf(i.url) === "m3u8")) {
    if (!confirm("HLS streams (.m3u8) will be merged into a single file by the desktop app. Continue?")) return;
  }
  const pageUrl = (currentTab && currentTab.url) || "";
  setStatus(`Sending ${checked.length} item(s)…`);
  chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
    { type: "RELAY_BATCH",
      items: checked.map((i) => {
        const { url, format_id, target_format } = i;
        const filename = redditCdnName(url, i.tabRef || currentTab);
        return filename ? { url, format_id, target_format, filename }
                        : { url, format_id, target_format };
      }),
      pageUrl },
    (resp) => {
      setStatus(resp && resp.ok
        ? `Sent ${(resp.job_ids || []).length} item(s) to Grabber ✓`
        : (resp && resp.error) || "Failed to send.");
    }
  );
}

// ---------------- tabs / loading ----------------

function showTab(mode) {
  tabMode = mode;
  document.getElementById("tabCurrent").classList.toggle("active", mode === "current");
  document.getElementById("tabOther").classList.toggle("active", mode === "other");
  document.getElementById("otherTabs").style.display = mode === "other" ? "block" : "none";
  if (mode === "current") loadCurrent();
  else loadOther();
}

async function loadCurrent() {
  const [tab] = await chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true });
  if (!tab) { setItems([], null); return; } // tab closed mid-query
  currentTab = tab;
  chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "GET_VIDEOS", tabId: tab.id }, (resp) => {
    setItems((resp && resp.videos) || [], tab);
    if (!_autoTried) { _autoTried = true; maybeAutoDownload(tab); }
  });
}

// v4.2: exactly one visible media item on the current page -> send it right
// away, toast, and close the popup. Runs once per popup open, and never twice
// for the same URL in the same tab (the second open shows the normal list).
async function maybeAutoDownload(tab) {
  try {
    if (tabMode !== "current" || !/^https?:/i.test(tab.url || "")) return;
    const vis = visibleItems();
    if (vis.length !== 1) return;
    const it = vis[0];
    const KEY = "autoSent";
    const st = await chrome.storage.session.get(KEY);
    const sent = st[KEY] || {};
    if (sent[tab.id] === it.url) return;
    sent[tab.id] = it.url;
    await chrome.storage.session.set({ [KEY]: sent });
    showToast(`Sending ${fileName(it.url)}…`);
    relayOne(it, tab, async (resp) => {
      if (resp && resp.ok) {
        showToast(`Sent ${fileName(it.url)} ✓`);
        setTimeout(() => window.close(), 1300);
      } else {
        delete sent[tab.id];
        try { await chrome.storage.session.set({ [KEY]: sent }); } catch (e) {}
        showToast((resp && resp.error) || "Failed to send", true);
      }
    });
  } catch (e) { /* keep the normal list */ }
}

// 7.6: "Other Pages (N)" once other tabs have detected media. The current tab
// is not "other", so it is left out of the list and the count.
function setOtherLabel() {
  document.getElementById("tabOther").textContent =
    otherTabs.length > 0 ? `Other Pages (${otherTabs.length})` : "Other Pages";
}

function fetchOtherTabs(cb) {
  chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "GET_ALL_VIDEOS" }, (resp) => {
    const curId = currentTab && currentTab.id;
    otherTabs = ((resp && resp.tabs) || []).filter((t) => t.id !== curId);
    setOtherLabel();
    if (cb) cb();
  });
}

function loadOther() {
  fetchOtherTabs(() => {
    renderOtherTabs();
    if (otherTabs.length) selectOtherTab(otherTabs[0].id, false);
    else setItems([], null);
  });
}

function renderOtherTabs() {
  const box = document.getElementById("otherTabs");
  box.innerHTML = "";
  if (!otherTabs.length) {
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No media detected on other tabs.</div>';
    return;
  }
  for (const t of otherTabs) {
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "otab" + (t.id === otherSelId ? " sel" : "");
    const title = document.createElement("span");
    title.textContent = t.title || t.url || `Tab ${t.id}`;
    title.style.overflow = "hidden";
    title.style.textOverflow = "ellipsis";
    title.style.whiteSpace = "nowrap";
    title.style.maxWidth = "260px";
    const count = document.createElement("span");
    count.textContent = `${t.items.length} item(s)`;
    el.append(title, count);
    el.addEventListener("click", () => selectOtherTab(t.id, true));
    box.appendChild(el);
  }
}

function selectOtherTab(tabId, activate) {
  otherSelId = tabId;
  renderOtherTabs();
  const t = otherTabs.find((x) => x.id === tabId);
  if (!t) return;
  if (activate) chrome.tabs.update(tabId, { active: true });
  setItems(t.items, { id: t.id, url: t.url, title: t.title });
}

// ---------------- filter / search ----------------

function rebuildFilterSet() {
  const boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#filterPanel input[data-type], #filterPanel input[value]"))
    .filter((b) => b.value && b.id !== "hideTiny");
  const on = new Set(boxes.filter((b) => b.checked).map((b) => b.value));
  filterSet = on.size === boxes.length ? null : on;
  const tiny = document.getElementById("hideTiny");
  chrome.storage.local.set({ popupFilter: { types: Array.from(on), hideTiny: tiny ? tiny.checked : true } });
  renderMedia();
}

async function restoreFilter() {
  const { popupFilter } = await chrome.storage.local.get("popupFilter");
  if (!popupFilter || !Array.isArray(popupFilter.types)) return;
  const want = new Set(popupFilter.types);
  document.querySelectorAll("#filterPanel input[value]").forEach((b) => {
    if (b.id !== "hideTiny") b.checked = want.has(b.value);
  });
  const tiny = document.getElementById("hideTiny");
  if (tiny && typeof popupFilter.hideTiny === "boolean") tiny.checked = popupFilter.hideTiny;
}

// ---------------- grab-all (secondary, unchanged feature) ----------------

// Scans the page DOM for downloadable-looking links and media sources.
// Runs inside the page via chrome.scripting.executeScript — keep it
// self-contained (no outside references).
function scanPageForDownloads() {
  const EXT_RE = /\.(mp4|m4v|mov|webm|mkv|avi|mp3|wav|flac|m4a|zip|rar|7z|pdf|docx?|pptx?|exe|msi)(\?|#|$)/i;
  const found = new Map();
  document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach((a) => {
    if (EXT_RE.test(a.href)) found.set(a.href, a.textContent.trim() || a.href);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("video, audio").forEach((el) => {
    if (el.currentSrc && !el.currentSrc.startsWith("blob:")) found.set(el.currentSrc, document.title);
    el.querySelectorAll("source[src]").forEach((s) => {
      if (s.src && !s.src.startsWith("blob:")) found.set(s.src, document.title);
    });
  });
  return Array.from(found.entries()).map(([url, filename]) => ({ url, filename }));
}

let grabItems = [];

// v4.2: "Queue X items? [Yes] [Cancel]" for big sends.
function hideGrabConfirm() {
  const box = document.getElementById("grabConfirm");
  if (box) box.style.display = "none";
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById("grabSendBtn");
  if (sendBtn) sendBtn.style.display = "block";
}

function showGrabConfirm(count, onYes) {
  document.getElementById("grabConfirmText").textContent = `Queue ${count} items?`;
  document.getElementById("grabSendBtn").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("grabConfirm").style.display = "flex";
  document.getElementById("grabConfirmYes").onclick = () => { hideGrabConfirm(); onYes(); };
  document.getElementById("grabConfirmNo").onclick = hideGrabConfirm;
}

function renderGrabChecklist() {
  hideGrabConfirm();
  const checklist = document.getElementById("grabChecklist");
  const toolbar = document.getElementById("grabToolbar");
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById("grabSendBtn");
  checklist.innerHTML = "";
  if (!grabItems.length) {
    toolbar.style.display = "none";
    sendBtn.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  toolbar.style.display = "flex";
  sendBtn.style.display = "block";
  grabItems.forEach((item, idx) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "grab-item";
    const cb = document.createElement("input");
    cb.type = "checkbox";
    cb.checked = item.checked;
    cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
      grabItems[idx].checked = cb.checked;
      updateGrabToolbar();
    });
    const name = document.createElement("span");
    name.className = "name";
    name.textContent = item.filename && item.filename !== item.url
      ? `${item.filename} — ${item.url.length > 60 ? item.url.slice(0, 60) + "…" : item.url}`
      : (item.url.length > 90 ? item.url.slice(0, 90) + "…" : item.url);
    row.appendChild(cb);
    row.appendChild(name);
    checklist.appendChild(row);
  });
  updateGrabToolbar();
}

function updateGrabToolbar() {
  hideGrabConfirm();
  const countEl = document.getElementById("grabCount");
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById("grabSendBtn");
  const checkedCount = grabItems.filter((i) => i.checked).length;
  countEl.textContent = `${checkedCount} of ${grabItems.length} selected`;
  sendBtn.disabled = checkedCount === 0;
  sendBtn.textContent = checkedCount
    ? `Download Selected (${checkedCount})`
    : "Download Selected";
}

async function grabAll(tab) {
  const resultEl = document.getElementById("grabResult");
  resultEl.textContent = "Scanning page…";
  grabItems = [];
  renderGrabChecklist();
  let results;
  try {
    const frames = await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
      target: { tabId: tab.id, allFrames: true },
      func: scanPageForDownloads,
    });
    // Same URL can surface from several frames (iframe + parent) — dedupe.
    const seen = new Set();
    results = frames.flatMap((f) => f.result || []).filter((r) => {
      if (seen.has(r.url)) return false;
      seen.add(r.url);
      return true;
    });
  } catch (e) {
    resultEl.textContent = "Couldn't scan this page.";
    return;
  }
  if (!results || !results.length) {
    resultEl.textContent = "No downloadable links found on this page.";
    return;
  }
  grabItems = results.map((r) => ({ ...r, checked: true }));
  resultEl.textContent = `Found ${results.length} item(s) — choose which to send below.`;
  renderGrabChecklist();
}

// ---------------- v4.3: overflow menu (the "..." button) ----------------
// Merge, Copy, Toggle, Sort, Filter, Clear and Search live in #moreMenu. They
// are the same buttons with the same ids and handlers; this only opens and
// closes the menu (click, Escape, arrow keys, click outside).
function setupOverflowMenu() {
  const btn = document.getElementById("btnMore");
  const menu = document.getElementById("moreMenu");
  const items = () => Array.from(menu.querySelectorAll("button")).filter((b) => !b.disabled);
  const close = (refocus) => {
    menu.hidden = true;
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    if (refocus) btn.focus();
  };
  const open = () => {
    menu.hidden = false;
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    const first = items()[0];
    if (first) first.focus();
  };
  btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (menu.hidden) open(); else close(true);
  });
  // The button's own handler runs first (target phase), then the menu closes.
  menu.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest("button:not(:disabled)")) close(false);
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (!menu.hidden && !menu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== btn) close(false);
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (menu.hidden) return;
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); close(true); return; }
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const list = items();
      if (!list.length) return;
      const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement);
      const next = e.key === "ArrowDown" ? (i + 1) % list.length : (i - 1 + list.length) % list.length;
      list[next].focus();
    }
  });
}

// ---------------- v4.3: settings panel (cog) ----------------
// Sections: Pill / Image Micro-Pill / Sniffer / Downloads / Notifications.
// Every control saves straight to chrome.storage.local (key vgSettings,
// see vgsettings.js); content.js and background.js pick the change up
// through storage.onChanged.
async function setupSettings() {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const mainView = $("mainView");
  const setView = $("settingsView");
  const showSettings = (on) => {
    mainView.style.display = on ? "none" : "";
    setView.style.display = on ? "block" : "none";
    if (on) paintSites();
  };
  $("btnCog").addEventListener("click", () => showSettings(setView.style.display !== "block"));
  $("setBack").addEventListener("click", () => showSettings(false));

  let cfg = vgNormalize((await chrome.storage.local.get(VG_SETTINGS_KEY))[VG_SETTINGS_KEY]);
  // [element id, setting key, kind]
  const controls = [
    ["setPillVisible", "pillVisible", "bool"],
    ["setMicroPill", "microPill", "bool"],
    ["setMicroPos", "microPillPos", "str"],
    ["setMicroSize", "microPillSize", "bool"],
    ["setIntercept", "interceptDownloads", "bool"],
    ["setCorner", "pillCorner", "str"],
    ["setQuality", "defaultQuality", "num"],
    ["setMenuH", "maxMenuHeight", "num"],
    ["setSniffer", "snifferMode", "str"],
    ["setNotifyRec", "notifyRecording", "bool"],
    ["setNotifyAct", "notifyActions", "bool"],
  ];
  const paint = () => {
    for (const [id, key, kind] of controls) {
      const el = $(id);
      if (kind === "bool") el.checked = !!cfg[key];
      else el.value = String(cfg[key]);
    }
  };
  for (const [id, key, kind] of controls) {
    $(id).addEventListener("change", async () => {
      const el = $(id);
      const value = kind === "bool" ? el.checked : kind === "num" ? Number(el.value) : el.value;
      cfg = vgNormalize({ ...cfg, [key]: value });
      try { await chrome.storage.local.set({ [VG_SETTINGS_KEY]: cfg }); }
      catch (e) { showToast("Couldn't save the setting", true); }
      paint();
    });
  }
  paint();

  // Sites the pill is hidden on (the same list the "Hide pill on this site"
  // button edits), each removable here.
  async function paintSites() {
    const box = $("setSites");
    const { disabledSites = [] } = await chrome.storage.local.get("disabledSites");
    box.textContent = "";
    if (!disabledSites.length) {
      const none = document.createElement("div");
      none.className = "none";
      none.textContent = "None. The pill shows on every site.";
      box.appendChild(none);
      return;
    }
    for (const host of disabledSites) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "site";
      const name = document.createElement("span");
      name.textContent = host;
      const rm = document.createElement("button");
      rm.textContent = "\u00d7";
      rm.title = "Show the pill on " + host;
      rm.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show the pill on " + host);
      rm.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        const cur = (await chrome.storage.local.get("disabledSites")).disabledSites || [];
        await chrome.storage.local.set({ disabledSites: cur.filter((h) => h !== host) });
        paintSites();
      });
      row.append(name, rm);
      box.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
  chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, area) => {
    if (area === "local" && changes.disabledSites && setView.style.display === "block") paintSites();
  });

  $("setResetPos").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    await chrome.storage.local.remove("pillPrefs");
    showToast("Pill positions reset");
  });
  $("setOptions").addEventListener("click", () => {
    try { chrome.runtime.openOptionsPage(); } catch (e) { showToast("Couldn't open Options", true); }
  });
}

// ---------------- wiring ----------------

(async () => {
  await checkBackend();
  startRecent();
  setupSiteSwitch();
  setupSettings();
  setupOverflowMenu();

  document.getElementById("tabCurrent").addEventListener("click", () => showTab("current"));
  document.getElementById("tabOther").addEventListener("click", () => showTab("other"));

  document.getElementById("btnMerge").addEventListener("click", () => sendBatch(true));
  document.getElementById("btnDownload").addEventListener("click", () => sendBatch(false));
  document.getElementById("btnCopy").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const urls = visibleItems().filter((i) => i.checked).map((i) => i.url);
    if (!urls.length) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(urls.join("\n")).then(() =>
      setStatus(`Copied ${urls.length} URL(s) ✓`));
  });
  document.getElementById("btnToggle").addEventListener("click", () => {
    // Toggle only what the user can see — hidden (filtered/searched-out)
    // items must not get swept into a batch download.
    const vis = visibleItems();
    const allChecked = vis.length > 0 && vis.every((i) => i.checked);
    vis.forEach((i) => { i.checked = !allChecked; });
    renderMedia();
  });
  document.getElementById("btnFilter").addEventListener("click", () => {
    // Read the real state: the panel's initial display comes from CSS, so
    // comparing the inline style made the first click a no-op.
    const p = document.getElementById("filterPanel");
    p.style.display = getComputedStyle(p).display === "none" ? "block" : "none";
  });
  await restoreFilter();
  // E5: restore the saved sort order and let the button cycle it.
  try {
    const { popupSort } = await chrome.storage.local.get("popupSort");
    if (["time", "size", "name"].includes(popupSort)) sortMode = popupSort;
  } catch (e) {}
  updateSortButton();
  document.getElementById("btnSort").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sortMode = sortMode === "time" ? "size" : sortMode === "size" ? "name" : "time";
    chrome.storage.local.set({ popupSort: sortMode });
    renderMedia();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#filterPanel input[type=checkbox]")
    .forEach((b) => b.addEventListener("change", rebuildFilterSet));
  rebuildFilterSet();
  document.getElementById("btnClear").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!currentTab) return;
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "CLEAR_VIDEOS", tabId: currentTab.id }, () => {
      setStatus("List cleared.");
      showTab(tabMode);
    });
  });
  document.getElementById("btnSearch").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const s = document.getElementById("searchInput");
    s.style.display = s.style.display === "none" ? "block" : "none";
    if (s.style.display === "block") s.focus();
    else { s.value = ""; searchText = ""; renderMedia(); }
  });
  document.getElementById("searchInput").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
    searchText = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderMedia();
  });

  // grab-all section
  const [tab] = await chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true });
  currentTab = tab || null;
  fetchOtherTabs();   // fills in the "Other Pages (N)" label up front
  if (tab) {
    document.getElementById("grabAllBtn").addEventListener("click", () => grabAll(tab));
  }
  document.getElementById("grabCheckAll").addEventListener("click", () => {
    grabItems = grabItems.map((i) => ({ ...i, checked: true }));
    renderGrabChecklist();
  });
  document.getElementById("grabUncheckAll").addEventListener("click", () => {
    grabItems = grabItems.map((i) => ({ ...i, checked: false }));
    renderGrabChecklist();
  });
  const sendGrabSelected = () => {
    const resultEl = document.getElementById("grabResult");
    const selected = grabItems.filter((i) => i.checked).map(({ url, filename }) => ({ url, filename }));
    if (!selected.length) return;
    resultEl.textContent = `Sending ${selected.length} item(s) to Grabber…`;
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
      { type: "RELAY_BATCH", items: selected, pageUrl: tab.url },
      (resp) => {
        resultEl.textContent = resp && resp.ok
          ? `Sent ${(resp.job_ids || []).length} item(s) to Grabber ✓`
          : (resp && resp.error) || "Failed to send.";
        if (resp && resp.ok) {
          grabItems = [];
          renderGrabChecklist();
        }
      }
    );
  };
  document.getElementById("grabSendBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const n = grabItems.filter((i) => i.checked).length;
    if (n > GRAB_CONFIRM_LIMIT) { showGrabConfirm(n, sendGrabSelected); return; }
    sendGrabSelected();
  });

  showTab("current");
})();// theme.js: shared by popup.html and options.html. Paints the saved theme
// immediately (no flash), then refreshes it from the app and saves it so the
// in-page pill can use it too. Falls back to the built-in Handheld colors.
(() => {
  const BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5757";
  const MAP = {
    bg_base: "--bg", bg_panel: "--panel", bg_elevated: "--elev", bg_sel: "--sel",
    bg_hover: "--hover", border: "--bd", border_hi: "--bd-hi", text: "--tx",
    text_soft: "--tx-soft", text_muted: "--mu", text_dim: "--dim", accent: "--ac",
    accent_dim: "--ac-dim", text_on_accent: "--on-ac", success: "--ok",
    warning: "--warn", error: "--err", info: "--info", radius: "--r", font: "--font",
  };
  function apply(t) {
    if (!t) return;
    const root = document.documentElement.style;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(MAP)) if (t[k]) root.setProperty(v, t[k]);
  }
  async function load() {
    try {
      const { theme, apiToken } = await chrome.storage.local.get(["theme", "apiToken"]);
      apply(theme);
      if (!apiToken) return;
      const r = await fetch(BASE + "/theme", { headers: { "X-API-Token": apiToken } });
      if (!r.ok) return;
      const fresh = await r.json();
      apply(fresh);
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ theme: fresh });
    } catch (e) { /* app not running: keep what we painted */ }
  }
  load();
})();
// vgsettings.js: shared extension settings (v4.3). Loaded by background.js
// (importScripts), content.js (manifest content_scripts) and popup.html.
// Stored in chrome.storage.local under VG_SETTINGS_KEY. Always read through
// vgNormalize() so a missing or damaged value falls back to the defaults.
const VG_SETTINGS_KEY = "vgSettings";
const VG_DEFAULTS = {
  pillVisible: true,       // show the pill over videos
  pillCorner: "",          // default corner for sites with no saved position: "" (free) | tl | tr | bl | br
  microPill: true,         // image hover micro-pill
  microPillPos: "tr",      // Batch 3: corner the micro-pill sits on: tr (the original spot) | tl | br | bl
  microPillSize: false,    // Batch 3: show the file size in the micro-pill menu (fetched when it opens)
  defaultQuality: 0,       // 0 = auto (best); else preferred height (e.g. 1080) when a site has no remembered pick
  maxMenuHeight: 0,        // 0 = no cap; else max dropdown height in px (menu scrolls inside)
  snifferMode: "all",      // "all" tabs | "active" tab only
  notifyRecording: true,   // desktop notifications for recordings
  notifyActions: true,     // desktop notifications for shortcuts and right-click sends
  interceptDownloads: false, // Batch 3: hand every browser download to the app.
                           // THE one source of truth for the interceptor: the
                           // old standalone "interceptDownloads" storage key is
                           // read once as a migration fallback (background.js,
                           // options.js) and never written again.
};
function vgNormalize(raw) {
  const r = (raw && typeof raw === "object") ? raw : {};
  const d = VG_DEFAULTS;
  const bool = (k) => (typeof r[k] === "boolean" ? r[k] : d[k]);
  const pick = (k, allowed) => (allowed.includes(r[k]) ? r[k] : d[k]);
  const num = (k, min, max) => {
    const n = (typeof r[k] === "number") ? r[k] : NaN;
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(n))) : d[k];
  };
  return {
    pillVisible: bool("pillVisible"),
    pillCorner: pick("pillCorner", ["", "tl", "tr", "bl", "br"]),
    microPill: bool("microPill"),
    microPillPos: pick("microPillPos", ["tr", "tl", "br", "bl"]),
    microPillSize: bool("microPillSize"),
    defaultQuality: num("defaultQuality", 0, 4320),
    maxMenuHeight: num("maxMenuHeight", 0, 2000),
    snifferMode: pick("snifferMode", ["all", "active"]),
    notifyRecording: bool("notifyRecording"),
    notifyActions: bool("notifyActions"),
    interceptDownloads: bool("interceptDownloads"),
  };
}
